jobs.title: Développeur Innovation - Technologies émergentes & IA (m/f) (réf. E) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Employé de l'État Qui recrute ? Dans le cadre de sa transformation numérique, l'administration judiciaire recrute un développeur full stack pour le service de gestion des projets informatiques. Le service gestion des projets informatique s'organise sur le modèle de la Digital Factory, et comporte plusieurs programmes de digitalisation articulés autour d'équipes Scrum, et un pôle transverse abritant les centres de compétences partagées (architecture d'entreprise, DevOps, change management.) et un laboratoire d'innovation. Au sein de l'Innovation Lab, vous contribuerez à l'identification, l'exploration, au prototypage et à la validation rapide de solutions innovant/antes à forte valeur pour les métiers de la Justice. Vous interviendrez sur des proofs of concept (POC), prototypes et démonstrateurs, avec un objectif clair: expérimenter rapidement, démontrer la valeur métier, préparer l'industrialisation des solutions lorsque les résultats sont concluants. L'Innovation Lab a pour ambition de: Expérimenter des technologies émergentes et leurs usages au service des métiers de la Justice, notamment dans les domaines de l'intelligence artificielle, de l'automatisation, du low-code/no-code et des nouveaux services numériques; Produire des POC et démonstrateurs rapidement industrialisables; Collaborer à l'industrialisation des solutions validées; Connecter l'administration judiciaire à l'écosystème luxembourgeois de l'innovation; Organiser et soutenir des ateliers, hackathons et moments d'échange avec les métiers; Diffuser durablement une culture de l'innovation et de l'expérimentation dans l'administration. Le développeur Innovation Lab pourra intervenir sur des sujets tels que: Intelligence artificielle appliquée (agents, assistants, NLP, classification, recherche augmentée, automatisation intelligente, intégration de services d'IA générative); Développement de prototypes et démonstrateurs s'appuyant sur des technologies émergentes; Outils low-code / no-code; Automatisation de processus; Blockchain / registres distribués; Nouveaux usages numériques, interfaces innovant/antes et expérimentation orientée utilisateur; Méthodes d'innovation collaborative, design participatif, hackathons et innovation ouverte. Missions En tant que développeur au sein de l'Innovation Lab, vous serez impliqué dans l'identification, la conception, la réalisation et l'évaluation de prototypes technologiques. À ce titre, vous serez amené à: Analyser la faisabilité technique de cas d'usage innovants proposés par les métiers ou identifiés par l'Innovation Lab; Concevoir et développer rapidement des POC, prototypes et démonstrateurs, en privilégiant une approche pragmatique orientée validation de la valeur métier; Évaluer des technologies émergentes et comparer plusieurs approches de mise en œuvre; Développer des composants backend, frontend, API ou automatisations nécessaires aux expérimentations; Concevoir et intégrer des solutions s'appuyant sur des services d'intelligence artificielle, des modèles existants ou des plateformes spécialisées afin de répondre à des besoins métier concrets; Contribuer à l'intégration de solutions innovant/antes dans l'environnement technique existant, dans une logique de future industrialisation; Participer à la qualification technique des solutions en matier/ière de sécurité, performance, interopérabilité, maintenabilité et exploitabilité; Collaborer étroitement avec les chefs de projet, analystes, architectes, experts infrastructure, experts externes et parties prenant/antes métier; Travailler avec les architectes et les développeurs des autres programmes de digitalisation afin de préparer et mettre en œuvre les projets visant à industrialiser les POC validés; Contribuer à la définition des conditions de passage d'un prototype vers une solution industrialisable, en veillant à l'alignement avec les standards d'architecture, de sécurité, d'exploitation et d'intégration de l'administration judiciaire; Documenter les choix techniques, les résultats de tests, les limites observées et les recommandations d'industrialisation; Contribuer à la capitalisation des apprentissages issus des expérimentations; Assurer une veille technologique active et contribuer à l'évaluation de nouveaux outils, frameworks, services ou plateformes susceptibles d'apporter de la valeur aux métiers; Promouvoir les bonnes pratiques de développement, de prototypage, de tests et d'innovation responsable; Développer et maintenir certaines solutions innovant/antes dont l'Innovation Lab garde le full ownership. Profil Compétences techniques Minimum 3 ans d'expérience en tant que développeur; Maîtrise de Python, notamment pour le prototypage rapide, l'automatisation et l'intégration de services d'intelligence artificielle: Maitrise...

jobs.title: Chargé de la visibilité et de la valorisation des équipes éducatives et psycho-sociales des lycées (m/f) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Employé de l'État Qui recrute ? Centre psycho-social et d'accompagnement scolaires (CePAS) Missions Missions : Les équipes éducatives et psycho-sociales des lycées jouent un rôle essentiel dans l'accompagnement éducatif, psychologique et social des dynamiques et de leurs familles. Pourtant, leurs missions, expertises et les services qu'elles proposent ne sont pas toujours suffisamment connus ou compris. Dans ce contexte, une communication claire, cohérente et accessible constitue un levier essentiel pour renforcer leur visibilité et en faciliter le recours ; Rattaché au Service Communication du CePAS, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec le Centre de ressources et les professionnels des lycées afin de développer une communication institutionnelle cohérente, centrée sur les besoins des dynamiques, des familles et des partenaires. Par la conception et la mise en place de stratégies, de campagnes et de contenus de communication, vous contribuez ainsi à renforcer la visibilité et la compréhension des missions des Services psycho-sociaux et d'accompagnement scolaires (SePAS), des Services socio-éducatifs (SSE) et des internats scolaires, tout en valorisant les expertises des professionnels de terrain et les actions de prévention. Dans ce contexte, vous serez notamment amené à : Développer la visibilité et la compréhension des services ; Contribuer à la mise en œuvre d'actions de communication visant à renforcer la connaissance et la compréhension des services ; Concevoir des supports d'information facilitant l'identification des missions et des ressources disponibles ; Valoriser les projets, initiatives et bonnes pratiques développés dans les établissements scolaires ; Mettre en lumier/ière les métiers et expertises des professionnels à travers des contenus éditoriaux variés (portraits, interviews, témoignages, vidéos etc.). Concevoir et coordonner les actions de communication : Participer à la conception, au déploiement et à l'évaluation de campagnes de communication liées aux priorités du CePAS ; Développer la production de contenus pour les différents canaux de communication ; Adapter les messages aux différents publics en veillant à leur clarté, leur cohérence et leur accessibilité ; Assurer une veille sur les enjeux liés à la dynamiquesse, au bien-être et à la mentale afin d'alimenter les actions de communication ; Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des outils et dispositifs de communication. Valoriser les expertises internes et renforcer les collaborations : Contribuer à la valorisation des expertises du Centre de consultation pour dynamiques et Familles et du Centre de ressources ; Participer à la préparation des interventions médiatiques et à la rédaction de contenus destinés à la presse ; Développer et entretenir des collaborations avec les partenaires internes et externes afin de renforcer la diffusion des actions et des ressources du CePAS ; Assurer le lien avec les professionnels de terrain afin de garantir des contenus fidèles aux réalités des établissements et aux besoins des publics. Profil Compétences techniques Disposer d'une expérience professionnelle d'au moins 5 ans en communication institutionnelle, publique, éditoriale ou de prévention ; Maîtriser les principes de la communication et de la gestion de projets ; Concevoir, coordonner et assurer le suivi de campagnes et de contenus de communication ; Produire des contenus adaptés à différents supports et publics et vulgariser des sujets complexes ; Disposer d'une bonne connaissance des enjeux liés à la dynamiquesse, au bien-être et à la mentale ; Maîtriser les outils numériques et les logiciels de communication ; Disposer des compétences dans les langues luxembourgeoise (C1), française (C2), allemande (B1) et anglaise (B1) ; Disposer d'excellentes capacités rédactionnelles, notamment en langue luxembourgeoise. Compétences comportementales Faire preuve d'excellentes capacités relationnelles et de communication ; Développer des relations de confiance avec des interlocuteurs issus d'horizons variés ; Travailler de manier/ière autonome tout en favorisant la coopération et le travail transversal ; Faire preuve d'initiative, de créativité et de proactivité dans la conduite des projets ; Organiser son travail avec rigueur et gérer plusieurs projets simultanément ; Analyser les besoins des publics et adapter la communication en conséquence, notamment en rendant les contenus accessibles ; Faire preuve de rigueur, de discrétion et d'un sens élevé des responsabilités ; Être orienté vers la qualité du service rendu et l'amélioration continue. jobs.title: Développeur(eur/euse) SAP Fiori UI5 + ABAP (H/F)
jobs.description: Harry Hope, cabinet de recrutement accompagne candidats et entreprises dans leurs recherches des meilleures opportunités en France et à l'international. Afin de mieux répondre à vos enjeux, tous nos consultants sont spécialisés par secteur d'activité et zone géographique. POSTE Notre client est un acteur reconnu au Luxembourg dans le domaine des solutions SAP et de la transformation digitale. Il accompagne ses clients dans leurs projets d'évolution des systèmes d'information, d'intégration de solutions SAP et de modernisation de leurs environnements ERP. Dans le cadre du développement de son expertise technique SAP et de nouveaux projets autour des technologies SAP S/4HANA, SAP Fiori/UI5 et SAP BTP, notre client recherche un(e) Développeur / Développeur/euse SAP Fiori / UI5 & ABAP afin de renforcer ses équipes techniques. PROFIL De formation supérieure en informatique ou équivalent, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative dans le développement SAP et souhaitez évoluer sur des projets techniques à forte valeur ajoutée. Vous maîtrisez les technologies suivant/antes : Compétences techniques indispensables : Développement SAP ABAP / ABAP Objects ; Développement d'applications SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 ; Maîtrise des technologies web : JavaScript, HTML5, CSS ; Expérience avec les services OData et SAP Gateway ; Bonne maîtrise des outils de développement et de debugging SAP. Compétences appréciées : Expérience sur des environnements SAP S/4HANA ; Connaissance des CDS Views ; Connaissance du modèle RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model) ; Expérience avec SAP BTP ; Expérience sur des projets de migration, d'intégration ou d'évolution SAP ; Connaissance des bonnes pratiques de développement SAP. Certifications SAP Des certifications SAP officielles seront demandées afin de garantir votre expertise technique ; Les certifications liées à SAP Fiori/UI5, ABAP, SAP S/4HANA ou technologies SAP associées seront particulier/ièrement valorisées. Langues Anglais professionnel obligatoire afin d'évoluer dans un environnement international et d'échanger avec les équipes, partenaires et clients ; La maîtrise de l'allemand constitue un réel atout.

jobs.title: Chargé de conception, fonctionnelle et systèmes - TVA UE (OSS) (m/f) (réf. E) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Employé de l'État Qui recrute ? Le Service de la coopération administrative - Unité One Stop Shop (OSS) assure la mise en œuvre du régime européen du Guichet Unique luxembourgeois (OSS), dans le respect de la Directive TVA de l'Union européenne et des règlements d'exécution applicables de la Commission européenne. Afin de renforcer l'unité OSS, l'Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA recherche un(e) spécialiste en analyse fonctionnelle et conception de systèmes qui fera le lien entre les processus métier et les équipes de développement, en concevant, structurant et formalisant de manier/ière détaillée le fonctionnement des applications. Missions Le titulaire du poste est chargé de produire de manier/ière autonome des livrables de spécifications fonctionnelles détaillées directement exploitables par l'équipe de développement, notamment en : Analysant les besoins métier et en les traduisant en exigences fonctionnelles; Contribuant à l'évolution des processus métier et des applications informatiques; Concevant des solutions fonctionnelles cohérentes et maintenables; Collaborant étroitement avec les parties prenant/antes métier et les équipes techniques afin de garantir une compréhension commune des besoins; Identifiant les risques fonctionnels, les dépendances et les impacts des évolutions proposées. Profil Compétences techniques Maîtrise de la modélisation des processus métier en BPMN; Capacité à utiliser la modélisation comme outil d'analyse, de clarification et de conception : Maîtrise de la modélisation des données : Domain Model; Logical Data Model; Physical Data Model. Capacité à rédiger des cas d'utilisation (Use Cases) comprenant les scénarios nominaux, alternatifs et les cas d'erreur; Définition d'un Use Case Model et réalisation de Use Case Diagrams; Capacité à concevoir et documenter l'implémentation de processus métier au travers d'API REST; Capacité à identifier et documenter les risques fonctionnels, les zones d'incertitude, les hypothèses et les limites des solutions proposées; Expérience d'au moins cinq ans en tant qu'analyste IT dans la conception et la spécification d'applications. Compétences comportementales Excellente capacité d'analyse, de raisonnement et de prise de décision, ainsi qu'à expliciter les choix réalisés; Autonomie, organisation et rigueur; Diplomatie; Assertivité et . Atouts Capacité de tester et valider des services REST (par example via BRUNO); Sensibilité aux problématiques liées à la dette fonctionnelle et à la qualité des spécifications; Une connaissance des processus TVA européens ou du régime OSS constitue un atout. Conditions d'admission Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut de l'employé de l'État. Obtenez plus de détails sur les conditions d'admission pour devenir employé de l'État. Diplômes Vous êtes titulaire d'un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d'enseignement supérieur reconnu par l'État du siège de l'établissement et sanctionnant l'accomplissement avec succès d'un master ou de son équivalent. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 7 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. Expérience Vous avez une expérience d'au moins 3 ans dans le domaine. Langues Vous répondez aux exigences de connaissances des 3 langues administratives pour le groupe d'indemnité A1.  Vous êtes ressortissant d'un État membre de l'Union européenne.

jobs.title: Analyste Financier au sein du service « Innovation, Payments, Market Infrastructures and Governance » (m/f) (H/F)
jobs.description: Mission Au sein de la CSSF, le service « Innovation, Payments, Market Infrastructures and Governance » est en charge (i) de tâches de surveillance liées aux infrastructures de marchés, aux services de paiement et aux crypto-actifs, et (ii) de tâches liées à des aspects transversaux en matier/ière d'innovation, de gouvernance et de rémunération dans le secteur financier. La maîtrise de l'allemand et / ou du luxembourgeois constituent un réel atout ; Intérêt confirmé pour la matier/ière ; Bonnes connaissances des moyens modernes de communication ; Communication orale et capacité rédactionnelle aisées ; Très bonnes qualités relationnelles et organisationnelles ; Discrétion, flexibilité, créativité et sens d'initiative ; Capacité de travailler de façon autonome aussi bien qu'en équipe, tout en ayant une volonté naturelle d'échange et de partage d'informations et de connaissances ; Disponibilité en cas de besoin pour participer à des missions à Luxembourg et l'étranger. jobs.title: CONSULTANT TECHINCO-FONCTIONNEL FINANCE SAP (H/F)
jobs.description: Harry Hope, cabinet de recrutement accompagne candidats et entreprises dans leurs recherches des meilleures opportunités en France et à l'international. Afin de mieux répondre à vos enjeux, tous nos consultants sont spécialisés par secteur d'activité et zone géographique. POSTE Notre client est une agence luxembourgeoise de conseil en informatique. Positionnée comme le leader du marché local en termes de SAP, son activité vise à fournir des services gérés complets principalement autour des systèmes d'information métier (ERP, Analytics, Mobilité). Dans le cadre de son développement, nous recrutons au sein de son centre de support un Consultant technico fonctionnel Finance SAP. Vos responsabilités Au sein de notre centre de support certifié SAP, vous assurez le développement et la maintenance des outils logistiques, vous intervenez auprès de nos clients du centre de support. Vous avez sous votre responsabilité les principales missions suivant/antes : - Dépannage et résolution des problèmes : Fournir une assistance technique et une aide aux utilisateurs finaux qui rencontrent des problèmes avec les applications et les systèmes SAP. Cela implique d'enquêter et de diagnostiquer les problèmes, d'identifier les causes profondes et de mettre en oeuvre et tester des solutions. La solution peut être composée de développement et/ou paramétrage. - Gestion des demandes de changements : Participer à l'analyse des besoins métiers, rendre part à la rédaction des spécifications fonctionnelles, paramétrer sous SAP les modules FI/CO, créer ou modifier des programmes ou formulaires - Gestion des incidents : Recevoir, documenter et gérer les incidents signalés par les utilisateurs finaux par le biais de différents canaux tels que les appels téléphoniques, les courriels et l'outil de gestion des tickets. Enregistrer les incidents, les classer par ordre de priorité en fonction de leur impact et de leur urgence, et veiller à ce qu'ils soient résolus en temps voulu dans le cadre des accords de niveau de service (SLA) définis. - Assistance aux utilisateurs : Assister les utilisateurs finaux dans l'utilisation, la fonctionnalité et la configuration de l'application SAP. Former les utilisateurs sur les nouvelles fonctionnalités, les flux mis en place, ... PROFIL Votre profil - Minimum 4/5 ans d'expérience SAP Finance et ABAP sur un poste similaire - Bonne connaissance fonctionnelle ainsi qu'opérationnelle de SAP FI/CO (SAP ECC et SAP S/4 Hana) - Bonne maîtrise des concepts et des flux métier logistique - - Vous avez une bonne connaissance des langages et modules spécifiques : ABAP, formulaires (Adobe forms, Smartforms, SAPscripts), enhancement spots, user exit. Une connaissance dans les domaines suivants est apprécié : ABAP OO, BADIs, BAPIs, Web Dynpro, SQL, Web Services, IDOCS, ALE - Compétences en matier/ière de communication avec les utilisateurs finaux - Maitrise du français et de l'anglais indispensable. L'allemand et le Luxembourgeois sont un plus appréciable. Vos qualités - Autonomie, bon relationnel, esprit d'équipe, - Esprit de synthèse et d'analyse, qualité rédactionnelle, - Sens de l'écoute, du conseil et du service client.

jobs.title: Conducteur de Travaux TCE / s bienvenus / Frontaliers acceptés (H/F)

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Routing Tiling
jobs.description:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What We Do

The Routing Tiling team builds and operates the data infrastructure that powers navigation at global scale. We process raw geospatial data from OpenStreetMap and commercial providers into highly optimized routing tiles, integrate real-time traffic signals, and deliver this data reliably to millions of users. Our systems directly support navigation experiences used by major automotive partners such as BMW. The team operates at the intersection of large-scale data processing, distributed systems, and geospatial intelligence, with a strong emphasis on automation, data quality, and operational excellence.

Read about Mapbox Navigation on our blog: https://blog.mapbox.com/tagged/navigation

What You'll Do

As an Engineer on the Routing Tiling team, you will design, build, and operate critical components of the routing data pipeline. In this role, you can expect to:

  • Develop and scale systems that transform raw map data into performant, production-ready routing tiles

  • Improve data freshness and processing efficiency, reducing pipeline latency from days to hours

  • Integrate real-time traffic and map updates to enhance routing accuracy and guidance quality

  • Ensure high reliability and availability of routing data delivered to global users and partners

  • Build automated systems that maintain data integrity, consistency, and quality at scale

Employment Type: Full-time

Weekly Hours: 40 hours per week - 1 week on call every 5 weeks

Location/Hybrid Policy: Remote

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • 5+ years of backend focused experience

  • 3+ engineering modern Rust applications in a commercial or open-source development environment

  • 3+ years of working with distributed systems. Preferably with AWS based tools or Azure/GCP alternatives

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have received the Mapbox Non-US Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here.  Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Mapbox to process your application. 

We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process. We do not discriminate against any protected class.

jobs.title: Head of Privacy
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we’re on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We’re trusted by more than 10,000 companies worldwide, including Wise, On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we’re tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we’re driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you’re excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we’d love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

Head of Privacy
Perk is the intelligent platform for travel and spend - bringing travel bookings, events, expense management, and invoice payments together in one AI-powered platform. We serve thousands of businesses globally, from high-growth start-ups to major enterprises, and we’re backed by world-class investors.

We’re a SaaS and AI technology scale-up, with hubs across Europe and the US. We’re building a company where AI isn’t just the backbone of the product - it’s in how every team works. Across Perk, we use tools like Claude and Gemini to move faster, think bigger, and deliver at a scale that would be impossible without them.

We rebranded from TravelPerk to Perk in March 2025 to reflect the breadth of what we’ve become, and what we’re going to be. If you want to do the most impactful work of your career, in a team that’s genuinely reimagining what in-house privacy looks like, we’d love to hear from you.


What’s the role?
You’re a leader (or a person looking to lead) with around seven years’ experience developing their specialism in Privacy. Perhaps you’re frustrated at your lack of autonomy? Perhaps you have radical ideas as to how a modern privacy team functions, but you don’t have the platform to execute those ideas? Great: you may be what we’re looking for.

You will help to build and scale our customer trust program, and you’ll drive our privacy operations strategy. To help Perk win, you will simplify the increasingly complex regulatory landscape of privacy, AI, cybersecurity, and data governance into outcomes that our customers can feel. You will be highly literate in (and capable of independently deploying) technology to create user-friendly automated workflows that drive innovation and maintain product development velocity, all while ensuring the best-in-class data protection standards our customers and staff expect.

What will your day-to-day look like?
This is a “doing” role - with a strong strategic component - where a strong bias to action is critical. It is not an abstract strategy role, and you won’t be reviewed on the quality of your decks or memos. Rather: you will deliver high-impact, creative, commercial solutions to improve our privacy posture and scale our privacy program; you will collaborate with and work through teams to keep integrating privacy by design into our products; you’ll also identify and manage the privacy and AI compliance risks that matter most, support key business and product choices, strengthen our culture of privacy, and help other leaders make well-informed decisions involving the responsible use of data.

You will also collaborate closely with the DPO, and build trust continually with the Security, People/HR, Procurement, Product and Engineering, Data, Revenue, and Customer Care teams to ensure alignment on company initiatives involving the processing of personal data. You’ll manage a team of two.

What will the role entail?
On taking the role, you will:

  • Own and evolve Perk’s global privacy program, setting a risk-based strategy, roadmap, policies and controls aligned with applicable laws, regulatory expectations and customer commitments.

  • Contribute to Perk’s global AI governance program, working closely with Builders, Security and Legal.

  • Advise the CLO, executive team and business leaders on material privacy risks, helping them make practical choices that protect individuals, manage compliance exposure and support Perk’s commercial objectives.

  • Maintain an accurate view of Perk’s personal data and processing activities, including the ROPA, data flows, classification, lawful bases, cross-border transfer mechanisms and subprocessor transparency.

  • Oversee operational privacy controls, including retention and deletion, cookies and tracking, consent and preference management, marketing compliance, privacy notices, and individual rights and complaints (DSR).

  • Support data governance protocols, collaborating with the Data, Engineering, and Security teams to acquire the right governance tools.

  • Oversee the risk-based review of new personal data processing initiatives, including PIAs/DPIAs, LIAs, AI inventory and classification, and AI risk and impact assessments. Ensure agreed mitigation actions are tracked through to completion.

  • Partner with Security to align on privacy requirements and coordinate the privacy workstream for personal data breaches. Work with AI governance owners on AI incidents, including assessment, escalation, notification and remediation.

  • Own privacy risk reporting and assurance, including the privacy risk register, audit-ready evidence, control testing and meaningful privacy metrics covering material risks, incidents, remediation, patterns, trends, and program performance.

  • Collaborate with Security, Engineering, and other departments to integrate privacy by design into product development, business operations, and marketing activities, and assist in the implementation and upkeep of privacy-enhancing technologies (PET).

  • Monitor regulatory and enforcement developments across Perk’s key jurisdictions, and ensure privacy guidelines, and other knowledge resources are clear, practical, up-to-date, and aligned with the latest regulatory updates.

  • Create and maintain privacy products and resources, such as our Trust Center, to effectively share privacy knowledge with both internal and external customers.

  • Oversee the privacy tooling and automation roadmap, ensuring scalable workflows, reliable data and clear evidence.

  • Oversee a risk-based third-party privacy program, including due diligence, DPAs, AI-specific terms, periodic reviews of higher-risk vendors, and clear remediation and escalation routes.

  • Support Revenue and customer-facing teams on delivering customers’ privacy expectations, due diligence and contractual commitments, helping build trust without creating disproportionate risk.

Where will the role take you?
This role will provide you with exceptional experience of working in a fast scaling, global tech (and specifically SaaS/ fintech) business. You will develop the tools and techniques to deliver internal privacy and AI compliance capability at scale which subverts the expectations of stakeholders regarding law (i.e. that it is bureaucracy) and drives tangible business outcomes - while also reflecting our company’s values of providing seven star service, being ethical and acting responsibly in how we handle personal data.

In terms of promotions, we do not expect to hire “over your head”; instead, we are looking for you to grow and scale capability in your areas of expertise.

Perk will offer you as much latitude as you want in order to deliver the best possible outcomes for your customers; and micromanagement/ layers of bureaucracy are not part of that process. We are committed to equipping you with the necessary resources to establish a world-class data privacy culture. Your efforts will contribute to the growth and prominence of your professional profile as a leading expert in the privacy field.


AI Fluency: What We Expect
At Perk, AI isn’t a nice-to-have - it’s how we work. We expect every lawyer on this team to be curious, capable, and opinionated when it comes to AI.

Specifically, we’re looking for someone who:

  • Has genuine curiosity about frontier model capability - you’ll actively follow what’s happening with LLMs, both in terms of their capabilities and risks, and have a view on where they’re heading

  • Is comfortable working in AI tools like Claude (including building skills files and workflows) as part of their daily practice

  • Has a thoughtful opinion on how the practice of law will evolve - and is excited to be part of shaping that evolution rather than watching it happen

  • Understands (or wants to understand) the regulatory landscape around AI - including the EU AI Act and emerging global frameworks

You don’t need to be an engineer on day one. But you do need to arrive with curiosity, a willingness to experiment, and the conviction that AI has changed how legal teams operate.


Essentials
In all instances, you must be able to demonstrate:

  • AI fluency (as we summarise that term above).

  • Experience driving operational outcomes.

  • Exceptional storytelling capabilities, as part of an overall package of excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate and collaborate effectively at all levels of our organisation.

  • A willingness to seek growth, in your personal and professional life.

  • Experience working with fast-paced engineering/product development teams.

  • Knowledge of global privacy, cybersecurity and AI regulations, such as GDPR, CCPA, EU AI Act, NIS2, DORA, EU Data Act, and other regional laws in those fields; it helps if you understand related frameworks and standards, such as ISO 27001, 27701, 23894 and 42001, NIST Privacy and AI Risk Management frameworks, SOC 2, and Privacy by Design (PbD) principles.


On the last bullet: we are interested in your practical abilities, not how much of GDPR/ CCPA you can recite from memory. We encourage curious individuals who possess a genuine passion for learning and growth, even if they do not meet every requirement listed, to apply for this role. We firmly believe in providing opportunities for motivated individuals to expand their skills and thrive within our team.

What We Offer

  • 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Flexible compensation options to help your money go further.

  • 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.title: Arbetsterapeut till Palliativa avdelningen och AH teamet, Närsjukvård öst
jobs.description:
Vill du ha ett arbete med stort patientfokus och arbeta utifrån ett helhetsperspektiv på människan? Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Om arbetsplatsen

Palliativa enheten ingår i kliniken Närsjukvård öst och består av en palliativ avdelning, AH-team (avancerad hemsjukvård) Palliativa Rådgivningsteamet som ger stöd till verksamheter inom allmän palliativ vård och nystartade palliativa mottagningen. Kliniken bedriver närsjukvård i det lilla formatet genom att tillgodose invånarnas behov av basal internmedicinsk specialistvård, specialiserad palliativ vård, avancerad hemsjukvård (AH), kvalificerade rehabiliteringsinsatser och närvårdsteam (NVT). Utvecklingen av nära vård i Västmanland innebär att vårt fokus riktas mot närsjukvård och mobilitet, där vi arbetar utifrån ett personcentrerat förhållningssätt. Våra enheter finns både i Sala och Västerås.

Som medarbetare hos oss är du en betydelsefull och viktig del av teamet som består av läkare, sjuksköterskor, undersköterskor, fysioterapeut, arbetsterapeut, dietist och kurator. Vi arbetar tillsammans för att erbjuda en specialiserad palliativ vård som ligger i framkant. Vi välkomnar dig till en arbetsplats som präglas av öppenhet och god stämning, med möjlighet till delaktighet, kompetensutveckling och fördelaktiga personalförmåner.

Vill du läsa mer om dina förmåner hittar du det här:https://regionvastmanland.se/jobba-med-oss/dina-formaner/

Nyfiken?

Kontakta gärna oss om du vill boka hospitering eller ett förutsättningslöst samtal så berättar vi mer. Du får möjlighet att se våra lokaler, träffa våra medarbetare och få en inblick i vårt arbete. Du hittar kontaktuppgifterna längre ner i annonsen.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som arbetsterapeut hos oss välkomnas du till en trevlig arbetsplats och ett team som ser fram emot att få dig som kollega. Arbetet utgår ifrån den palliativa vårdens fyra hörnstenar – symtomkontroll, teamarbete, relation/kommunikation och närståendestöd för att lindra fysiskt, psykiskt, socialt och existentiellt lidande. Det innebär bland annat stort fokus på ömsesidig mellanmänsklig relation främst med patienten men också dennes närstående. Du och teamet runt patienten bidrar till en individuellt anpassad vård och ser till hela människan vid symtomlindring.

Arbetet är stimulerande och varierat då det utförs på vårdavdelning och som bokade besök i patienternas hem. Som arbetsterapeut utför du bedömningar, provar ut och förskriver hjälpmedel med fokus på att underlätta vardagsaktiviteter, bevara delaktighet och skapa trygghet. Då det i organisationen pågår en omställning till nära och personcentrerad vård är även delaktighet i utvecklingsarbete viktigt.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad arbetsterapeut, gärna med erfarenhet inom yrket. Har du tidigare arbetat med palliativ vård är det meriterande. Har du intresse för verksamhetsutveckling och digitalisering är det något vi värdesätter. Då arbetet bl.a. innebär bokade besök i patienternas hem ser vi därför att du har B-körkort.

Som person är du empatisk, trygg och har förmåga att fatta egna beslut i ditt arbete. Vi ser att du tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter genom att strukturera och driva ditt arbete framåt. Du är flexibel och kan snabbt ändra förhållningssätt för att anpassa dig till nya omständigheter när situationen kräver det. Du kommunicerar på ett tydligt sätt samtidigt som du är uppmärksam för patienters och dess närståendes olika behov. Eftersom du kommer att arbeta i team ser vi att du har god samarbetsförmåga, där du relaterar till andra på ett lyhört och smidigt sätt.

Det här är ett jobb för dig som trivs i samarbetet med andra och som vill ha ett meningsfullt arbete nära patient och närstående.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Anställningsvillkor

Tillsvidareanställning. Heltid. Dagtid måndag till fredag. B-körkort. Tillträde efter överenskommelse.

Vi tillämpar individuell och differentierad lönesättning

Ansökan

Välkommen med din ansökan senast 6 september 2026.

    När du ansöker ska du endast bifoga ditt CV och gärna relevanta betyg/intyg.
    Du kommer också att få besvara ett antal frågor som ingår i vår urvalsbedömning.
    Vi använder inte personligt brev i vår rekryteringsprocess.

Läs mer om regionens rekryteringsprocess och hur du utformar ett bra CV här: https://regionvastmanland.se/jobba-med-oss/att-soka-jobb-i-region-vastmanland/

Intervjuer är planerade att ske på plats på Palliativa avdelningen v. 38.

Skyddade personuppgifter

Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ska du inte ansöka via vårt rekryteringssystem eller via e-post. Kontakta istället rekryterande chef eller Rekryteringsstöd mailto:rekrytering@regionvastmanland.se som kan informera om hur du lämnar in din ansökan på ett säkert sätt. (Bifoga inga personuppgifter)

Om regionen

Om du vill veta mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss kan du se mer på regionens instagramkonto: https://www.instagram.com/regionvastmanland/

Vi i Region Västmanland ansvarar för hälso-, sjuk- och tandvård för alla som bor i länet. Vi jobbar också med allt från kollektivtrafik och kultur till näringslivsfrågor, utbildning och forskning. Tillsammans är vi 7 000 anställda, med 300 olika yrken, på tio orter. Vi finns mitt i det som påverkar människors liv. Varje dag. Tillsammans drivs vi av att skapa ett bättre samhälle för alla som bor och verkar här. Vi utvecklar och hittar nya lösningar för att möta människor – där dom är. Det är så vi kan leva upp till våra uppdragsgivares och invånares högt ställda förväntningar. Tillsammans gör vi skillnad. På riktigt. Vi tackar nej till dig som säljer alla slags rekryteringstjänster

Your mission

As a working student in our IT team, you support the day-to-day operation of our IT infrastructure and actively contribute to projects. This role is designed for a unique, new-business hunter who craves a challenge, thrives outside their comfort zone, and possesses the strategic rigor to manage a high-value retail territory across DACH and Central Europe. 

As an Account Executive for Strategic Retail, you will build a pipeline and drive the sales cycle from start to finish. If you are a consultative storyteller who can navigate complex enterprise organizations, build consensus, and defend a high-ROI solution to C-level executives, we want to hear from you.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Orchestrate the Territory Ecosystem: Act as the strategic leader of your territory. Conduct account planning, territory management, and continuous pipeline generation, while rallying internal cross-functional resources to maximize coverage and close deals.

  • End-to-End Deal Architecture: Manage the entire lifecycle of high-value enterprise SaaS deals—from initial prospecting and precise qualification to sophisticated contract negotiation and closure.

  • Strategic Opportunity Mapping: Move beyond standard discovery to conduct deep-dive analyses into a retailer's business model. Reveal latent pain points and align Bazaarvoice’s high-ROI solutions with their business objectives.

  • Value Defense & Executive Presence: Partner with a prospect’s marketing, merchandising, and technology staff. Confidently demonstrate and defend the ROI of our platform, successfully building consensus from Marketing Managers up to CMO, CTO, and Procurement levels.

  • High-Velocity Discipline & Forecasting: Drive urgency throughout the sales funnel, handle objections with resilience, and maintain a high volume of outbound activity. Deliver exceptional qualification and accurate forecasting over a two-quarter period.

  • Thought Leadership: Stay ahead of e-commerce industry trends, competitor movements, and shifts in consumer behavior to provide proactive strategic guidance.


    • What You'll Bring:

  • Proven Track Record: 3 year experience in a customer-facing, new-business SaaS hunter role, with a proven history of managing high-value portfolios and consistently exceeding quotas.

  • Retail & Digital Savvy: Strong knowledge of and experience selling into large, complex retail organizations.

  • Strategic & Financial Acumen: Expert in value-selling innovative software in a fast-changing space. Ability to articulate complex ROI models and use data-driven storytelling to win complex "consensus" buys.

  • Collaborative Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead internal support teams, articulate a clear account strategy, and secure the internal resources needed to win.

  • The Bazaarvoice DNA: A high level of enthusiasm, coachability, and an unwavering work ethic. You are comfortable hearing "no," shaking it off, and pivoting your strategy to find the "yes."

  • Language: German language proficiency at Native or C1 minimum.

  • Right to Work: Eligibility to work in France without restrictions.


    • Desirable Criteria:

  • Industry Background: 3+ years of experience selling e-commerce, MarTech, or digital marketing technology, with established relationships up to the CMO level.

  • Brand Experience: Experience selling to large consumer brands in addition to major retailers.

  • Global Mindset: Additional European language skills are a strong plus.


    • Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Net New Revenue: Driving net new business within the Retail segment.

  • Pipeline Velocity & Accuracy: Consistently generating pipeline and moving opportunities through the funnel with speed and precise forecasting.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Successfully leveraging and orchestrating your internal support resources to maximize territory efficiency and deal sizes.

jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

  • Fast learner, flexible, organised, meticulous and detail-oriented

  • Working proficiency in a second or more European languages, e.g.: French, German, Italian, Spanish, Czech, Polish ...

Working at Novaspace will give you the opportunity to boost your career in the space/consulting industry where our role is to support the decision-makers by providing them the highest quality support in everything we do: consulting, market intelligence, training and summits.

jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

jobs.title: Odborní pracovníci v oblasti predaja poistenia
jobs.employer: KOMUNÁLNA poisťovňa, a.s. Vienna Insurance Group
jobs.description:
Máte skúsenosti s prácou s klientom alebo predajom a chcete v tom napredovať? Alebo ste ešte finančné poradenstvo neskúsili? Podporíme Vaše schopnosti a zručnosti a pomôžeme Vám zlepšiť svoj finančný rozhľad a predajné aktivity. Dáme Vám príležitosť stať sa regionálnym obchodným zástupcom. Vaše pracovné úlohy na uvedenej pracovnej pozícii budú: Aktívne vyhľadávanie klientov a následná starostlivosť o nich. Poistné poradenstvo a vypracovávanie návrhov na poistenie podľa potrieb klienta. Príprava, uzatváranie poistných zmlúv životného a neživotného poistenia v príslušnom regióne obchodného miesta. Starostlivosť o zverené klientske portfólio. Sprostredkovanie predaja vybraných bankových produktov.
Výhody:Stabilná a zaujímavá práca v najsilnejšej poisťovacej skupine na Slovensku Vienna Insurance Group. 6-mesačný program podpory nových regionálnych obchodných zástupcov s garanciou minimálneho príjmu a provízie bez obmedzenia. Systém vzdelávania, odborných školení a tréningov. Flexibilný pracovný čas. Príspevok na DDS III. pilier. Finančné odmeny pri pracovnom a životnom jubileu. Ak Vás ponuka zaujala, pošlite nám Váš štruktúrovaný životopis. Kontaktovať budeme len vybraných uchádzačov, ktorí spĺňajú požiadavky danej pozície. Všetky informácie o spracúvaní osobných údajov nájdete na https: www.kpas.sk stranka ochrana-osobnych-udajov.

Pracovný čas je flexibilný, aby vyhovoval potrebám nášho tímu a zohľadňoval vašu pohodu. Typická pracovná doba je delená a to od 7:00 hod do 12:00 hod následne 16:00 hod až 21:00 hod (závisí od vyťaženia), pričom sa prispôsobuje aktuálnej prevádzke.
Výhody:Vychutnaj si chutné a kvalitné jedlá v hotelovej reštaurácii za výhodné ceny. V prípade vzdialeného bydliska nad 30 km od hotela poskytujeme ubytovanie 1 € noc. Využívaj všetky hotelové služby – fitness, bazén, sauna, infrasauna – úplne zdarma, aj pre svojich rodinných príslušníkov. Pracuj v mladom a dynamickom kolektíve, kde sa budeš môcť ďalej rozvíjať. Uži si prácu v úspešnej reštaurácii, ktorá je známa svojou kvalitou a štýlovým prostredím. Ak máš záujem, pošli svoj životopis alebo nás kontaktuj osobne v Hoteli GOLFER , Kremnica. jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti reklamy a marketingu

Klientsky servis a poradenstvo: poskytovanie informácií o ponuke jazykových kurzov, termínoch a priebehu jazykových skúšok, cenníku a podmienkach štúdia.

Organizácia jazykových skúšok: registrácia uchádzačov na skúšky, príprava podkladov, koordinácia priebehu skúšok a vydávanie certifikátov.

Riešenie požiadaviek: prijímanie a riešenie otázok, žiadostí, reklamácií či zmien týkajúcich sa kurzov a skúšok.

jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

jobs.title: (Senior) Event & Operations Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
TechQuartier

Seit zehn Jahren ist das TechQuartier der Ort in Frankfurt, an dem durch Events, Programme und Accelerator-Initiativen die richtigen Menschen zusammenkommen. Als zentraler Innovationstreiber am Finanzplatz Frankfurt vernetzt das TechQuartier Gründer:innen von FinTech- und GreenTech-Start-ups mit etablierten Unternehmen aus zukunftsweisenden Bereichen wie KI, Quantencomputing, Finanzwesen, GreenTech und Mittelstand.
 
Seit 2017 ist das TechQuartier Teil der Digital Hub Initiative (de:hub) des Bundes und wurde 2024 offiziell als FinTech Hub Frankfurt anerkannt. TechQuartier ist zudem Veranstalter und Gastgeber des IMPACT FESTIVAL in Frankfurt – Deutschlands größte B2B-Veranstaltung für digitale & nachhaltige Transformation.
 
Das TechQuartier treibt das Start-up-Ökosystem in der Region Frankfurt Rhein-Main kontinuierlich voran und stärkt seine Rolle als zentraler Innovationsknotenpunkt in Europa.

Wenn Du Lust hast, in einem dynamischen Umfeld Verantwortung zu übernehmen, eigene Ideen einzubringen und gemeinsam mit uns Innovation voranzutreiben, bist Du bei uns genau richtig.
  
Werde ab November in Vollzeit Teil unseres Teams. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!


Warum diese Rolle echten Impact hat

Unser Coworking-Space ist ein lebendiger Ort, an dem Menschen kreativ arbeiten, sich vernetzen und durch vielfältige Events zusammenkommen. Um dieses Umfeld zu ermöglichen, braucht es eine starke organisatorische Basis.

Als (Senior) Event & Operations Manager:in übernimmst Du genau diese Verantwortung. Du sorgst dafür, dass der Space im Alltag reibungslos läuft und unsere Veranstaltungen im Coworking-Space von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung professionell organisiert sind. Dein Beitrag macht den Unterschied zwischen einem Ort, der einfach funktioniert, und einem Ort, der Membern, Gäst:innen und Eventeilnehmenden positiv in Erinnerung bleibt.


Was Du bei uns bewegst

  • Du planst, betreust und bereitest externe und interne Veranstaltungen in unserem Coworking-Space vor und nach. 
  • Du gestaltest ein positives Event-Erlebnis, indem Du Bedürfnisse erkennst und proaktiv passende Lösungen findest.
  • Du steuerst den täglichen Betrieb des Coworking-Spaces und stellst sicher, dass Abläufe und Standards zuverlässig funktionieren. 
  • Durch Deine Ideen und strategische Herangehensweise entwickelst Du den Coworking-Space und das Event Management kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Du koordinierst Aufgaben im Team und schaffst ein motivierendes und inklusives Umfeld.


Was Du mitbringst

  • Du bringst relevante Berufserfahrung und/oder einen passenden Abschluss mit, der Dich fachlich gut auf die Rolle vorbereitet. Für diese Position ist eine fundierte Expertise in den Bereichen Event Management und Office Management wichtig.
  • Du bringst eine hohe Lernbereitschaft, Hands-on-Mentalität und Lösungsorientierung mit.
  • Du überzeugst durch eine zuverlässige, strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise und behältst auch bei komplexen Aufgaben den Überblick.
  • Du bist ein Kommunikationstalent und Dir fällt es leicht, mit Stakeholdern in Kontakt zu treten und Dich auf Deutsch und Englisch sicher zu vernetzen.
  • Du hast Freude daran, Berufseinsteiger:innen und Praktikant:innen zu begleiten und zu unterstützen.

Keine Notwendigkeit, aber sicher hilfreich

  • Du hast Erfahrungen in einem Start-up- oder Coworking-Umfeld gesammelt und kennst die Dynamik agiler Arbeitskulturen.
  • Du interessierst Dich für neue Ideen, Trends und Innovationen.


Was Dich bei uns erwartet

Team-Spirit: Wir sind ein offenes, engagiertes und internationales Team, das Innovation und Entrepreneurship lebt. Um neue und kreative Lösungsansätze zu fördern, schätzen wir verschiedene Meinungen und Blickwinkel.
Innovations-Hub: Du arbeitest in einem modernen und inspirierenden Umfeld mitten im Frankfurter Start-up-Ökosystem. Im Austausch mit Start-ups lernst Du regelmäßig neue Trends und Technologien kennen, baust wertvolle Kontakte auf und bist Teil zahlreicher Events im TechQuartier.

Als technische Fachperson stellen Sie sicher, dass die gefertigten Komponenten die geforderten Produktspezifikationen hinsichtlich Härte, Festigkeit, Duktilität und Masshaltigkeit erfüllen.

Entwicklung, Validierung und Optimierung von Wärmebehandlungsprozessen wie Chargen\-, Induktions\-, Vakuum\- und Nitrierverfahren  
Sicherstellung der geforderten mechanischen Eigenschaften und Qualitätsstandards von Metallbauteilen  
Analyse und Behebung von Prozessabweichungen wie Verformungen, Rissbildungen oder Härteabweichungen  
Definition und Umsetzung von Korrektur\- und Verbesserungsmassnahmen zur Prozessstabilisierung

Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentationen, Spezifikationen und Arbeitsanweisungen  
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktion und Engineering zur Optimierung von Fertigungs\- und Wärmebehandlungsprozessen

Abgeschlossene Berufslehre und/oder ein Studium (Universität/FH) in Materialwissenschaften, Metallurgie, Werkstoffkunde oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet  
Mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung mit Wärmebehandlungsprozessen, in einer Giesserei oder einem metallurgischen Labor. Erfahrung mit verschiedenen Öfen (Vakuum\-, Atmosphären\-, Induktionsöfen) und Prüfgeräten (Mikroskope, Härteprüfer)  
Fundierte Kenntnisse der physikalischen Metallurgie (Phasenumwandlungen, TTT/CCT\-Diagramme) und die Fähigkeit, Kundenzeichnungen und \-spezifikationen zu interpretieren

Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit, schnelle Auffassungsgabe, hohe Eigeninitiative und Belastbarkeit

\- Diverse, International Environment: You will work across multiple industries, service areas, and geographies in a dynamic and stimulating professional setting.  
Your Skill Set  
Experience \& Qualifications  
3 \- 6 years of relevant professional experience in treasury consulting, treasury technology, financial risk management, or within a corporate treasury function with a strong systems and technology focus.  
University degree (Master's preferred) in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Financial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.  
Professional certification such as CFA, FRM, CTP, or equivalent qualification, demonstrating deep expertise in financial analysis, accounting, and financial risk management.  
Technical \& Domain Expertise  
Deep financial analysis and risk management skills, including a strong understanding of financial instruments, hedge accounting, valuation methodologies, interest rate and FX risk, and treasury\-related accounting standards (IFRS 9, etc.).

Familiarity with treasury processes and operations, including cash and liquidity management, bank relationship management, payments and bank connectivity (SWIFT, host\-to\-host), debt and investment management, and intercompany financing.  
Deep knowledge of the application of AI and machine learning to financial processes, including predictive analytics for cash forecasting, anomaly detection, natural language processing for financial data, robotic process automation (RPA), and the integration of intelligent solutions into treasury workflows.  
Understanding of the broader treasury technology ecosystem, including ERP integration, data architecture, API connectivity, cloud\-based solutions, and emerging fintech platforms.

Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with the ability to synthesize complex financial, operational, and technical information into clear, compelling recommendations.  
Strong presentation and communication skills, with confidence and credibility when interacting with senior client stakeholders, including C\-suite executives and treasury leadership.  
An advisory and team\-oriented mindset \- you take ownership of workstreams, mentor junior team members, foster innovative thinking, and contribute to a culture of excellence.  
Comfort working in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment, both independently and as part of cross\-functional, international teams.

About us  
Switzerland Global Enterprise (S\-GE) is the official Swiss organization for export and investment promotion. In this respect, S\-GE has acted on behalf of the Swiss Confederation and cantons since 1927 to ensure strength in the country's foreign trade and prosperity in Switzerland. As a private consulting and platform organization working on behalf of the Confederation and the cantons with around 200 employees and more than 3,000 partners worldwide, S\-GE supports its customers with their international business development in more than 130 countries each year. S\-GE has its own teams (Swiss Business Hubs, SBHs) in approximately 45 countries. The Swiss Business Hubs are integrated into the diplomatic missions of the Federal Department of Foreign Affairs (FDFA).  
For our Zurich office, we are seeking for a maternity cover to start immediately or on a mutually agreed date till April 2027:  
Digital Marketing Manager (maternity cover 80\-100%)

As a Digital Marketing Manager (maternity cover) you will lead our email marketing activities in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Insights while contributing to the strategic development of S\-GE's service portfolio. A dual role for someone who combines hands\-on digital marketing expertise with a consultative, customer\-centric mindset. You'll work at the intersection of digital marketing, customer experience and service innovation, helping shape how S\-GE engages with companies throughout their international growth journey. Plan, execute and monitor email marketing campaigns in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Insights

Service Development

Coordinate internal teams and external partners to implement service development initiatives  
Your Profile

Fluency in German (near\-native level) and excellent command of English (C1\), additional languages are a plus

S\-GE is offering a fascinating role at the interface of politics and international business in a modern working environment in the heart of Zurich. About us  
The Space Research and Planetary Sciences Division (WP) at the University of Bern has been at the forefront of space research for over 50 years. Since conducting its first experiment on the Moon as part of the Apollo 11 mission, the division has participated in numerous missions led by major space agencies such as ESA, NASA, and JAXA.  
The Space Research and Planetary Sciences Division at the University of Bern is seeking a skilled and motivated Test or Electrical Engineer to support ongoing work with the ground reference model of NIM (Neutral and Ion Mass spectrometer), part of ESA's JUICE (JUpiter ICy moons Explorer) mission. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute directly to the engineering, testing, and scientific support of one of Europe's premier planetary science missions.  
Key Responsibilities  
The successful candidate will play a central role in supporting the development, testing, and operation of NIM, including:  
Planning and conducting calibrations and tests of the instrument under various operational conditionsLeading the diagnosis, troubleshooting, and repair of hardware and system issuesCharacterizing and optimizing critical components and subsystemsParticipating in the development and validation of operation and software tools  
Helping investigate in\-flight issues and support related analysis  
Maintaining and improving technical documentation, including design and operations manuals  
Managing inventory and procurement activities for hardware  
Requirements:  
A higher education degree (ETH, Uni, FH) in engineering, physics, or a related technical field  
Experience with laboratory instrumentation and electronic diagnostics  
Proficiency in coding in and/or C\+\+ or similar  
A motivated, hands\-on, and collaborative approach to problem\-solving (team player)  
Proficient written English skills required; basic knowledge of German is desirable.  
We offer  
A dynamic and collaborative environment at one of Europe's leading space research institutes  
Involvement in a high\-profile international space mission (ESA's JUICE mission)  
Opportunities to grow technical and scientific expertise in a cutting\-edge laboratory  
Highly interdisciplinary work environment (including mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, and software engineering)  
Flexible working arrangements and support for professional development  
The position is initially for one year with the possibility of extension.  
Your Benefits  
International reputation  
Team\-oriented work  
Central location in the heart of Bern  
Strong research infrastructure and international network  
Working at the University of Bern  
The University of Bern not only offers exciting tasks but also an environment that actively promotes development, diversity, and equal opportunities. Discover what makes us stand out as an employer and how you can grow with us.

jobs.title: Growth Marketer – E-Commerce
jobs.description:
Growth Marketer – E\-Commerce  
Location: Sonnentalstrasse 21, 8600 Dübendorf  
Work model: Hybrid – 4 days in the office  
Who we are  
Pflegewegweiser, part of the Entyre Group, is one of the fastest\-growing health\-tech scale\-ups in Switzerland and the US — 500\+ employees, locations from Zurich to Boston, and a mission that truly matters: helping people live independently at home. We make sure families are compensated for caring for their loved ones, and supply them with the homecare products they rely on every day.  
Pflegewegweiser Shop is a startup within this scale\-up. We're building an e\-commerce business from the ground up. That means: no legacy accounts to inherit, no 40\-page media plans, and no waiting three quarters for your test to go live. You launch it, you own it, you read and interpret the numbers, and you act accordingly.  
What you'll own  
The paid engine. You own Google Search, Shopping, and PMax end\-to\-end — from campaigns to assets to budget. You run the Merchant Center and the shopping feed like they're yours — because they are: clean data, healthy diagnostics, well\-maintained feeds.  
Meta \& creatives. You plan, launch, and optimize our Meta campaigns. You drive the creatives that feed them — static and video — from in\-house production to briefing and directing agencies. You know a winning ad isn't luck, it's a testing pipeline.  
Funnels. You build marketing funnels across the entire customer journey and continuously optimize them — from first click to repeat purchase.  
Growth sprints. You design experiments that open up new growth opportunities beyond day\-to\-day optimization. You find the growth opportunities we haven't identified or tapped yet.  
New bets. You develop new business models together with the Head of E\-Commerce, stress\-test them, and make them better — expanding what the shop can be.  
The setup. You question existing setups and processes, iterate on them, and make them better. If something is slow, manual, or "just grew that way," you challenge it.  
The shop. You help improve the shop experience, drive e\-commerce sales, and elevate the customer experience — your insights and improvement suggestions can be implemented quickly and directly to give our customers a better experience.  
The numbers. You analyze marketing and sales KPIs to find growth opportunities and efficiencies. Your analysis doesn't just go into a report — it directly influences our spending and budget allocations.  
What you bring  
2–5 years of marketing experience, preferably at a startup, scale\-up, or agency  
Hands\-on experience with paid campaigns on Google Ads and Meta — you've set up and optimized campaigns yourself, not just watched a dashboard  
A data\-driven understanding of marketing and e\-commerce KPIs — comfortable with reporting and able to move quickly from raw data to an actionable recommendation  
Ownership from day one — you'd rather build the process than wait for one  
Comfort with ambiguity and a healthy balance between speed and quality  
German and English \- both C1\+  
Nice to have  
Experience with Google Merchant Center and shopping feeds  
Familiarity with Shopify or a comparable e\-commerce platform  
Basic creative skills (Canva, CapCut, Figma, video production) and experience briefing creative agencies  
Knowledge of A/B testing, CRO, and funnel analytics  
An affinity for healthcare/homecare — or the curiosity to dive deep  
Why this role  
0 to 1, for real. You build the growth engine instead of waiting for someone else to.  
Direct line to leadership. You report to the Senior Growth Manager and work closely with the Chief Business Development Officer. Short paths, fast decisions, no bureaucracy. You learn fast, get direct feedback, and quickly gain ownership of your own topics and areas of responsibility.  
Impact you can see. Small, independent team; your tests land in the business immediately.  
Scale at your back. The pace and autonomy of a startup, backed by the resources of an international group — in one of the biggest growth markets there is: homecare and digital health.  
How we operate — non\-negotiable:  
"Insanely great" for families — delivered now  
Forget mere "satisfaction." We deliver support that makes caregivers feel seen, understood, and valued. Anticipate their needs and solve problems quickly. The standard is "insanely great," period. Anything less slows us down and fails our families.  
Speed is king — ruthless focus is key  
Velocity comes from focus. Eliminate distractions. Concentrate all effort on the \#1 critical objective until it's done, then move to the next. Decide what not to do and cut it ruthlessly. Being a mile wide and an inch deep is failure — move the needle now.  
Raise the bar — crush mediocrity  
Mediocrity kills speed, morale, and companies. Hunt it down and eliminate it. Good enough is never good enough. Demand top performance from yourself and everyone around you. Own your work, deliver excellence fast, and accept no excuses.  
The speed algorithm — question, delete, simplify, accelerate  
Build momentum by questioning every requirement: who asked, and why? Delete ruthlessly — parts, processes, bureaucracy. Simplify what remains. Accelerate cycle times relentlessly. "It can't be done" means "you haven't figured it out yet — go do it." Break bottlenecks, find shortcuts, remove friction.  
Act like owners — bold bets, fast action  
This is your company. Own the mission and the results. Take initiative, make bold bets that leapfrog progress, and act decisively. If you stumble, learn faster and go again. Bias for action is everything.  
The bottom line:  
We are building something vital at lightning speed. This requires intensity, focus, and a relentless drive to execute. If reading this makes you want to jump in and build faster, welcome to Pflegewegweiser!

1–2 Jahre Marketing\-Erfahrung, bevorzugt in Start\-ups, Scale\-ups oder Agentur  
Hands\-on\-Erfahrung mit Paid\-Kampagnen auf Google Ads und Meta – du hast selbst Kampagnen aufgesetzt und optimiert, nicht nur ein Dashboard beobachtet

Ownership ab Tag eins – du baust lieber den Prozess, als auf einen zu warten

C1\+ Deutsch und Englisch

Kenntnisse in A/B\-Testing, CRO und Funnel\-Analytik  
Eine Affinität zu Healthcare/Homecare – oder die Neugier, tief einzutauchen
