jobs.title: Medizinische Praxisassistentin / Medizinischer Praxisassistent 40-60%
jobs.description:
Das Luzerner Kantonsspital mit den Standorten Luzern, Sursee und Wolhusen ist ein Unternehmen der LUKS Gruppe und gehört damit einer der führenden Spitalgruppen der Schweiz an. Die über 8500 Mitarbeitenden sind mit Herzlichkeit, Kompetenz und Engagement rund um die Uhr für das Wohl der Patientinnen und Patienten da. Die Kliniken und Institute der LUKS Gruppe bieten medizinische Leistungen von höchster Qualität. Für unser Team suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung Verstärkung.  
Ihr Wirkungsfeld  
In dieser Position sind Sie verantwortlich für das Aufnahmeverfahren elektiver Patientinnen und Patienten am Schalter der chirurgischen Tagesklinik sowie in der Holding Area der Frauenklinik  
Sie koordinieren und organisieren die Patienteneintritte, übernehmen administrative Aufgaben und stellen eine effiziente Planung sowie Korrespondenz im EPIC\-Betriebssystem sicher  
Sie priorisieren Ihre Aufgaben eigenständig, reagieren flexibel auf unvorhergesehene Situationen und tragen aktiv zur Optimierung von Arbeit  
Mit Ihrer ausgeprägten Kundenorientierung und Ihrem hohen Anspruch an Servicequalität unterstützen Sie bei Bedarf auch andere Organisationseinheiten innerhalb der Tagesklinik Chirurgie und übernehmen kompetenzgerecht logistische, administrative sowie hauswirtschaftliche Aufgaben  
Ihre Erfahrung  
Für diese Position setzen wir eine abgeschlossene medizinische Ausbildung sowie Berufserfahrung im medizinischen Umfeld voraus  
Sie sind mit der medizinischen Terminologie und den Abläufen in einem Spital vertraut und verfügen über gute PC\-Kenntnisse; Erfahrungen mit dem EPIC\-System sind von Vorteil  
Mit Ihrem ausgeprägten Organisationstalent, Ihrer hohen Eigenverantwortung und Ihrem Qualitätsbewusstsein leisten Sie einen wesentlichen Beitrag zu einem reibungslosen Ablauf in beiden Tageskliniken  
Zudem zeichnen Sie sich durch eine belastbare, flexible und kommunikative Persönlichkeit aus und behalten auch in herausfordernden Situationen den Überblick sowie die nötige Ruhe  
Ihre Perspektiven  
Wir bieten Ihnen eine herausfordernde Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen Umfeld, wo Ihre Fachkompetenz geschätzt wird und Sie sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln können  
Sie sind Teil vom dynamischen, engagierten und interprofessionellen Team der Tagesklinik und können Ihre eigene Persönlichkeit authentisch mit einbringen  
Wir fördern Ihre fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung durch gezielte Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und bieten Ihnen die Möglichkeit, aktiv an der Gestaltung Ihres beruflichen Werdegangs mitzuwirken  
Sie profitieren von geregelten Arbeitszeiten (keine Wochenendarbeit), sehr guten Sozialleistungen und Anstellungsbedingungen. Sie finden diese und weitere Informationen unter folgendem Link:  
Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständige online Bewerbung. Bei Fragen wenden Sie sich bitte an Sabina , Abteilungsleiterin Tagesklinik, Tel.: Renate , Teamleitung Tagesklinik, Tel.: .

jobs.title: Poêlier - Fumiste
jobs.description:
Poêlier-fumiste qualifié et autonome

Pour l’un de nos clients, nous recherchons un poêlier-fumiste qualifié, expérimenté et autonome pour intervenir sur des chantiers de construction, de rénovation ou chez des particuliers.

Vos missions :
Installer et monter des poêles, cheminées, foyers, conduits de fumée et systèmes d’évacuation selon les plans et les normes en vigueur.
Préparer le chantier, effectuer les prises de mesures et adapter les installations aux contraintes techniques du bâtiment.
Réaliser les raccordements, les habillages et les finitions avec soin.
Assurer les travaux de montage et les adaptations de maçonnerie, peinture, ferblanterie/couverture liées à l’installation.
Contrôler la conformité, l’étanchéité et le bon fonctionnement des installations.
Intervenir sur des travaux neufs, de rénovation, de transformation ou de remise en état.
Veiller au respect des normes techniques, des règles de sécurité et des prescriptions de protection incendie.

Votre profil :
Vous êtes qualifié ou expérimenté, capable de travailler de manière autonome.
Vous maîtrisez l’installation de poêles, cheminées et conduits de fumée.
Vous êtes précis, soigneux et attaché à la qualité du travail réalisé.
Vous savez lire les plans, prendre des mesures et vous adapter aux contraintes du chantier.
Vous êtes fiable, polyvalent et appréciez le travail bien fait.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Our Consulting business offers a broad range of functional and cross\-country services dedicated to providing high\-value and trusted advice to clients, with a specific focus on business transformation programs.

You will gain insights into cutting\-edge IT environments and into our global methodology. Your focus: analysis, evaluation and optimization of processes, structures and systems

We are a world leading Engine MRO service provider, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, with over 90 years of operational experience. Our unwavering dedication to innovation, excellence and environmental responsibility propels us forward on our journey to becoming the leading, most customer-centric, and sustainable Engine focused MRO worldwide.

Working with an extensive network of partners and business development offices in Europe, the USA, Asia and the Middle East, we offer comprehensive, fully customized solutions for the Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul of aircraft engines, airframes and components sales business including impeccable technical support to over 500 customers worldwide. Our mission: We safely power your flight.

We are looking for dedicated and skilled individuals to join our shop floor across several areas and departments at Zurich-Airport. If this sounds appealing to you, we encourage you to apply for our Supervisor position.

- Proficient in English (B2+), German is an advantage

jobs.title: Barista/Employée de buffet
jobs.description:
Mission:
Assurer la préparation des boissons et le bon fonctionnement du buffet en garantissant un service rapide, soigné et de qualité. Veiller à la propreté des équipements, à la gestion de la vaisselle et au réapprovisionnement afin de soutenir efficacement le service en salle.

Responsabilités principales

Préparation des boissons
• Préparer les cafés, expressos, cappuccinos, latte macchiatos et autres spécialités selon les recettes de l’établissement.
• Préparer les thés, chocolats chauds, boissons froides, smoothies et autres boissons de la carte.
• Assurer une présentation soignée et constante des boissons servies.
• Contrôler la qualité des préparations avant leur remise au personnel de service.

Gestion du buffet
• Organiser et maintenir un buffet propre, fonctionnel et bien approvisionné.
• Réapprovisionner les produits, le lait, les sirops, les tasses, les verres et les consommables.
• Contrôler les stocks et signaler les besoins de commande.

Vaisselle
• Assurer le lavage et le rangement de la vaisselle, des verres, des couverts et du matériel de préparation.
• Maintenir les machines et les espaces de plonge propres et opérationnels.
• Respecter les procédures d’hygiène et de désinfection.

Entretien et hygiène
• Nettoyer quotidiennement les machines à café, moulins et équipements.
• Respecter les normes d’hygiène alimentaire (HACCP).
• Maintenir un poste de travail propre, organisé et sécurisé.

Collaboration
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les employés de service et la vente.
• Participer à l’ouverture et à la fermeture du buffet.
• Soutenir les équipes lors des périodes de forte affluence.

Horaires soit ouverture (environ 7h00-17h000 avec 1h15 pause midi) soit fermeture (environ 8h00-18h30, 1h15 pause midi)
2 jours de congés
5 semaines de vacances

jobs.title: Senior PLC Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Creating impact together at !  
Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.  
aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.  
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start\-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.  
Senior PLC Software Development Engineer  
Join 's Business Area Value Nutrition and help shape the next generation of automation and software solutions for advanced machine control systems. In this role within R\&D, you will combine PLC programming, modern software development, and interdisciplinary collaboration to develop reliable, efficient, and high\-performing solutions that support our customers in achieving outstanding process and product quality.  
This is where you'll excel  
You develop and implement PLC software for machine control systems, primarily using Siemens automation platforms; Rockwell knowledge is an advantage  
You design, implement, and maintain visualization software, including C\# backend services and Angular\-based frontend applications  
You analyze technical requirements and translate them into robust automation and software solutions aligned with engineering standards and best practices  
You collaborate closely with electrical, mechanical, process, and project teams, including close cooperation with our development team in China  
You support machine commissioning, troubleshooting, optimization, and 3rd\-level support for machine control systems and related services, both remotely and on\-site when required  
These are the skills you'll need  
Degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a comparable technical field, ideally from a University of Applied Sciences or ETH  
Several years of experience in industrial automation, with solid knowledge of PLC programming, machine control software, relevant automation standards, C\# backend development, and ideally Angular, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS frontend development  
Good understanding of software engineering principles, including modular design, testing, version control, and documentation, combined with analytical thinking, strong problem\-solving skills and deployment strategies as well as willingness to learn data science, data analytics, and machine learning methods for industrial applications  
Strong communication and collaboration skills in interdisciplinary teams, along with very good English and good German skills  
Willingness to travel up to 10% per year  
Questions? We are happy to answer them!

Our Human Health Division maintains a “patient first, profits later” ideology. The organization is comprised of sales, marketing, market access, digital analytics and commercial professionals who are passionate about their role in bringing our medicines to our customers worldwide.
We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Account Manager to manage our existing Pulmonary Hypertension (PH) business and lead the launch of an exciting new product across the Swiss German part of Switzerland. This role requires strong expertise in pharmaceutical sales, strategic planning and relationship-building with key healthcare professionals. The Account Manager will also work closely with marketing to create and implement impactful materials, projects and campaigns. While experience in Pulmonary Hypertension and rare diseases is a plus, we welcome candidates with a strong background in pharmaceutical sales who are excited about launching a new product in a very specialized market.
Responsibilities:
•    Manage performance of Pulmonary Hypertension (PH) portfolio, lead the successful launch of a new Pulmonary arterial Hypertension (PAH) product, including market analysis, stakeholder engagement, implementation of launch strategy and monitor territory performance versus targets.
•    Build and maintain long-term partnerships with customers (Scientific Leaders, Specialists and specialized Nurses), through individual sales visits, promotional lectures and participation in congresses and educational events.
•    Ensure tailored account management for your assigned territory by understanding and mapping your customers, identifying Drivers and Barriers, understanding the patient journey and influencers on treatment decisions per account.
•    Engage in balanced product sales discussions including scientific data with Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) to align the customer and business needs.
•    Stay up-to date on the latest product and therapeutic area information by attending internal trainings, conferences and symposia, as well as by self-study.
•    Drive tailored customer engagements, by using data and analytics to better understand the customer’s preference and by properly balancing physical and digital engagements.
•    Organize and co-create educational events for HCP’s including sponsorships in line with strategic priorities and budget constraints.
•    Demonstrating highest ethical principles conducting Local law, our company’s Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and regulations.


Your Profile:

•    3-5 years of pharmaceutical or biotech sales experience, ideally in specialty care. Experience in Pulmonary Hypertension, Intestinal Lung Disease or Rare Diseases is a strong plus.
•    Degree in Life Sciences, medical/paramedical field or another relevant discipline with healthcare curriculum from an accredited institution. shqa Certification «Certified Pharma Sales Representative» is a strong plus.
•    Proven experience in managing an existing product portfolio and successfully launching a new product.
•    Strong track record of achieving sales targets and supporting marketing efforts in a complex medical environment.
•    Excellent communication, relationship-building and presentation skills.
•    Ability to manage multiple priorities, with strong organizational and strategic planning skills.
•    Experience collaborating with marketing teams to create and implement marketing materials, campaigns and projects.
•    Open to innovation and experimentation.
•    Fluent in German and additionally English.
•    Valid driver’s license.

Interpersonal capabilities:

•    Growth-mindset, strong team-player, results-oriented and proven ability to achieve ambitious goals.
•    Adaptable to change, ambiguity and a high level of resilience in the face of challenges.
•    Independent, motivated and highly organized.
•    Excellent interpersonal skills in communication, persuasion and customer relations.
•    Possessing a strong learning mindset.
•    Identification of challenges or obstacles and proactively ideate on solutions.
•    Data-driven decision-making and mindset.
•    Comfortable with commercial experimentation and implementing customer projects.

Additional information needed for the advert:
Relocation: None
Visa Sponsorship: None
Travel Requirements: 75%
Flexible Working Arrangements: No onsite
Shift: No
Valid Driver License: Yes
Hazardous Materials: No

THE COMPANY

Our Company is a leading biopharmaceutical company employing over 1,000 people in Switzerland at three sites. The company’s headquarters are in Lucerne. At the site in Zurich, the company operates a global innovation and development hub. In addition, we manufacture medicines for global clinical trials and operate a forensic laboratory in Schachen (Canton Lucerne). We conduct around 40 clinical trials annually in Switzerland. The main therapeutic areas include oncology, infectious diseases, cardiovascular and cardiometabolic diseases. We also have a broad portfolio of vaccines for the prevention of diseases in children, adolescents, and adults and we are one of the leading companies in veterinary medicine. Furthermore, we take our responsibility to the local community seriously and have been involved for many years in initiatives such as the «Trendtage Gesundheit Luzern» and the «Alliance Health Competence».  

We are proud to be certified as a “Top Employer Switzerland” and “Top Employer Europe” showing the company’s commitment to our employees and the community around us.

One Roof is our new Swiss headquarters in Lucerne designed to bring teams together and make collaboration easier. Across 15,000 m² of modern office space, we unite colleagues from national, regional and global functions within different functions under one roof to strengthen cross functional cooperation and a ONE Team culture. The site is centrally located, a short walk from Lucerne train station, supporting sustainable commuting.

jobs.title: Expert Clinical Trial Documentation - Clinical Trial Associate
jobs.description:
Expert Clinical Trial Documentation \- Clinical Trial Associate (CTA)  
Become part of a vital chain and contribute to our common goal of making people’s lives better. Headquartered in Lachen, Switzerland, Octapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing medicines sourced from human plasma and human cell lines. We are a privately\-owned company, where the warmth of family meets the scale of a global organisation.  
Join us in shaping our vision to provide new health solutions advancing human life.  
Expert Clinical Trial Documentation \- Clinical Trial Associate (CTA)  
Your main tasks and responsibilities  
Set up and maintain Trial Master Files (TMFs) and lnvestigator Site Files (ISFs) according to Octapharma SOPs  
Support the Clinical Team in preparing clinical trial documents and documentation for regulatory submissions  
Track clinical trial documents such as insurance certificates, confidentiality agreements and study contracts throughout the trial lifecycle  
Maintain audit and inspection readiness through periodic review of TMF accuracy and completeness, quality control checks, and a unified TMF management approach. Support audits and inspection preparation and execution with regards to the TMF  
Act as a central contact for trial documentation, designated project communications, support ad hoc tasks  
Manage returning/archiving of TMF documents  
Assist in the organization of lnvestigator Meetings  
Perform various administrative tasks to support team members with clinical trial execution, as required (e.g. literature search or document formatting review for regulatory submissions)  
In addition, for the senior position:  
Assume Data Protection / Information Security Champion responsibilities  
Assists in development of SOPs  
Perform vendor evaluation and oversight for selected vendors  
Your expertise and ideal skill set  
A minimum of 1 year of experience as a CTA/documentation expert in international clinical trials or similar (3 years for the senior position)  
Fluent in both written and spoken English; preferably also in German  
Experience with various CTMS and TMF systems  
Excellent command of Microsoft Office applications and Adobe Acrobat DC  
Able to prioritize workload with attention to details and within timelines  
Able to learn on the job and apply new knowledge to future challenges  
Able to manage multiple and various tasks with a positive and flexible attitude  
Strong operational, organizational, documentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, able to work in a team and independently  
Your department \- where you make an impact  
The Clinical Research and Development (CR\&D) team in Lachen develops medicines that target complex and life\-threatening conditions in Haematology and Critical Care  
We specialize in clinical development of new as well as already marketed products  
The successful candidate will work closely with CPMs, CTMs, and colleagues across CR\&D in Lachen to support a wide variety of clinical trials  
This position reports to the Global Senior Director CR\&D in Lachen and is a permanent role within the team.  
“Join an international environment with exciting projects and responsibilities — be proactive, contribute, and grow together with a great team”  
\- Dr. Cristina Solomon, Global Vice President CRD Lachen  
Thrive with us  
You help save lives \- Every day is meaningful as we produce life\-saving medicines  
Family values \- Long\-term perspective for employees and relationships  
Be rewarded with market\-related salary and benefits package  
You will have a high level of influence where you can make a difference and leave your footprint  
Work with skilled and fun colleagues in a relatively informal organization  
Skills development \- We offer various internal and external employee and leadership trainings, trainee programs and digital solutions  
It´s in our blood  
We live diversity and stand for equal opportunities as an employer! We therefore look forward to receiving your application \- regardless of age, gender, origin, sexual orientation, and religion.  
Please apply in English.  
Do you have any questions? Then get in touch with your contact person.  
Vignau  
Senior Expert Talent \& Acquisition  
Octapharma AG  
Seidenstrasse 2, 8853 Lachen  
T:  
Want to find out more about us?  
Visit our website Octapharma Career and follow us daily on LinkedIn.  
About Octapharma  
Octapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing human proteins from human plasma and human cell lines. We employ more than 11,000 people worldwide to support the treatment of patients in 120 countries with products across three therapeutic areas: Immunotherapy, Haematology and Critical Care. With seven R\&D sites and five state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facilities in Austria, France, Germany, and Sweden, Octapharma also operates over 195 plasma donation centres across Europe and the US. With four decades of experience, we are committed to advancing patient care worldwide. jpid5481217jm jit0833jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: AI Product Engineer
jobs.description:
AI Product Engineer  
Neho is one of Switzerland's leading real estate brokerage companies, redefining the industry through innovation. We combine human expertise with powerful digital solutions to deliver a faster, more transparent, and more efficient real estate experience. Our approach has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the SEF Award 2023\. What truly sets us apart is our fixed\-price model, offering clients a modern alternative to traditional commission\-based services, powered by advanced technology.  
We are looking for an AI product engineer to lead, hands\-on, how we put AI to work. You will build the agents that take the manual, repetitive parts of buying, financing and selling a home off people's plates, so our experts can spend their time on the moments that .  
You will not start from zero. We have a compelling vision and working prototypes. Your job is to take this pattern from prototype to product: real agents, real users, measured outcomes. You will get a first agent into production within your first months and grow a pipeline from there.  
This is a zero\-to\-one role with real ownership and visibility reporting directly to our CTO. If you love turning a manual process into working software that ships in weeks rather than quarters, you will feel at home here.  
Workload: 80 \- 100%  
Your Tasks  
Find the value: Spend real time with product managers, advisors, real estate agents and operations specialists, map their workflows, identify the agent use cases that remove the most measurable toil across the client journey or internal operations \- prioritise by outcome  
Build the agents, hands\-on: Design, build, test and ship agents yourself: use agent frameworks \& platforms where they are faster, real code where they are not  
Own the delivery surfaces: Take our prototypes to product, and evolve how agents reach users: in\-product, in chat, and later on mobile  
Build the MCP layer: Wrap the stable domain APIs in thin, well\-designed MCP tools your agents act through. You are the first and most demanding consumer of our API\-first architecture.  
Drive the requirements to the teams: Specify the APIs your agents and surfaces need from the domain\-owning engineering teams, who build and expose them; you consume clean contracts rather than reaching into systems directly  
Choose the platform with Platform: Lead the selection of the technology \& platforms jointly with the Platform team, accounting for security, Swiss/EU data protection, cost and operability  
Ship on rails, within the guardrails: Deploy on the company's fenced, containerised, API\-only path; instrument and evaluate your agents; respect data\-sensitivity tiers  
Hand off when an agent grows up: When an agent becomes revenue\-critical or touches critical client or financial data, hand it to Engineering for hardening and long\-term ownership, and keep building the next one  
Measure outcomes: Track effort removed, cycle\-time and conversion impact, and adoption by the people the agents serve. Not the number of agents shipped  
What this role is not  
Not the builder of core APIs: Domain engineering teams own and expose the stable APIs; you drive the requirements, build the thin MCP wrappers on top, and consume the contracts  
Not the platform/infra owner: Platform owns runtime, deployment, observability and security; you build on top  
Not an AI services desk: You are not here to build bespoke tools for every department; you build the agents that move our priorities, and help others self\-serve safely on the sanctioned path  
What we offer  
End\-to\-end ownership of your product with the authority to drive implementation, challenge the status quo, and own the outcome from conception to launch of new features  
A unique career opportunity to join a fast\-growing and award\-winning scale\-up within the real estate industry  
Shape the future of real estate tech in Switzerland: Have a direct impact on Neho's growth, and deliver efficient, and scalable AI tools that give Neho a competitive edge  
Enjoy flat hierarchies, quick decision\-making processes, and the freedom to work autonomously and leave your  
Be part of an energetic, forward\-thinking team spanning our offices in Lausanne and Zurich as well as our remote engineering team in Romania  
Thrive in an entrepreneurial, innovative culture that values transparency, fairness, and strong team support  
Competitive benefits including 5 weeks of vacation \+ extra days based on tenure, fully paid maternity/paternity leave, remote work options, regular team events, and more!  
What you bring  
Fluent in the AI stack: You've worked with the modern AI stack in some form (direct model APIs, agent frameworks like LangGraph/CrewAI/Google ADK, orchestration platforms like Dify/n8n). We care about what you shipped, not which tool you used.  
A developer at heart: You have a software engineering background and have been writing and owning production code for years. Which specific language doesn't to us.  
Comfortable across the stack: Whether that's PHP, TypeScript/JavaScript, or , you're comfortable building applications, APIs and random other things like browser extensions or even mobile apps.  
Pragmatic about tools: You reach for agent platforms and AI tooling where they're faster, and write real code where they're not. Comfortable with MCP, webhooks, prompting and streaming UIs.  
Disciplined about evaluation: You have shipped LLM\-based systems to real users: you write evals, design quadrails, think in failure modes, and know when an agent must refuse to answer. In a regulated, document\-heavy domain this is the core skill, not a nice extra  
A discovery person: You are comfortable sitting next to an advisor for an afternoon, mapping a messy human workflow, and earning the trust of the people whose toil you are removing  
Product\-minded: You prioritise by outcome, validate before building, and are willing to kill an agent that does not move a metric  
Fast and pragmatic: You can get a first useful agent into production in weeks and iterate.  
Safety\-aware: You respect data sensitivity (client, financial, identity) and work within guardrails rather than around them  
Language: Strong communication skills in English, French or German is considered a plus  
Nice To Have  
Experience with real estate, mortgages, fintech or another regulated, document\-heavy domain  
Familiarity with Swiss/EU data\-protection expectations  
Mobile development experience (for the later delivery surfaces)  
What success looks like as an AI Product Engineer at Neho  
Month 3: first agent live in production, with measured effort removed.  
Month 6: a handful of agents in production across the journey and internal ops, delivered through a central delivery system and used daily by agents, ops or advisors; the platform choice settled with the Platform team; a clear, prioritised backlog.  
Month 12: agents are a normal, trusted way we remove toil; the hand\-off path to Engineering is working; the case is made for a small agent pod if volume warrants it.  
If this sounds like the right professional opportunity for you, then apply now with your CV in English.  
Please note that we are only considering applications submitted through our career page: / jpid57e2a0fjm jit0833jm jiy26jm

Conducteur de Travaux \- Rénovation \& Transformation  
Conducteur de Travaux \- Rénovation \& Transformation  
Description de l'entreprise  
Notre client est un acteur établi du secteur de la construction en Suisse romande. Grâce à son expertise technique, à ses équipes expérimentées et à sa capacité à mener des projets complexes, l'entreprise intervient sur des chantiers variés de rénovation, de transformation et de réhabilitation de bâtiments. Elle propose un environnement dynamique, axé sur la qualité, la sécurité et l'efficacité opérationnelle, au sein duquel chaque collaborateur bénéficie d'un réel niveau d'autonomie et de responsabilités.  
Description du poste  
Dans le cadre de vos fonctions, vous serez responsable de la préparation, de l'organisation et du suivi complet de vos chantiers de rénovation et de transformation, de la phase de préparation jusqu'à leur réalisation finale.  
Préparer les chantiers sur les plans technique, organisationnel et financier.  
Analyser les plans, les dossiers d'exécution et les spécificités liées aux bâtiments existants.  
Planifier les différentes étapes des travaux, notamment les besoins en personnel, en matériel et en équipements.  
Organiser le déroulement quotidien des chantiers et assurer leur exécution opérationnelle.  
Coordonner les équipes, les sous\-traitants et les différents corps de métier.  
Assurer la commande, l'approvisionnement et la disponibilité des matériaux nécessaires.  
Anticiper les éventuelles contraintes liées à l'occupation, à l'exploitation ou à la structure des bâtiments existants.  
Mettre en place et suivre les procédures liées à la qualité, à la sécurité et à l'environnement.  
Contrôler l'avancement des travaux ainsi que le respect des délais, des coûts et des exigences techniques.  
Assurer le suivi financier des chantiers.  
Élaborer les offres, les offres complémentaires et les métrés des travaux réalisés.  
Participer à la facturation et au contrôle des prestations exécutées.  
Participer aux séances de chantier et assurer le suivi des décisions prises.  
Entretenir une relation professionnelle de qualité avec les maîtres d'ouvrage, les directions de travaux, les mandataires et les partenaires du projet.  
Profil recherché  
Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation reconnue de conducteur(trice) de travaux.  
Vous justifiez d'au moins cinq ans d'expérience confirmée dans la conduite de chantiers en Suisse.  
Vous disposez d'une expérience concrète dans le domaine de la rénovation et de la transformation.  
Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques usuels ainsi que le logiciel BauBit.  
Vous êtes à l'aise dans le suivi technique, administratif et financier des chantiers.  
Vous êtes une personne proactive, autonome, organisée et dotée d'un bon sens des responsabilités.  
Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et savez communiquer efficacement avec les différents intervenants d'un chantier.  
Vous êtes capable de gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement exigeant et en constante évolution.

In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie eine auf 10 Monate befristete Mutterschaftsvertretung, idealerweise mit Start per 1\. November, und verantworten die selbständige Durchführung der Lohnverarbeitung für über 1'000 Mitarbeitende. Sie stellen eine korrekte, gesetzeskonforme und termingerechte Payroll über den gesamten Employee Lifecycle sicher und fungieren als Subject Expert für Payroll, Time \& Absence, Sozialversicherungen und Steuern. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Mitarbeitenden, Führungskräften, HR, Finance und externen Stellen beraten Sie zu payrollrelevanten Themen, treiben Prozessverbesserungen voran und stellen die erfolgreiche Durchführung von Audits sowie die Einhaltung aller regulatorischen Anforderungen sicher. Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung sowie eine umfassende Übergabe durch die aktuelle Stelleninhaberin gewährleisten einen reibungslosen Einstieg in die Funktion.  
Ihre Aufgaben:  
Selbständige Durchführung der monatlichen Lohnverarbeitung für über 1'000 Mitarbeitende in der Schweiz.  
Sicherstellung einer korrekten und termingerechten Lohnverarbeitung inklusive Payroll Accounting, Lohnausweisen und Jahresendverarbeitung.  
Pflege und Validierung lohnrelevanter Personal\-, Organisations\- und Vergütungsdaten zur Gewährleistung einer korrekten und gesetzeskonformen Lohnverarbeitung über den gesamten Employee Lifecycle.  
Betreuung und Durchführung payrollrelevanter Prozesse in Workday, SAP und weiteren angebundenen HR\-Systemen.  
Übernahme der Rolle als Subject Expert für Swiss Payroll, Time \& Absence, Sozialversicherungen und Steuern sowie Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorgaben und Best Practices.  
Hauptansprechpartner/in für externe Stakeholder (bspw. Sozialversicherungen)  
Bearbeitung und Koordination payrollrelevanter Anfragen und Tickets von Mitarbeitenden, Führungskräften und HR Business Partnern.  
Verarbeitung und Abstimmung von Payroll\-Daten, Erstellung von Payroll\-Auswertungen und Analysen sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit Finance bei Kontenabstimmungen sowie HR\-relevanten Rückstellungen.

Hohe Genauigkeit sowie ein ausgeprägtes Qualitäts\- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein.  
Fähigkeit, Optimierungspotenziale zu erkennen, Verbesserungsinitiativen voranzutreiben und nachhaltige Lösungen pragmatisch umzusetzen.  
Dienstleistungsorientierte, proaktive und selbständige Arbeitsweise.

Kantine.

modene Büroräumlichkeiten, smart working.  
flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle und Arbeitsorte.  
Home\-Office\-Möglichkeiten.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
In this role, you will join Accelleron on a 10\-month maternity leave cover assignment, ideally starting on November 1, and independently manage Swiss payroll operations for more than 1,000 employees. You will ensure accurate, compliant and timely payroll processing throughout the employee lifecycle while acting as the subject expert for payroll, time \& absence, social security and tax matters. In close collaboration with employees, managers, HR, Finance and external institutions, you will provide expert guidance, drive continuous process improvements and ensure successful payroll audits and regulatory compliance. A structured onboarding and comprehensive handover from the current role holder will be provided to ensure a smooth transition into the role.  
Your Responsibilities:  
Independently execute the monthly payroll process for a workforce of over 1,000 employees in Switzerland.  
Ensure accurate and timely salary payments, payroll accounting, salary statements and year\-end activities.  
Maintain and validate payroll\-relevant employee, organizational and compensation data to ensure accurate and compliant payroll processing throughout the employee lifecycle.  
Manage payroll\-related activities within Workday, SAP and connected HR systems.  
Act as the Subject Expert for Swiss Payroll, Time \& Absence, Social Security and Tax matters, providing expert guidance and ensuring regulatory compliance and best\-practice application.

jobs.description:
Executive Assistant \& Private PA to the Chairman \& CEO  
About the Company  
A privately owned investment holding based in Zurich. Through its operating companies, it develops strategic resources at origin, alongside proprietary investments in emerging technologies.  
The Zurich team is small and senior, with short decision paths — this role has direct visibility and impact.  
We are looking for an organized, responsible, and proactive assistant who combines classic executive assistance to our Chairman \& CEO with corporate and office support for the Zurich team — and, distinctively, with private and family support for the principal. Track statutory and filing deadlines  
Liaise with external providers (fiduciary, insurance broker, external counsel, banks) on administrative matters

Coordinate children's school administration and communications, extracurricular activities, and related logistics — largely in German  
Plan and book private and family travel and holidays  
Handle household administration: insurance policies, vehicle matters (registration, servicing, appointments), property\-related paperwork, and coordination of contractors and service providers  
Manage personal errands, purchases, gifting, and restaurant and event reservations  
Serve as a reliable point of coordination between the office, the household, and the family  
Office Management \& Cross\-Jurisdictional Coordination  
Support day\-to\-day operations of the Zurich office (supplies, facilities, visitors, mail)  
Assist with administrative coordination across the group's international entities  
Candidate Profile  
Required  
Experience as a Personal/Executive Assistant, Private PA, or in a comparable role supporting senior leadership, a principal, or a family  
Fluent English and German (written and spoken) — German is essential for schools, medical providers, and Swiss administration  
Experience organizing complex international travel  
High discretion; able to handle confidential legal, HR, financial, family, and household information responsibly

Additional languages (e.g., French)

This is an on\-site role based in central Zurich during normal office hours. Given the private\-support dimension, occasional flexibility outside standard hours is expected for time\-sensitive personal or travel matters; this is managed reasonably and reciprocated with flexibility in return.  
What We Offer  
Direct, daily exposure to the Chairman/CEO, the COO, and board\-level operations in an entrepreneurial, international holding group  
A genuinely varied role combining classic PA/EA work, corporate operations exposure, and private/family support  
A position of real trust with meaningful autonomy and short decision paths  
A small, senior, non\-bureaucratic team  
Central Zurich office location  
Competitive compensation, commensurate with the breadth and seniority of the role

Please submit your CV and a short cover note via this platform. The employer is not named at this stage for reasons of strategic confidentiality. Full company details will be disclosed to shortlisted candidates before the interview process.

Stay current with the global HF regulatory landscape and contribute to shaping Ypsomed’s position in collaboration with industry bodies and consortium representatives  
Your profile  
A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Factors, Ergonomics, Usability Engineering, Product Design, Psychology, or a related field, combined with at least 7 years of professional experience as a Human Factors consultant, including experience within the combination product or related medical device industry

Du bist begeistert von moderner IT, Cloud\-Technologien und digitalen Arbeitsplatzlösungen? Dann bist du bei Brack Alltron genau richtig! In dieser Rolle bist du die Brücke zwischen Kunden, Trends und Technologie.

So begleitest du unsere Geschäftskunden auf ihrem Weg in die digitale Zukunft und unterstützt sie bei der Auswahl und Einführung passender Modern\-Work\-Lösungen, Cloud\-Services und Lizenzmodelle.  
Specialized Sales Modern Work \& Cloud  
Das erwartet dich  
Unterstützung unserer Key Account Manager in Verkaufsgesprächen und Übernahme einer zentralen Rolle in der strategischen und fachlichen Kundenberatung rund um die Brack Business Cloud Service Plattform  
Gewährleistung einer kompetenten, lösungsorientierten und nachhaltigen Beratung im Bereich Modern Work \& Cloud, sowohl remote als auch beim Kunden vor Ort  
Analyse von Kundenanforderungen, Evaluation möglicher Lösungsansätze und Ableitung fundierter Empfehlungen für die Umsetzung  
Erarbeitung passender Angebote, Begleitung des Verkaufsprozesses bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss und Mitverantwortung für Umsatz, Conversion Rate sowie die technische Umsetzung der Projekte  
Pflege enger Beziehungen zu unseren Partnern im speziellen zu Pax8, frühzeitige Erkennung von Markttrends und Ableitung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten  
Sicherstellung der Datenqualität in unseren CRM\- und ERP\-Systemen und eigenständige Pflege deiner Projekte  
Aktives Einbringen deines Wissens in Kundenmarketingaktionen, Partnertrainings, Kundenevents und internen Schulungen  
Durch regelmässige Weiterbildung und relevante Zertifizierungen stets auf dem neuesten Stand der Technologie bleiben  
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Produkt Management und Marketing, sowie weiteren internen Teams und Beitrag mit deinem Know\-how zur Weiterentwicklung des Bereichs  
Das bringst du mit  
Kaufmännische oder technische Grundausbildung mit Weiterbildung in Verkauf, Marketing oder ICT (idealerweise höhere Fachschule oder vergleichbare Qualifikation)  
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Account Management im Umfeld von ICT\-Cloud Lösungen, im Verkauf und / oder in der Beratung/Consulting als Specialized Sales  
Du überzeugst durch ausgeprägte Beratungskompetenz, Verhandlungsgeschick und Abschlusssicherheit sowie durch fundierte Erfahrung in der Ausarbeitung komplexer Angebote und Verträge  
Sicherer Umgang mit IT\-Infrastrukturen, CRM\- und ERP\-Systemen  
Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse, gute Englisch\- und ösischkenntnisse  
Professionelles Auftreten mit hoher Kommunikationsstärke und Verhandlungsgeschick  
Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, Eigenverantwortung und Teamfähigkeit  
Bereitschaft zu Reisetätigkeit bis zu 60 % innerhalb der Schweiz  
Bist du interessiert oder hast du weiterführende Fragen?  
Icobas steht dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung.  
[E\-Mail schreiben](<>)  
Über uns  
«Gemeinsam gestalten wir den Handel von morgen» beschäftigt rund 1300 Mitarbeitende und erwirtschaftet über eine Milliarde Umsatz. Das Unternehmen gibt es, weil ein Mensch den Mut hatte, neue Wege zu finden und sie zu gehen. Unsere Erfolgsgeschichte zeigt, dass durch jeden Einzelnen, gemeinsam etwas Grosses entsteht und wir lieben unsere Einzigartigkeit. Wir setzen uns ambitionierte Ziele, dabei ist es uns sehr wichtig, dass wir verantwortlich handeln, uns gegenseitig fördern und fordern und Freude haben an dem, was wir tagtäglich tun.  
Unser Anstellungsprozess  
Du erstellst in unserem Karriereportal dein Profil und bewirbst dich direkt online auf die ausgeschriebene Stelle.  
Du bekommst umgehend eine Eingangsbestätigung und innerhalb von spätestens 10 Arbeitstagen erhältst du die Rückmeldung, wie weiter.  
Während du uns deine Geduld entgegenbringst, nehmen wir uns persönlich Zeit, deine Bewerbung zu prüfen und definieren die nächsten Schritte.  
Deine Unterlagen überzeugen, dann lernen wir uns mit Live\-Videocall oder im persönlichen Gespräch kennen.  
Der «Match» bestätigt sich gegenseitig. Dann gehen wir in die zweite Gesprächsrunde bei dem du deinen zukünftigen Arbeitsplatz und das Team kennenlernst.  
YES – wir haben uns füreinander entschieden! Der Arbeitsvertrag wird dir digital zugestellt und nach Vertragsabschluss erhältst du den Zugang zu unseren internen Kommunikationskanälen und zeitgleich bereiten wir deinen Onboarding\-Prozess vor.  
Benefits  
Vergünstigungen: Attraktive Vergünstigungen im Brack\-Onlineshop sowie Mittagessenvergünstigungen und Personalrestaurants in Mägenwil und Willisau.  
Erholung: Mindestens 5 Wochen Ferien, zusätzlich besteht die Möglichkeit für Ferienkauf und unbezahlten Urlaub.  
Entwicklung: Interne Ausbildungen in der eigenen Academy sowie finanzielle Beteiligung an externen Weiterbildungen.  
Familie: 18 Wochen bezahlter Mutterschaftsurlaub mit Verlängerungsmöglichkeit und 4 Wochen bezahlter Vaterschaftsurlaub.  
Versicherungen: Überobligatorisch – 100% Lohnfortzahlung sowie vollständige Finanzierung der Krankentaggeldversicherung durch den Arbeitgeber.

Die operative Projektsteuerung liegt in Ihren Händen, ebenso die strukturierte Koordination aller Beteiligten

Applications are sought from persons interested in employment within the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva.  
The successful applicant will be engaged as a locally engaged staff member by the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva.  
Please be advised that the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva does not assist with relocation. Any costs associated with taking up the position would be the responsibility of the successful candidate.  
A standard probity check will be undertaken prior to commencement for the successful applicant.  
Executive Assistant \- LE4 \- DFAT \- Geneva  
About The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade  
The role of the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) is to advance the interests of Australia and Australians internationally. This involves strengthening Australia’s security, enhancing Australia’s prosperity, delivering an effective and high\-quality overseas aid program and helping Australian travellers and Australians overseas. The department provides foreign, trade and development policy advice to the Australian Government. DFAT also works with other Australian Government agencies to drive coordination of Australia’s pursuit of global, regional and bilateral interests.  
About the Position  
Under direction, the Executive Assistant to the Ambassador and Deputy Ambassador provides high\-level executive, administrative and organisational support at the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva. The position also organises official events and functions.  
Due to the sensitive nature of the work involved, this position will need to be able to hold and maintain a national security clearance recognised by DFAT.  
Key responsibilities of the position include but are not limited to:  
Provide high\-level executive support to the Ambassador and Deputy Ambassador, ensuring the effective operation of executive offices in a fast\-paced and sensitive environment.  
Manage and prioritise correspondence, invitations, briefing materials and requests, exercising sound judgement to determine priority, action and compliance requirements.  
Coordinate official visits and delegation programs for Ministers, senior officials and high\-level visitors, balancing competing priorities and operational requirements.  
Plan and deliver representational events, meetings and official engagements, liaising with internal and external stakeholders to achieve Mission objectives.  
Manage representational expenditure and financial administration, including forecasting, acquittals, reconciliations and reporting in accordance with DFAT policies and procedures.  
Coordinate travel, logistics and related administrative arrangements for executive leadership and official activities, ensuring compliance with relevant policies and procedures.  
Monitor security, operational and workflow risks, implementing required controls and escalating issues as appropriate.  
Provide administrative guidance, maintain effective business systems and support team coordination, contributing to continuous improvement and organisational effectiveness.  
Required Qualifications/Experience/Knowledge/Skills  
Proven experience in similar Executive Assistant role/s  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills  
Ability to work with and support a team. Ability to develop and maintain respectful and effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders  
Ability to manage time, prioritise, plan, handle multiple tasks and work well under pressure  
Financial management and organisational skills  
Discretion and sound judgement in handling confidential information  
Extensive experience using Microsoft Office and electronic applications  
Exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills  
Fluency in English is required, with fluency in French highly regarded  
Knowledge of, or an ability to quickly acquire a knowledge of Australian Government legislation or departmental policy and guidelines in relation to the position duties  
Desirable  
Previous experience working in an embassy, international organisation, or comparable environment.  
Security Requirements  
Australian NV2 security clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain this. Therefore applicants must hold Australian citizenship to be considered.  
Please note that candidates who hold citizenship or dual citizenship of Switzerland are not eligible for an Australian Security Clearance.  
How to Apply

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams  
and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.  
Manager \- Tax Services \- Indirect Tax/VAT (Zug or Luzern)  
The opportunity  
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your voice and perspective to help EY become even better too.

jobs.title: Femme / Valet de Chambre
jobs.description:
Intitulé du poste:  Femme / Valet de Chambre
Département : Housekeeping
Supérieur hiérarchique: Gouvernante et Property Manager.
Lieu de travail: Établissement hôtelier de luxe – Hôtel 5 étoiles, résidences privées et chalets de prestige.
Type de contrat
•    CDD saisonnier
•    Temps plein
•    Horaires variables incluant les week-ends, jours fériés et périodes de forte activité
Mission du poste
La Femme / le Valet de Chambre est responsable de l'entretien, du nettoyage et de la remise en état des chambres, suites, appartements, chalets et espaces privatifs confiés, dans le respect des standards de qualité de l'établissement. Il/elle veille à offrir aux clients un environnement irréprochable, confortable et accueillant, tout en garantissant la discrétion, la confidentialité et un service d'excellence.
Responsabilités principales
Entretien des chambres et espaces privatifs
•    Assurer le nettoyage complet des chambres, suites, appartements et chalets selon les standards de l'établissement.
•    Effectuer les remises à blanc et les recouches.
•    Nettoyer et désinfecter les salles de bains.
•    Changer le linge de lit, le linge de bain et les peignoirs.
•    Réapprovisionner les produits d'accueil, minibars, consommables et fournitures.
•    Contrôler le bon fonctionnement des équipements et signaler toute anomalie technique.
Qualité et standards de luxe
•    Garantir une qualité de nettoyage irréprochable jusque dans les moindres détails.
•    Respecter les standards de présentation définis par l'établissement.
•    Préparer les chambres selon les demandes spécifiques des clients (VIP, anniversaires, demandes particulières, etc.).
•    Vérifier que chaque chambre est prête à accueillir les clients dans les meilleures conditions.
Gestion du linge et du matériel
•    Utiliser correctement les produits de nettoyage et les équipements mis à disposition.
•    Veiller au bon entretien du matériel de travail.
•    Réapprovisionner quotidiennement son chariot de service.
•    Gérer le linge sale et le linge propre selon les procédures internes.
•    Respecter les procédures de gestion des objets trouvés.
Hygiène, sécurité et environnement
•    Respecter les normes d'hygiène, de sécurité et les procédures internes.
•    Utiliser les produits d'entretien conformément aux recommandations.
•    Respecter les consignes relatives au tri des déchets et aux démarches environnementales de l'établissement.
•    Maintenir les offices, réserves et locaux Housekeeping propres et organisés.
Relation client
•    Saluer les clients avec courtoisie et professionnalisme.
•    Répondre aux demandes simples des clients ou les orienter vers le service compétent.
•    Faire preuve de discrétion et respecter strictement la confidentialité des informations concernant les clients.
•    Représenter en permanence les valeurs et l'image de l'établissement.
Travail en équipe
•    Collaborer avec les Gouvernantes, la Réception, la Maintenance, le Spa, le Room Service et les autres départements.
•    Participer aux briefings quotidiens.
•    Informer immédiatement sa hiérarchie de toute anomalie ou situation particulière.
Profil recherché
Formation
•    Formation en hôtellerie ou Housekeeping appréciée.
•    Une formation interne peut être assurée.
Expérience
•    Expérience d'au moins 1 an dans un poste similaire souhaitée.
•    Une expérience en hôtellerie de luxe (4 ou 5 étoiles), palaces ou résidences de prestige constitue un atout majeur.
Compétences techniques
•    Maîtrise des techniques de nettoyage hôtelier.
•    Bonne connaissance des produits d'entretien.
•    Connaissance des standards de qualité de l'hôtellerie de luxe.
•    Capacité à organiser efficacement son travail.
•    Respect strict des procédures internes.
Compétences personnelles
•    Sens aigu du détail.
•    Excellente organisation.
•    Discrétion et confidentialité.
•    Rigueur.
•    Rapidité d'exécution.
•    Sens du service.
•    Polyvalence.
•    Esprit d'équipe.
•    Bonne condition physique.
•    Gestion du temps et des priorités.
Langues
•    Une connaissance du français ou de l'anglais est souhaitée.
•    Toute autre langue constitue un avantage.
Conditions particulières
•    Travail debout prolongé.
•    Port de charges légères à modérées.
•    Horaires variables incluant les week-ends et jours fériés.
•    Respect des standards de présentation et de l'uniforme de l'établissement.
•    Respect absolu de la confidentialité et de la vie privée des clients.
Objectifs de performance
•    Garantir un niveau de propreté irréprochable conforme aux standards de l'établissement.
•    Respecter les temps de nettoyage définis tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité.
•    Assurer la satisfaction des clients grâce à un environnement impeccable.
•    Respecter les procédures d'hygiène, de sécurité et de qualité.
•    Contribuer à l'image d'excellence et de prestige de l'établissement.
Qualités recherchées
•    Sens de l'excellence.
•    Passion du travail bien fait.
•    Discrétion.
•    Sens des responsabilités.
•    Esprit d'équipe.
•    Fiabilité.
•    Ponctualité.
•    Adaptabilité.
•    Motivation.
•    Respect des standards de qualité.

jobs.description:
Join MSF OCG as a Social Media & Community Engagement Officer in Geneva!
We are looking for passionate candidates ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission.
Below, you will find the job details and the qualifications we are looking for.
Inclusivity and Diversity at MSF
Do your qualifications and experience not exactly match all requirements of the job?
At MSF OCG, we are committed to an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff members. We strive to create workplaces where teams of people with diverse backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF's social mission and create better outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with.
We understand that some people may hesitate to apply for employment if they don't meet all listed job requirements. Research shows that this is especially true for women. jobs.title: Clinical Fellowship in Robotic Lymphatic Microsurgery & Lymphatic Biology 80-100%
jobs.description:
The Clinic of Plastic Surgery and Hand Surgery at the University Hospital Zurich is providing the full spectrum of plastic and reconstructive surgery, hand surgery, burn care and sarcoma surgery. Our clinic has more than 10 years of experience in lymphatic reconstructive surgery, has been among the earliest adopters of robotic microsurgery worldwide and possesses a solid research foundation, ranging from basic to translational and clinical research.  
Fellowship purpose  
This 3\-6 month advanced fellowship trains surgeons and physician\-scientists in (1\) robotic\-assisted microsurgery / supermicrosurgery workflows and (2\) translational lymphatic biology, with a focus on lymphatic reconstruction. The fellow is integrated into a high\-volume academic plastic surgery service and a structured research program linking surgical innovation to lymphatic science. The fellowship has been designed with a 60% clinical and 40% research focus to maximize the benefits of this dedicated time.  
The Fellowship is unpaid. The accommodation in Zurich will be organized and sponsored by the fellow.  
The language during the Fellowship is English. German language knowledge is found to be helpful.  
Fellowship Types  
Track A: Clinical Fellow Lymphatic Surgery, 6 months (hands\-on clinical practice under supervision). Track A is designed for candidates who can legally participate in patient care in Switzerland, enabling them to have hands\-on clinical practice under supervision.  
Track B: Observership Fellow, 3 months (observer status; no medical practice).  
For candidates who do not meet Swiss recognition/authorization requirements. The observer fellow is fully integrated into the daily clinical routine and operating theater, but without the right to perform in any surgery/ medical procedure.  
The University Hospital of Zurich is one of the largest hospitals in Switzerland. Our more than 8, 600 employees and around 700 trainees work every day for the well\-being of our patients.  
Clinical Fellowship in Robotic Lymphatic Microsurgery \& Lymphatic Biology 80\-100%  
Start date: June 1, 2026 or by agreement  
Your main tasks  
Track A  
\* Supervised participation in outpatient clinics, perioperative care, and operating theatre activities  
\* Progressive clinical entrustment based on competency milestones (assistant ? key procedural steps ? selected cases under direct supervision)  
\* Participation in journal clubs and skills lab training  
\* Active research participation including lab meetings and data presentation  
Track B  
\* Structured shadowing of clinical routine including ward rounds and outpatient clinics (observer role)  
\* Observation in the operating theatre  
\* Participation in journal clubs and skills lab training  
\* Research participation including lab meetings and data presentation  
Both Tracks  
\* Attendance at rounds, conferences, teaching sessions, and educational activities organized by the host clinic  
\* Participation in the core curriculum:  
\* Robotic microsurgery / supermicrosurgery training  
\* Simulation modules (dry\- and wet\-lab)  
\* Case\-based clinical learning  
\* Operating room workflow orientation  
\* Exposure to lymphatic surgery patient evaluation and treatment pathways  
\* Assigned research project(s) based on fellowship duration and qualifications  
\* Scientific mentorship and dedicated research time  
\* Participation in consultations and surgical schedule (as permitted by track status)  
Your profile  
Track A  
\* Medical degree enabling eligibility for clinical participation in Switzerland  
\* Willingness and responsibility to obtain MEBEKO recognition of medical diploma prior to fellowship start  
\* Ability to work in a supervised clinical environment  
\* Interest in lymphatic surgery and microsurgical innovation  
Track B  
\* Medical or scientific background relevant to the fellowship field  
\* Interest in clinical observation and research participation  
\* Eligibility to participate in the fellowship in an observer capacity (no patient care activities)  
Both Tracks  
\* Proficiency in English (working language of the fellowship)  
\* German language skills considered an advantage  
\* Strong motivation to engage in surgical education and research  
\* Interest in lymphatic reconstruction and translational science  
\* Ability to participate in academic meetings, teaching sessions, and research activities  
Benefits  
Supervision  
Named fellowship mentors within the Department of Plastic Surgery and Hand Surgery (USZ):  
Clinical part: Prof. Dr. med. Lindenblatt, Dr. med. Jennifer Ashley Watson, Dr. med.  
Research part: Prof. Dr. med. Lindenblatt, PD Dr. med. Epameinondas Gousopoulos  
Evaluation  
Quarterly review: operative logbook (Track A), skills assessments (simulation), research milestones, and professionalism goals.  
Fellowship completion requirements: (i) documented competency portfolio, (ii) at least one manuscript submitted (or a complete study protocol with ethics submission).  
Deliverables \& Outcome  
Graduates will be able to integrate robotic microsurgical workflows into reconstructive practice and translate lymphatic biology into clinically meaningful innovation. Upon completion of the Fellowship, all Fellows will be part of the Fellows' Academy, a tool of professional networking, future collaborations, and a discussion forum for the future leaders of the field.

jobs.title: Residential Assistant Houseparent
jobs.description:
Aiglon College seeks to appoint a suitably qualified

Residential Assistant Houseparent

to join the school from: 08.01.2027

Your profile
The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.
Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application.  

About us
Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not-for-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world-class education in a stunning alpine setting.
The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.
There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes.

What we offer
Aiglon is dedicated to the well-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages.

How to apply
Deadline for applications: 06.09.2026
Early applications are encouraged.  We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate.  Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered.

Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children.
Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.

You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s Privacy Notice.

JOB PURPOSE
This is a live-in residential position where the post holder will be responsible for the safeguarding, welfare and security of students in conjunction with the Houseparent (HP) and House team.
The job may involve any or all of the following specifications. Above all, there is an expectation of a RAHP who is generous with their time and responsive to the needs of the students. The list is neither  definitive nor exhaustive and the range of tasks will embrace many incidents and situations which are not stated, but require initiative and common sense to be applied.

The post requires someone who likes and understands young people and is able to demonstrate good sense. They should have good personal interactive skills with young people and their parents and guardians by being a good listener, flexible in outlook, reliable, warm and friendly in disposition, with sufficient sensitivity to show tact and diplomacy. A sense of humour and an even temper dealing with all situations in a co-operative and sensitive manner are also fundamental to carrying out this job effectively.

The nature of the work requires physical fitness and a good level of stamina. It is understood that each House may have a slightly different structure for the job, depending upon the particular circumstances, strengths and skills of the individual post holders. The role will vary according to whether the RAHP works in a junior or senior House, usually working 4 out of 5 weekday afternoons with one full day off during the week. In addition, there are two evening duties, with accompanying overnights on call. Weekend commitments are approximately 2 out of 3 weekends, with some tutor support at various times over the weekend.

KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The role of the RAHP can cover a variety of responsibilities, including:
General residential support
Acting as a tutor for a small group of students, providing them with individual guidance and support in both academic and pastoral areas
Supporting teaching or coaching staff, for example in drama, music, sport, expeditions or another area of specialist interest and competence

General duties in the House will include
Assisting the Houseparent in promoting the welfare and security of students and the smooth running of the House
Working as part of the wider House team
Residential and administrative work in the House
Weekday supervision in House
Weekend duties
Morning and evening duties in the House
Overnight supervision in the House as required
Various boarding and school supervision duties as required
Study supervision
Assistance with the co-curricular programme
Attendance at training and support meetings as required
To maintain the medicine cabinet and medical records in accordance with Health Centre guidance
To supervise and keep records of students taking medication. All prescribed medication should be administered to students on time according to the prescription timings
Any other duties which may reasonably be required from time to time by the School

Working week
Residential Assistant Houseparents work 4 afternoons and 2 evenings per week. They also work 2 weekends out of 3. A weekend starts once school ends on Friday and ends on Monday morning. They have one weekday off each week which varies across houses based on the timetable of the Houseparent.

An example of a weekday routine
11:55 - 12:05        Handover from House Assistant to RAHP
11:55 - 17:00        RAHP on duty
16:15 - 21:30        Tutor on duty plus RAHP or HP in House (HP x2 and RAHP x2 evenings)
21:30 - 23:00        RAHP or HP on duty (HP x2 and RAHP x2 weekday nights)
23:00 - 07:00        RAHP or HP on overnight call (HP x2 and RAHP x2 weekday nights)

Friday evening and the weekend is staffed by the RAHP or HP on duty for that weekend with some tutor support at various times over the weekend.

In addition to the responsibilities outlined above
It is important that the post holder is always aware of the School’s Safeguarding guidelines and Staff Prudence code, observing an appropriate professional relationship with students that is characterised by effective working and caring relationships.
Undertake any other task which may be reasonably required by the Deputy School Director to assist in the smooth running of the team.
Understand and implement all school policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people.
Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times.

Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. All shortlisted applicants will undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.

We're looking for a City Scout to help build the most reliable database of work-friendly cafes for travellers across the UK.

You'll visit cafes across your assigned city, verify information like WiFi quality, internet speed, plug points and overall work-friendliness, and submit accurate data that powers a new Atlys product. Every visit directly improves the travel experience for thousands of users.

  • Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.

jobs.title: Product Manager: Customer Onboarding Experience
jobs.description:
About You

You are a technically fluent, customer-obsessed PM who gets energized by removing friction from developer workflows. You have a strong instinct for what makes integrations feel fast and safe, and you know how to balance developer needs with long-term product maintainability. You bring systems thinking to SDK and tracking decisions, hold a high bar for integration correctness and reliability, and are energized by the challenge of reducing time-to-value for the teams and customers who depend on you.


About Us

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we've built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We're passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.

Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.

We're a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.

About the Position

As the PM for Customer Developer Experience + Customer Data Integrations, you will own the end-to-end integration journey for Constructor's customers and SIs — from first setup through long-term adoption. Your north star is time-to-value: making it fast, correct, and reliable for any team to integrate with Constructor and start getting results.

You will span two tightly connected surfaces:

  • CDX — SDKs, UI libraries, integration patterns, docs, and the extensibility model that lets customers build on Constructor without accumulating hidden complexity.

  • CDI — tracking/instrumentation, data attributes, event validation tooling, and the reliability + correctness of the data flows that power Constructor's AI.

Day-to-day, you will:

  • Define and drive a roadmap that measurably reduces integration time, defects, and escalations.

  • Improve integration correctness for key tracking flows (search → PDP → conversion, sponsored click tracking, etc.) by reducing common failure modes and adding robust validation and diagnostics.

  • Build and evolve validation and debugging tooling that empowers customers, Solutions Engineers, and Customer Success to self-serve faster.

  • Define clear support and capability boundaries to reduce high-visibility escalations and improve customer predictability.

  • Partner with Engineering, Solutions/CS, and other Product teams to sequence work, de-risk launches, and ensure new capabilities ship integration-ready.

Define and report a CDX+CDI KPI stack (time-to-first-value, adoption, defect rate, escalation volume, doc findability) and drive continuous improvement.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of product management experience shipping developer-facing or integration-heavy products — such as SDKs, APIs, web tracking/instrumentation, data pipelines, or developer tooling.

  • Demonstrated ability to reduce time-to-value or integration complexity in a B2B SaaS environment — with concrete, measurable outcomes.

  • Technical fluency sufficient to reason credibly about event flows, browser/web constraints, attribution, versioning, breaking changes, and rollout risk — without needing to be an engineer.

  • Track record of strong cross-functional collaboration: aligning Engineering, Customer Success, Solutions, and other Product teams on priorities and support boundaries.

  • Comfort defining metrics and making decisions with imperfect data; experience building and reporting product health dashboards.

  • Strong written communication — clear specs, integration guides, capability docs, and stakeholder updates.

🛋️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office

DAS IST DER JOB


Du suchst keinen klassischen, monotonen Laboranten-Job, sondern willst die Entwicklung von Wasch-/Putz-/Reinigungsmittel- und Kosmetikrezepturen aktiv mitgestalten? Dann bist du als Junior Produktentwickler - Home & Personal Care (m/w/d) bei uns genau richtig, denn hier übernimmst du schnell Verantwortung für deine eigenen Projekte. 

Deine Hauptaufgaben werden sein:

  • Rezepturen entwickeln & optimieren: Du führst praktische Machbarkeitsprüfungen neuer Rezepturideen für Wasch-/Putz-/Reinigungsmittel sowie Kosmetika durch und optimierst bestehende Produkte.

  • Labortests & Analytik: Du begleitest deine Laboransätze eigenständig durch systematische Labortests (Charakterisierung, Stabilitäts- und Lagerprüfungen).

  • Labororganisation: Du verantwortest den reibungslosen, praktischen Laborbetrieb und bringst eigene Ideen zur Optimierung unserer internen Laborabläufe ein.

  • Schnittstellen & Benchmarking: Du führst technisches Benchmarking sowie Leistungsbeurteilungen durch, wählst externe Testinstitute aus (z. B. für Dermatest, Schwermetallanalysen) und beauftragst diese. Zudem stimmst du dich bezüglich Qualitätsvereinbarungen, QS-Parametern und der Scale-up-Betreuung eng mit unseren Lohnherstellern ab.

  • Dokumentation: Du dokumentierst deine Ergebnisse systematisch und teilst sie im R&D-Team.

Wenn du dich leidenschaftlich für Nachhaltigkeit engagieren möchtest und hochmotiviert bist, mit uns die Welt ein bisschen sauberer zu machen, dann finden wir dich richtig gut!
Wenn du außerdem gerne proaktiv und im Team arbeitest, und du jede kleine und große Herausforderung als eine Chance ansiehst, noch besser zu werden – dann sind wir schon ein ganz kleines bisschen verknallt.
Wenn du schließlich auch noch über die folgenden Skills und Erfahrungen verfügst, dann sind wir uns fast sicher: Das könnte der Beginn einer ganz großen Love Story sein!

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute bis verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift für die internationale Kommunikation mit Lieferanten.

Seitdem haben unsere Haushalts- und Pflegeprodukte bereits mehr als 20 Millionen Einweg-Plastikflaschen und Tausende Tonnen unnötige CO2-Emissionen und chemische Rohstoffe eingespart.
