We're Cortea, a European audit-tech company, born in Berlin, rebuilding how audits are done everywhere.

Audits are still driven by spreadsheets, checklists, and manual reviews in one of the most regulated, high-stakes areas of business. We use AI to automate audits end to end, so highly educated auditors no longer spend 60+ hour weeks on manual work and can focus on judgment, trust, and choices that matter.

With €15m+ in funding, a live product, and paying customers across Europe, we're at a stage where your choices will directly shape Cortea's future, and how audits are done.

The Role

This is a role for an experienced auditor who enjoys the client side of the profession: building relationships, leading discussions, and earning the trust of sceptical practitioners. As part of Cortea's UK go-to-market team, you are the subject-matter expert who gives our commercial work credibility: you speak with auditors as a peer, lead methodology conversations with prospects and customers, and help turn pilots into long-term partnerships. Colleagues own the sales playbook, forecasting, and deal mechanics, while you own trust, expertise, and account growth.

Key Responsibilities

Audit Expertise in GTM: Act as the audit subject-matter expert in Cortea's UK go-to-market unit, joining demos, pilots, and customer conversations as the credible auditor in the room

Customer Relationships & Growth: Be a key point of contact for our UK customers throughout pilots and rollouts; deepen relationships at existing customers, identify upsell opportunities, and lead methodology conversations that grow accounts

Industry Voice: Build a visible public presence for Cortea: be active on LinkedIn, speak at industry events, and evangelise AI-supported auditing to the UK profession

Market Insight: Feed customer and market insight back to our product team to sharpen the UK roadmap

Berlin Collaboration: Travel regularly to our Berlin hub to work closely with the founders and GTM colleagues

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of financial audit experience (Big 4 or leading mid-tier firms preferred)

  • ACA (ICAEW), ACCA, or equivalent chartered accountancy qualification

  • A confident, client-facing communicator: you enjoy presenting, networking, and representing your firm publicly, including at events and on LinkedIn

  • Comfortable taking ownership in a young, fast-moving company: you handle ambiguity well, work towards clear commercial targets, and enjoy building processes rather than following established ones

  • Strong grasp of ISA, UK GAAP, IFRS, and the Companies Act 2006, enough to hold your own in methodology discussions with partners

  • Native in English, German is a plus

  • Right to work in the UK required; we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role

Benefits

  • Competitive salary plus equity participation

  • High-impact role at the intersection of audit and AI, with the chance to build Cortea's UK customer base and public presence

  • Hybrid collaboration from our London office, with regular trips to our Berlin hub

  • 25+ days holiday allowance

jobs.title: Complaints Champion
jobs.description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

If you love digging into operational processes, understanding where things might have gone wrong and then putting them right, working across several teams and upholding exceptional service levels, then you could be just right for a Complaints Champion role.

Your mission

Your mission will be to uphold great service levels for our customers and ensure iwoca is learning from the complaints we receive.

You’ll achieve this by:

  • Investigating customer complaints, ensuring they are dealt with in a timely manner

    • Listening to customer calls

    • Reviewing operations agent’s notes

    • Understanding company wide processes

    • Liaising with other teams/ stakeholders in the business

  • Writing complaint responses, ensuring they include findings from the investigation, but also align with our tone of voice

  • Feeding back to operational teams if a mistake has happened and; where necessary, suggesting improvements and changes to current processes

  • Preparing case files for, and liaising with, the Financial Ombudsman Service (“FOS”)

You’ll report to iwoca’s Complaints Manager, who reports directly to the COO.

Requirements

Essential requirements are:

  • A real curiosity to thoroughly investigate each complaint to find the root cause

  • Excellent communication skills, for dealing with customers (some of whom may be frustrated, angry, vulnerable) as well as a diverse group of internal stakeholders (including Operations team leads, product managers, and senior execs)

  • Excellent writing skills, for being able to craft clear, professional responses to our customers

  • Demonstrates curiosity to use and learn more about AI tools.   • Experience working within a financial services firm - preferable but not essential

The salary

We expect to pay from £30,000 - £45,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

We’re looking for a Senior Back-End Engineer

This role is a chance to tackle complex, high-impact challenges at the heart of our fintech platform. You will join the team that owns iwoca's ledger — the system of record for the money we lend and collect — and you will be responsible for scaling it across the full lifecycle of our credit card and lending products, building the reconciliation and reporting that prove it correct, and laying the foundations for our next generation of products. This is a hands-on role: you'll design these systems, write the code, and own them in production.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

The Ledger Platform team owns the ledger across all of iwoca's products, from credit cards to our lending range, plus everything around it: reconciliation, financial reporting, and the data Finance, Accounting and Capital Markets run on. Some of the team work fully remotely and others are hybrid, working 1-3 days per week in the London office.


The role

Responsibility and Autonomy:

  • Lead the delivery of projects involving many stakeholders and systems.

  • Architect and implement scalable solutions for complex challenges: the lifecycle of an account, interest and repayment allocation, reconciliation, and how financial data reaches our reporting stack.

  • Use domain modelling to find the simple design behind a complicated problem, and structure software so that it is easy to understand, test and evolve.

  • Be pragmatic about which parts of a problem actually need solving now. The hardest work here is deciding what not to build.

  • Build solutions that avoid single points of failure, and make sure our releases happen with zero downtime.

  • Translate ambiguous product requirements into clear, actionable technical plans that guide the team's work.

  • Promptly investigate and fix live issues, and ensure they do not resurface. Own what you ship in production and keep it reliable and easy to operate.

  • Share new approaches and tooling with the wider engineering group through our internal forums and company-wide talks.

AI:

Engineers here write clear technical specs, let skills and agents implement boiler-plate, and hold a high bar on code review — the person, not the model, is accountable for what merges.   • Extensive experience with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL, but open to MySQL or similar (e.g., MS SQL, Oracle); emphasis is on data integrity.

  • Experience with systems where correctness is a hard requirement — ledgers, accounting, billing or payments, ideally in a regulated setting — including the invariants, immutable audit trails and reconciliation controls that enforce it.

  • Experience leading a feature or project end to end — scoping, design, delivery, and running it in production.

  • You use AI (like Cursor, Claude Code or similar) in your daily flow - whether for work or for fun. You use it to blast through boilerplate and research, so you can focus on the hard parts: complex architecture, rigour, and high-stakes decision-making.

  • Clear written and verbal communication — you can explain a technical trade-off to Finance, and a business constraint back to engineers.

Bonus:

We're looking for a back-end engineer to join the Repeats team.

The company

Imagine a world where every small business has the power to thrive. That's the world we're building at iwoca. Small businesses aren't just statistics – they're the heartbeat of our communities, the character of our high streets, and the engine of our economy. Since 2012, we've revolutionised how these businesses access finance, turning what was once a lengthy, frustrating process into something remarkable: funding that's fast, flexible, and actually works for modern businesses.

Our impact speaks for itself: we've provided billions in funding to over 150,000 businesses across Europe, making us one of the continent's leading fintech innovators. But we're just getting started. Our mission? To empower one million businesses with the financial tools they deserve.

We combine cutting-edge technology and data science with genuine human understanding to make finance feel less like a barrier and more like a superpower. Whether it's managing cash flow or seizing unexpected opportunities, we ensure businesses get the funds they need – often within minutes.

The team

The Repeats team is one of iwoca's funnel teams. We grow customer lifetime value after a business's first loan. That means we own the underwriting, pricing, and product experience for two segments that make up most of iwoca's back-book value: top-up customers who borrow again while still repaying, and loan-ended customers who return for a new loan. Almost every repeat borrower goes through code we own. The team is cross-functional – backend, frontend, product, design, data science and analytics – shipping behind split tests and measuring impact in Looker rather than on gut feel.

The role

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Experience team at Pleo. In this role, you’ll own a portfolio of large, complex, and strategically important enterprise customers, helping them achieve measurable business outcomes, expand adoption, manage change, and build long-term value with Pleo.

You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders while coordinating the broader Pleo relationship across Customer Success, Product, Support, Sales, Finance, and other internal teams.

This is not a reactive account-management role. You’ll be expected to understand each customer’s business priorities, operating model, success criteria, and risk profile. You’ll turn that understanding into clear success plans, executive engagement strategies, adoption programs, renewal plans, and growth opportunities.

The right candidate will bring at least three years of direct experience managing enterprise customers, along with the communication skills, commercial judgment, and operational discipline required to manage high-value relationships in a fast-paced technology environment.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Manager of Customer Success, Large & High-Growth Customers and work closely with teams across:

  • Customer Support

  • Customer Onboarding

  • Sales and Account Management

  • Product and Product Operations

  • Revenue Operations

  • Finance

  • Data and Analytics

  • Program Management and Operations

You’ll work with customer stakeholders across finance, procurement, operations, technology, transformation, and executive leadership.

You’ll be responsible for creating alignment across these stakeholders, establishing clear governance, and ensuring Pleo remains connected to the customer’s evolving strategic and operational priorities.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will:

  • Own a portfolio of enterprise customers with accountability for customer health, value realisation, adoption, retention, renewal readiness, advocacy, and growth.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders, positioning yourself as a credible advisor who understands their business priorities and operating environment.

  • Develop detailed customer success plans that connect the customer’s strategic goals to measurable outcomes, adoption milestones, responsibilities, and timelines.

  • Lead executive business reviews and strategic customer meetings that demonstrate value, address risks, align stakeholders, and create clear next steps.

  • Drive product adoption across complex customer organisations, helping customers expand usage across teams, entities, locations, use cases, and workflows.

  • Create and maintain detailed stakeholder maps, identifying decision-makers, champions, influencers, operational contacts, blockers, and executive sponsors.

  • Identify churn risk early using product usage, engagement, stakeholder, support, financial, organisational, and external business signals.

  • Build and execute churn-prevention plans with clear actions, owners, timelines, customer commitments, and executive escalation paths.

  • Maintain detailed and accurate forecasts across renewals, risk, customer health, expected outcomes, growth opportunities, and major account milestones.

  • Lead renewal-readiness activities by ensuring customer value is documented, risks are addressed, stakeholders are aligned, and commercial partners have accurate account intelligence.

  • Identify and support expansion opportunities by connecting additional Pleo capabilities, products, or use cases to the customer’s evolving business needs.

  • Coordinate complex customer escalations across Support, Product, Engineering, Finance, and other teams while maintaining clear and confident customer communication.

  • Act as the customer’s internal advocate, ensuring customer needs, feedback, risks, and opportunities are visible to the right stakeholders at Pleo.

  • Navigate customer change effectively, including leadership transitions, reorganisations, acquisitions, market expansion, platform changes, and evolving business priorities.

  • Track customer commitments and outcomes with strong operational discipline, ensuring actions are documented, owned, and completed.

  • Contribute to the evolution of Pleo’s enterprise Customer Success model by sharing best practices, customer insights, playbooks, and recommendations.

  • Support peer development and knowledge sharing across the Customer Success team without holding direct people-management responsibility.

To put things into context

In this role, you can expect to work on priorities such as:

  • strengthening relationships with Pleo’s largest and most strategic customers

  • improving enterprise customer retention and renewal predictability

  • increasing adoption across complex customer organisations

  • creating stronger executive engagement and governance

  • identifying churn risk before it becomes a renewal issue

  • improving forecast accuracy and account visibility

  • coordinating complex customer needs across multiple internal teams

  • helping customers quantify and communicate the value they receive from Pleo

  • identifying opportunities for expansion and deeper product adoption

  • improving the consistency and quality of enterprise success planning

  • helping customers navigate operational and organisational change

  • turning customer feedback into actionable Product and CX insight

You can expect to work across a technology environment that includes CRM, Customer Success platforms, support systems, product analytics, business intelligence tools, workflow tools, and collaboration platforms.

Examples may include Vitally, Gainsight or similar, Zendesk, Looker, Tableau or Power BI, Jira, Asana, and Slack.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • At least three years of direct enterprise Customer Success or strategic account-management experience, managing large, complex, and high-value B2B customers.

  • Five or more years of overall experience in Customer Success, account management, consulting, implementation, or a related customer-facing role.

  • Experience working in SaaS, fintech, enterprise technology, or another complex B2B technology environment.

  • A proven record of retaining and growing enterprise customers, including managing renewals, adoption, risk, and value realisation.

  • Strong executive relationship-management skills, with the confidence and credibility to engage senior decision-makers and business leaders.

  • Experience managing complex stakeholder environments involving multiple teams, business units, regions, entities, or decision-makers.

  • Strong churn-prediction and prevention skills, including the ability to interpret customer signals, identify root causes, and build effective recovery plans.

  • Detailed forecasting experience across renewals, customer risk, account health, adoption, and expansion opportunities.

  • Strong commercial judgment, with an understanding of how customer outcomes connect to retention, revenue, expansion, and long-term account value.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to lead difficult conversations, present to executives, and simplify complex issues.

  • Experience building strategic success plans, account plans, stakeholder maps, and executive business reviews.

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret customer data, product usage, service trends, and business information.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to align internal stakeholders without relying on direct authority.

  • A structured and proactive approach to account management, with excellent follow-through and attention to detail.

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced growth environment where customer expectations, internal priorities, and business needs can evolve quickly.

  • The ability to balance strategic relationship management with detailed operational execution.

Nice to have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, spend management, financial operations, or expense-management technology

  • Experience working with finance leaders, procurement teams, controllers, CFO organisations, or transformation leaders

  • Experience managing multi-country or multinational enterprise customers

  • Familiarity with ERP, accounting, procurement, or financial-system integrations

  • Experience supporting customers through significant organisational or technology transformation

  • Exposure to AI-enabled Customer Success, predictive health models, automated risk detection, or digital engagement

  • Experience partnering with Product teams on strategic customer feedback and roadmap discussions

  • Experience managing accounts with complex security, compliance, governance, or implementation requirements

Why is this role a good fit for you?

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You enjoy building strategic relationships with complex enterprise customers.

  • You are comfortable engaging senior leaders and navigating high-stakes customer situations.

  • You know how to connect product adoption to measurable customer outcomes.

  • You are proactive about identifying and addressing churn risk.

  • You combine strong relationship skills with rigorous account-management discipline.

  • You are confident leading executive reviews, renewal discussions, and difficult customer conversations.

  • You enjoy coordinating internal teams around complex customer needs.

  • You want direct responsibility for protecting and growing some of Pleo’s most important customer relationships.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You have not directly managed enterprise or strategic customer relationships.

  • You prefer transactional or high-volume customer portfolios.

  • You are uncomfortable owning customer risk, retention, and renewal readiness.

  • You prefer reacting to customer requests rather than building proactive engagement strategies.

  • You are uncomfortable engaging executive stakeholders or leading difficult conversations.

  • You do not enjoy detailed forecasting, CRM management, and account planning.

  • You prefer working independently without significant cross-functional coordination.

  • You are looking for a people-management role rather than a senior individual-contributor position.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 1 month at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Learn Pleo’s product, enterprise customer journey, value proposition, and Customer Success operating model.

  • Build a detailed understanding of your customer portfolio, including revenue, renewal dates, usage, stakeholders, open issues, risks, and growth potential.

  • Establish relationships with key customer stakeholders and internal account partners.

  • Review and improve success plans, stakeholder maps, account plans, and risk assessments.

  • Establish clear operating rhythms for customer engagement, internal coordination, and forecasting.

  • Identify immediate risks, adoption gaps, and opportunities across your portfolio.

In your first 3 months, you’ll:

  • Lead consistent executive and operational engagement across your customer portfolio.

  • Improve customer success planning, value documentation, and renewal readiness.

  • Strengthen the accuracy and detail of customer health and renewal forecasts.

  • Deliver measurable progress against adoption, engagement, and customer outcome goals.

  • Build and execute mitigation plans for at-risk customers.

  • Identify and support qualified expansion opportunities.

  • Become a trusted advisor to customer stakeholders and a reliable source of account intelligence internally.

In your first 5 months, you’ll:

  • Build a healthy and well-managed portfolio of enterprise customers.

  • Deliver strong retention and renewal performance.

  • Improve adoption and value realisation across complex customer organisations.

  • Develop trusted relationships with senior and executive customer stakeholders.

  • Demonstrate strong forecast accuracy and proactive risk management.

  • Contribute repeatable best practices and insight to Pleo’s broader enterprise Customer Success model.

  • Be recognised as a senior individual contributor capable of managing Pleo’s most important and complex customer relationships.

Success in this role looks like

  • Enterprise customers have clear success plans connected to measurable business outcomes.

  • Executive and operational customer relationships are strong and multi-threaded.

  • Customer risks are identified early and addressed through structured mitigation plans.

  • Renewal forecasts are detailed, accurate, and supported by clear account evidence.

  • Customers demonstrate stronger product adoption and value realisation.

  • Escalations are managed with urgency, clarity, and strong customer communication.

  • Internal teams are aligned around customer priorities, responsibilities, and next steps.

  • Renewal and retention performance is strong across the assigned portfolio.

  • Expansion opportunities are identified through customer value and business need rather than transactional selling.

  • Pleo is viewed as a strategic partner rather than simply a product provider.

Candidate profile summary

The strongest candidate for this role is an experienced enterprise Customer Success professional who combines senior-level relationship skills with commercial awareness, analytical thinking, and disciplined account execution.

They have at least three years of direct enterprise experience and are comfortable managing complex customers with multiple stakeholders, high expectations, and significant revenue impact.

They know how to earn executive trust, demonstrate value, predict and prevent churn, maintain accurate forecasts, and mobilise cross-functional teams around customer outcomes. They are proactive, credible, highly organised, and capable of protecting and growing Pleo’s most strategic customer relationships.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

This is an exciting opportunity to help shape how Pleo builds AI-powered product features, working alongside software engineers, data engineers and data scientists to take ideas from prototype to production. Pleo has over 40,000 customers and a decade of unique spend data — an incredible foundation to build on. Your mission will be to harness this data to create real product value.

Please note: applications will be open until 1st September 2026 at 09.00 CEST. We will not review any application before the window is closed so please take all the time you need to submit a great application!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You'll be reporting to the Senior Manager for Data & AI Products and will be one of the first hires in the team but, rest assured, you will not be working solo! You will work very closely with other Engineers and Data Scientists, each bringing distinctive skills while you bring applied AI engineering and data context. Together, the team covers the full chain from data to shipped product.

Your core focus is on building and shipping AI-powered features, with a strong collaborative element across Product Engineering, AI Platform, and Data & ML Platform teams.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Applied AI Engineer you will:

  • Build and ship AI-powered product features for Pleo’s customers, owning outcomes end-to-end for a scoped area.

  • Design and build end-to-end RAG systems for specific product use cases: chunking strategies, embedding model selection, retrieval optimisation, and quality evaluation.

  • Own the full AI-product lifecycle: prompt design, context and state management, agentic loops, output parsing, edge case handling, and safe production deployment.

  • Build evaluation datasets and automated eval pipelines that give the team confidence in AI feature quality before and after changes.

  • Instrument AI features for production observability: logging, drift detection, quality monitoring, and alerting.

  • Collaborate with Product and Design to scope AI features from first principles; you are a co-author of what gets built, not just an implementer of specs.

  • Partner with our GenAI Platform team to identify infrastructure needs and champion adoption of platform tooling.

  • Support other engineers through reviews, pairing, and pragmatic technical leadership on the projects you lead.

What you bring

You will thrive in this role if you have:

  • Proven experience shipping customer-facing AI features using LLMs; beyond prototype stage and into real production systems with real users.

  • Deep practical experience with RAG system design and the full retrieval pipeline: embedding models, vector databases, chunking, hybrid search, re-ranking.

  • Experience building and operating evaluation frameworks for LLM-based systems; you have a systematic approach to measuring quality.

  • Strong Python engineering; your code is production-grade, tested, and maintainable.

  • Experience building APIs and data retrieval pipelines that feed context into AI systems.

  • Enough data intuition to reason about data quality, schema, and retrieval architecture without needing a dedicated data engineer beside you at all times.

  • Experience with agentic system patterns: tool use, multi-step orchestration, error handling in LLM workflows.

  • Familiarity with public cloud providers (AWS, GCP)

  • We operate a polyglot platform, with components written in Kotlin and Python. While this role is Python-focused, you will need from time to time to contribute in a Kotlin stack, so being open to that is important.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You have strong product instincts and build with the user in mind. You understand that a model is only as good as the problem it solves.

  • You have moved past prototyping and have a deep understanding of the realities of LLMOps, data retrieval, prompt and context engineering, as well as model evaluation in production.

  • You don't just call APIs, you understand the data feeding the AI system and can reason about data quality, architecture, and retrieval without needing a dedicated data engineer beside you at all times.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You are primarily interested in model research or algorithm development. This role is about shipping working AI features to production.

  • You need fully defined specs and a groomed backlog to operate effectively. We expect you to discover and define the problem alongside Product and Design.

  • You cannot explain AI trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders. You will regularly work with Product Managers, Designers, and business leaders who need to understand what is and isn't possible.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Familiarise yourself with our codebase, tooling and roadmap.

  • Partner with our Principal Engineer to define and own our approach to AI feature development.

  • Contribute to shaping the roadmap for tooling and features developed by our GenAI Core team.

  • Collaborate with Product and Data teams to ship a first feature to production

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills!

The location

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work.

We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Technical screening: A 15 to 30 minute call with our Talent Partner to check your knowledge of key technical topics

  3. System design interview: A 75-minute practical session with our engineers focusing on scoping and designing an AI feature

  4. Live coding interview: A 75-minute practical session with our engineers focusing on implementing your solution.

  5. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute conversation to deep dive into your knowledge and experience.

  6. Final interview: A leadership interview focusing on your behavioural, communication and collaboration skills.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

We're looking for someone with proven experience shipping customer-facing AI products who can also confidently operate at Senior level in a SaaS organisation. This means we'll be looking for evidence that you can own fairly complex technical features from design to implementation.

  • You have strong product instincts and build with the user in mind. You understand that a model is only as good as the problem it solves.

  • You have moved past prototyping and have a deep understanding of the realities of LLMOps, data retrieval, prompt and context engineering, as well as model evaluation in production.

  • You don't just call APIs, you understand the data feeding the AI system and can reason about data quality, architecture, and retrieval without needing a dedicated data engineer beside you at all times.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You are primarily interested in model research or algorithm development. This role is about shipping working AI features to production.

  • You need fully defined specs and a groomed backlog to operate effectively. We expect you to discover and define the problem alongside Product and Design.

  • You cannot explain AI trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders. You will regularly work with Product Managers, Designers, and business leaders who need to understand what is and isn't possible.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Familiarise yourself with our codebase, tooling and roadmap.

  • Partner with our Principal Engineer to define and own our approach to AI feature development.

  • Contribute to shaping the roadmap for tooling and features developed by our GenAI Core team.

  • Collaborate with Product and Data teams to ship a first feature to production

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills!

The location

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work.

We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Technical screening: A 15 to 30 minute call with our Talent Partner to check your knowledge of key technical topics

  3. System design interview: A 75-minute practical session with our engineers focusing on scoping and designing an AI feature

  4. Live coding interview: A 75-minute practical session with our engineers focusing on implementing your solution.

  5. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute conversation to deep dive into your knowledge and experience.

  6. Final interview: A leadership interview focusing on your behavioural, communication and collaboration skills.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: this is neither a research-driven nor a traditional data or software engineering role. We're looking for someone with proven experience shipping customer-facing AI products who can also confidently operate at Senior level in a SaaS organisation. This means we'll be looking for evidence that you can own fairly complex technical features from design to implementation.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

jobs.title: FAST AFTENVAGT
jobs.description:
FAST AFTENVAGT

Drømmer du om en hverdag som udekørende aftenvagt social- og sundhedshjælper der er præget af nærvær og samarbejde?

Frit Valg Svane Pleje søger social og sundhedshjælper til aftenvagt i hjemmeplejen i vores afdeling i Aalborg.

Vi har gennem den seneste tid gennemgået en rivende udvikling i vores arbejdsgange i forhold til Implementering af den nye ældrereformen – til gavn for kollegaer og borgere. Vi er kommet en lang vej og ønsker at fortsætte den gode udvikling. I Frit Valg Svane Pleje arbejder vi i teams på tværs af hele døgnet for at styrke samarbejdet kollegaer imellem og skabe den helt rigtige opmærksomhed og sparring på vores borgeres forløb og pleje.

Vi søger en kollega, der ønsker at tage del i denne udvikling og yde den bedste pleje til vores borgere. Vi tilbyder en fast stilling til vores aftenvagtteam med rig mulighed for indflydelse på egne arbejdstider, og udvikling af arbejdsområder samt kollegial sparring. Arbejdet består primært af pleje og praktisk bistand til vores borgere. Du vil få din egen rute med faste borgere.

Opgaverne som social- og sundhedshjælper er mangeartede, men overordnet kan nævnes:

·         Grundlæggende sygepleje, genoptræning og hverdagsliv med afsæt i den rehabiliterende tilgang

·         Praktisk og personlig pleje af borgeren, såsom påklædning, rengøring og personlig og praktisk bistand, der støtter borgeren i at bevare deres værdighed og tilføje livsglæde

·         Observering, test og screening af borgerne med henblik på tidlig opsporing

·         Samarbejde med borgere, kollegaer, interne og eksterne kommunale samarbejdspartner

·         Dokumentation i Cura

 

Vil du med på holdet?

Vi søger dig, der er uddannet social og sundhedshjælper og som brænder for at arbejde med borgere i eget hjem, der gennem helhjertet og professionel indsats vil gøre en stor forskel for vores borgeres hverdag og trivsel.

Vi forestiller os derudover, at:

·         Du har et kæmpe omsorgsgen, som du ønsker at sætte i spil i en stilling med ældre borgere

·         Er i stand til at arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig være en del af et team

·         Kan agere professionelt og udvise stor tålmodighed og forståelse for menneskers situation

·         Du er dygtig til at kommunikere og arbejde tværprofessionelt

·         Du kan skabe tryghed og liv gennem nærvær og dialog

·         Du er mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst

·         Du er omstillingsparat, da opgaverne er omskiftelige og det daglige arbejde kræver fleksibilitet

Vi kan tilbyde:

·         En fast stilling på 28 timer

·         Medindflydelse på dine arbejdstider og fleksibilitet

·         Et grundigt introduktionsforløb, hvor du kører sammen med en kollega den første tid og bliver oplært i vores systemer

·         Stor frihed under ansvar

·         Muligheden for kompetenceudvikling og kollegial sparring

·         En lydhør ledelse, der forstår at den enkelte medarbejder er en stærk ressource

 

Sammen skaber vi gode rammer for din ansættelse
Dit primære arbejdssted er i Aalborg, hvor du møder ind og starter din rute. Kørekort B er påkrævet, da vores ruter udelukkende er bilruter. På adressen er der mulighed for at låne en af vores firmabiler, som står til rådighed.

Ansøgning og ansættelsesforhold
Vi ønsker stillingen besat snarest muligt. Der indkaldes til samtale løbende.

Hvis du har spørgsmål eller ønsker stillingsopslaget uddybet, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Jannike Frølund 41 40 20 10 eller aalborg@Svanepleje.dk

jobs.title: Autolakerer til opstart af ny afdeling i Silkeborg
jobs.description:
Vil du være med helt fra starten og sætte dit præg på en ny afdeling?

Byens Bilpleje.com søger en dygtig og engageret autolakerer, som har lyst til at være med til at åbne og opbygge vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg.
Her får du ikke bare et almindeligt job som autolakerer. Du bliver en vigtig del af opstarten og får mulighed for at være med til at skabe gode arbejdsgange, høj kvalitet og den rette kultur i afdelingen fra første dag.

Om Byens Bilpleje.com

Byens Bilpleje.com er en af Danmarks største aktører inden for kosmetisk klargøring, autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse og udskiftning af autoglas.
Vi behandler mere end 200.000 biler om året og beskæftiger mere end 450 medarbejdere i Danmark.
Den første afdeling blev grundlagt i Vejle i 1997, og i dag har vi mere end 50 afdelinger i Danmark.
Vores ambition er at være bilejerens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Det gør vi ved at skabe værdi for vores kunder gennem effektivitet, kvalitet og fleksibilitet.

Om jobbet

Som autolakerer i vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg bliver du en central del af opstarten.
Du kommer til at arbejde med autolakering i den daglige produktion og får samtidig mulighed for at bidrage til, hvordan afdelingen skal fungere i praksis. Vi leder derfor efter dig, der både har faglig stolthed og lyst til at tage ansvar.
Du klargør bilerne til lakering ved at spartle, slibe og afdække, inden du sprøjtelakerer dem med fokus på et flot og ensartet resultat. Du er med hele vejen i processen og sikrer den sidste finish, så bilen står skarpt og ser ud som ny.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Sikre topkvalitet på det udførte arbejde 
  • Selvom du styrer dine egen opgaver, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det 
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens 
  • Sikring af høj og ensartet kvalitet
  • Bidrage til effektive arbejdsgange og processer
  • Overholde aftalte deadlines
  • Samarbejde tæt med kolleger og ledelse
  • Være med til at skabe struktur og gode rutiner i den nye afdeling
  • Bidrage aktivt til opbygningen og udviklingen af afdelingen

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du er uddannet autolakerer og har erfaring fra faget.
Det vigtigste er, at du går op i dit håndværk og afleverer et resultat, du kan være stolt af. Samtidig skal du have lyst til at være en del af en ny afdeling, hvor ikke alt nødvendigvis er fastlagt på forhånd.
Du ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger og har lyst til at være med til at bygge noget op sammen med dine nye kolleger.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du

  • Er uddannet autolakerer og har relevant erfaring
  • Har høj faglig stolthed og sans for kvalitet
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret
  • Er løsningsorienteret og tager ansvar
  • Trives i en travl og ordreproducerende hverdag
  • Er en holdspiller og bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø
  • Er fleksibel og klar på de opgaver, der følger med opstarten af en ny afdeling
  • Har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med virksomheden

Vi tilbyder

Du får en særlig mulighed for at komme med helt fra begyndelsen og være med til at sætte dit præg på vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg.
Samtidig bliver du en del af en stor organisation med erfarne kolleger og masser af faglig sparring. Selvom afdelingen er ny, står du derfor ikke alene.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • En central rolle i opstarten af en helt ny afdeling
  • Mulighed for at præge arbejdsgange og den daglige drift
  • Et stærkt fagligt fællesskab på tværs af Byens Bilpleje.com
  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling
  • En arbejdsplads med højt til loftet og godt humør
  • Grundig introduktion til virksomheden og vores processer
  • Konkurrencedygtig løn og pension
  • Mulighed for at vokse med afdelingen i takt med, at forretningen udvikler sig

Ansøg nu – før en anden snupper din plads!

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ønsker stillingen besat snarest muligt – men vi venter gerne på den rette kollega.

Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com.

Grundet GDPR modtager vi ikke ansøgninger via e-mail, og ansøgninger fremsendt på mail vil derfor ikke blive taget i betragtning.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Leon Clausen på 22 43 31 76.

jobs.title: Personliga assistenter sökes till Göteborg med omnejd
jobs.employer: Göteborgskooperativet för Independent Living, GIL ek. för.
jobs.description:
Vi söker dig som vill arbetar som personlig assistent. Du måste kunna tala och förstå svenska bra, eftersom många tjänster kräver att du skall tolka den personen du arbetar för.

Just nu har vi allt från timanställningar, extrajobb på kvällar och helger och större tjänster på 30-80 % som rullar på så länge assistansuppdraget varar. Vi har sällan tjänster som bara innebär arbete enbart på dagtid på vardagar.

Vi på rekryteringsavdelningen kommer att göra ett urval bland inkomna ansökningar och matcha lämpliga kandidater med någon av de assistansberättigade i GIL som just nu söker personal.

Att arbeta som personlig assistent kan många gånger vara olikt andra arbeten. Hur det blir beror på vem du jobbar hos och vem du är. Ni väljer varandra och bygger upp en relation som känns bra för båda. För många är tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet och utbildningar ganska ointressant, utan oftast handlar det om personkemi.

Arbetsuppgifterna för en personlig assistent beror på vem man jobbar hos. Somliga behöver mycket hjälp med kroppen, andra med knoppen. Vissa festar hårt, reser lång, har många barn. Somliga pluggar, andra jobbar. Någon hänger ofta i stallet, andra gillar hockey. Någon tycker om att måla, en annan älskar prinsesstårtor. Somliga är tystlåtna, andra snacksaliga.

Om du är intresserad av att jobba som personlig assistent i GIL, så skickar du in ett personligt brev, ditt CV och svarar på videofrågorna samt urvalsfrågorna.

Tjänsterna tillsätts löpande!

GIL samordnar personlig assistans sedan 1989. För oss handlar personlig assistans om att skapa förutsättningar för att en person med funktionsnedsättning ska kunna leva det liv hen själv vill leva. I många uppdrag är den assistansberättigade själv arbetsledare, medan andra har utsett en ställföreträdande arbetsledare. Uppdrag och roller ser olika ut beroende på verksamhet och funktion.

GIL:s kontor ger stöd inom bland annat arbetsledning, administration, ekonomi, HR och utbildning. Tillsammans bidrar vi till att vardagen fungerar för både assistansberättigade och medarbetare inom kooperativet.

För att få och behålla trygga och engagerade medarbetare satsar GIL på utbildning och gemensamma aktiviteter.

• GIL:s assistenter har kollektivavtal med Fremia–Kommunal

• Friskvårdsbidrag upp till 2 500 kr/år

• Individuell lönesättning

• Utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister ska visas upp vid anställning

Skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, då urval sker löpande.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
jobs.description:
Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer Case Execution
jobs.description:
About Pivotal Health

Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, theyâre often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.

Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement theyâre entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.

Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. Weâre building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers.

This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, workflow-driven backend problems and working through data-heavy decision logic. The most technically demanding areas for this team are eligibility and batching, and the right person is energized by that kind of work rather than looking to avoid it.

What You'll Do

  • Build and improve core case execution systems: Own backend development across eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These are the systems that determine how cases move through Pivotal's platform and reach resolution.

  • Tackle complex, data-driven backend problems: Work through the decision logic and data-heavy workflows that make eligibility and batching hard, understanding not just how individual systems work, but how they interact across the broader platform.

  • Contribute to workflow orchestration: Build and improve the systems that coordinate how cases are staged, routed, and executed end to end, with a clear eye toward correctness and reliability.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with the Integrations team, Case Strategy team, and other engineering and product partners to ensure systems are well-connected and aligned with how the broader platform operates.

  • Contribute to front-end and admin workflows where needed: The role is primarily backend-focused, but you'll contribute to internal-facing UI and ops tooling where the product requires it.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong backend focus

  • Strong engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building data-heavy, workflow-oriented systems

  • Experience working on complex, data-driven decision logic or orchestration problems: you're comfortable with systems where correctness and sequencing both matter

  • Comfortable operating in a collaborative, fast-moving startup environment where ownership and requirements evolve

  • Python experience; able to work effectively in a Python-based backend environment

  • Self-directed and proactive: you identify problems and drive them to resolution without heavy oversight

  • Strong communicator who collaborates well across engineering, product, and adjacent teams

Extra Credit If You Have

  • Experience with healthcare-specific data or HealthTech systems

  • Exposure to data-heavy architectures or problems adjacent to data engineering without being a pure data engineer

  • Familiarity with tools like Snowflake, dbt, or Databricks

  • Some front-end experience to support admin workflow contributions

Why Youâll Love Working Here

Weâre a collaborative, low-ego team on a mission to make healthcare reimbursement fairer for providers. While we primarily hire around our core hubsâLos Angeles and New Yorkâwe remain open to exceptional talent outside those regions. Remote and hybrid flexibility varies by role and team, and is outlined in each job description.

If youâre excited by solving complex problems and making a real-world impact, weâd love to hear from you.

Benefits Include:

  • Competitive compensation, including equity

  • Full health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Retirement savings plan through 401(k)

  • Flexible time off

  • Opportunities for company-wide connection and events

Ready to Make an Impact?
Weâre building something meaningful; and we want you on the team.

Bring your ideas, curiosity, and drive, and letâs transform healthcare reimbursement together.

jobs.title: Directeur / Directrice d'hôtel (H/F)
jobs.description:
Description du poste :

Hôtel des Années Folles construit en 1928, rendez-vous des artistes et écrivains, des gentlemen et des aventuriers, Le Royal Monceau - Raffles Paris incarne depuis toujours ce je-ne-sais-quoi parisien. Spontané, cultivé, audacieux : l'effervescence permanente de création et d'émotion qui y règne, attire les voyageurs en quête de vie à la française.

Ayant rouvert en 2010 comme l'hôtel de luxe le plus artistique de Paris, après une transformation complète de 2 ans par le designer Philippe Starck, c'est en 2013 que l'hôtel reçoit la distinction "Palace". Composé de 149 chambres et suites prestigieuses, dont 3 Suites Présidentielles, l'hôtel se situe à quelques minutes de l'Arc de Triomphe et des Champs-Élysées. Au Royal Monceau - Raffles Paris, l'Art est omniprésent, avec un service exclusif d'Art Concierge, une Librairie des Arts, une galerie d'art, un cinéma privé de 99 places et également une collection privée d'oeuvres d'art.

L'offre culinaire est elle aussi portée par l'esprit de créativité qui anime tout l'hôtel, de la partition sucrée du Chef et entrepreneur Yazid Ichemrahen, à l'effervescence du "Bar Long" jusqu'aux trois restaurants : "Matsuhisa Paris" dédié à la gastronomie péruvo-japonaise par l'illustre Chef Nobu et "Il Carpaccio", restaurant étoilé aux notes italiennes en collaboration avec la famille Da Vittorio. A ne pas manquer : les petits déjeuners et les brunchs d'exception du restaurant "La Cuisine". Le Raffles Spa & Wellness et sa piscine spectaculaire baignée de lumière naturelle est quant à lui un véritable havre de paix où l'on aime se perdre, pour mieux se retrouver.


Missions Améliorer la sécurité et la sûreté de l'hôtel via des moyens humains et matériels, et assurer une veille constante sur les évolutions juridiques, réglementaires et technologiques du secteur.
* Conseiller la Direction Générale sur les aspects sécuritaires et juridiques des opérations, et traiter avec discrétion les problèmes confiés par la Direction.
* Superviser et rendre compte mensuellement de la gestion administrative de son service, ainsi que du suivi et des missions de l'équipe de sécurité/sûreté.
* Participer aux appels d'offres liés à la sécurité, ainsi qu'à la rédaction et mise à jour du DUER et des plans de prévention.
* Rédiger et tenir à jour les consignes, procédures et le manuel d'urgence en matière de sécurité et sûreté.
* Contrôler les rapports de sécurité et assurer le suivi des anomalies relevées.
* Assurer la communication et coordination entre services (briefings, remontées d'information au comité de Direction) et participer aux réunions d'exploitation.
* Participer au recrutement, à la formation et à l'accompagnement des équipes, et animer les formations de sécurité (incendie, terrorisme, comportements inacceptables, etc Gérer tout événement lié à la sûreté/sécurité, faire l'interface avec les services de l'État, remonter les informations à la Direction Générale, et être présent lors des événements importants de l'établissement.

Ce descriptif de poste est non exhaustif. Le titulaire peut être amené à accomplir d'autres missions.


Exigences en matière d'aptitudes personnelles et de compétences Sens de la confidentialité
* Sang-froid et bon sens quel que soit la situation
* Diplomate
* Physionomiste
* Capacité à travailler dans un environnement international et multiculturel
* Connaissance de la législation du travail, réglementation incendie et de la législation encadrant la sécurité privée (Livre 6 du CSI)
* Connaissance sur les différentes technologies
* Maitriser la prévention et la gestion des risques et situation de crise.

Exigences en matière d'expérience Minimum 5 années d'expérience à un poste similaire dans un hôtel de catégorie équivalente.

jobs.description:
Gepassioneerd door persoonlijke groei? Geraakt door ademhaling?

Gedreven door zelfbewustzijn?

Wij zoeken jou!

Bij ZEGG (ZElfbewust Gezond Groeien) geloven we dat in elk van ons de kracht zit om bewust te groeien. Uitdagingen en problemen in het leven zien we als een stap die ons kan helpen te groeien. We vertrekken vanuit een holistische kijk en hechten belang aan het lichaam (voeding, beweging, bewust voelen), geest (cognitie, emotie, spiritualiteit) en het systeem waarin een persoon zich vindt.

Als hartcoherentiecoach zal je specifiek mensen trainen naar een betere ademhaling.

Dit kan in de praktijk zijn, in een bedrijf of in een praktijk waar we mee samenwerken.

Je doet dit aan de hand van individuele sessies, groepssessies of het geven van vormingen. Verbaas ons met jouw kwaliteiten!

Je werkt in een multi-disciplinair team. Samen met je collega's kan je trajecten uitwerken voor je cliënt waarbij je aandacht hebt voor de andere disciplines.

Deze vacature is voor zelfstandige of voor flexijob. We mikken op een 12 tot 16 uur per maand.

CENTAR ZA PRUŽANJE USLUGA U ZAJEDNICI ZADAR ULICA IVANA MEŠTROVIĆA 3 23000 ZADAR Klasa :VUP-000-08/26-01/3 Ur. broj: 2198-409-01-04-26-15 Zadar, 17. kolovoza 2026. Na temelju prethodne suglasnosti Ministarstva rada, mirovinskoga sustava, obitelji i socijalne politike (Klasa: 100-01/26-02/104, Ur. broj: 524-09-01-02-01/2-65-2) od 27. veljače 2026. godine, na temelju Pravilnika o unutarnjoj sistematizaciji Centra za pružanje usluga u zajednici Zadar, koji je donesen 10. srpnja 2025. godine, na temelju čl. 35 Statuta Centra za pružanje usluga u zajednici Zadar ( dalje u tekstu Centar), koji je donesen 11. kolovoza 2023. godine, na temelju članka 16. Kolektivnog ugovora za djelatnost socijalne skrbi (NN 61/18, NN 3/19) od 11. srpnja 2018., na temelju Pravilnika o zaštiti na radu, koji je donesen 01. srpnja 2025. godine, na temelju Zakona o zaštiti na radu (NN71/14; NN118/14; NN154/14; NN 94/18; NN 96/18) od 01. studenog 2018., ravnateljica Liana Brkić, univ.spec.act.soc. raspisuje: J A V N I N A T J E Č A J Za višeg referenta-stručnjaka zaštite na radu II-1 izvršitelj/ica na neodređeno nepuno radno vrijeme Uvjeti: -završen najmanje preddiplomski studij sa stečenim nazivom prvostupnik (baccalaureus) iz područja tehničkih, biotehničkih ili prirodnih znanosti ili iz drugog područja koje odgovara djelatnosti poslodavca Posebni uvjeti:
  • položen opći i posebni dio stručnog ispita za stručnjaka zaštite na radu ili priznat status stručnjaka zaštite na radu
  • rad na računalu
  • vozačka dozvola B kategorije
  • probni rad 4 mjeseca
Uz prijavu na natječaj (molbu) kandidati su dužni priložiti: - životopis - dokaz o stručnoj spremi i položenom stručnom ispitu - domovnica (preslika) - potvrda Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje – elektronički zapis o radnom stažu - uvjerenje da se ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od mjesec dana) Kandidati koji prema posebnim propisima ostvaruju pravo prednosti, moraju se u prijavi pozvati na to pravo, odnosno uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17, 98/19, 84/21) uz prijavu na natječaj dužni su priložiti, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Da bi kandidat ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, osoba iz članka 48. stavaka 1. – 2. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21) koji u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te ovisno o kategoriji koja se poziva na prednost pri zapošljavanju priložiti sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN 157/ 13, 152/ 14, 39/18, 32/20) uz prijavu na natječaj dužni su, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom na temelju koje se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.). Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju iz članka 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (NN 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 02/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), uz ostale dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, dužni su priložiti i odgovarajuće dokaze o ostvarivanju prava prednosti, kao rješenje ili potvrdu o priznatom statusu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, izjavu da do sada nije koristio pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja po toj osnovi te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.). Prijave s potrebnom dokumentacijom, podnose se u roku od 8 dana od dana objave natječaja u Narodnim novinama te na stranici Centra i HZZ-a, na mail adresu liana.brkic@socskrb.hr. Podnošenjem prijave na natječaj kandidati daju suglasnost Centru da kao voditelj zbirke osobnih podataka može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati njihove osobne podatke isključivo u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno propisima koji uređuju zaštitu osobnih podataka. O načinu, pravnim i drugim izvorima iz kojih će se testiranje provesti, kao i o vremenu istog, kandidati će biti obavješteni putem mrežne stranice Centra za pružanje usluga u zajednici Zadar. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu ili potpunu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom u postupku natječaja. O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obavješteni putem mrežne stranice Centra za pružanje usluga u zajednici Zadar. Ravnateljica: Liana Brkić, univ.spec.act.soc.
