jobs.title: Personlig assistent sökes till härlig 9-årig tjej i Hammarbyhöjden
jobs.description:
Är du en varm, lekfull och engagerad person som tycker om att arbeta med barn och vill göra verklig skillnad i ett barns utveckling? Då kanske du är den vi söker.

Vi söker en personlig assistent till vår 9-åriga dotter som bor med oss i Hammarbyhöjden. Tjänsten omfattar 15 timmar i veckan, främst helger och vissa eftermiddagar och kvällar. Exakta tider planeras tillsammans.

Om arbetet

Vår dotter är en glad, nyfiken och mycket social tjej med intellektuell funktionsnedsättning. Hon älskar musik, bilar, lek, bus och att vara tillsammans med människor.

Hon kommunicerar med TAKK (tecken som stöd), ljud och gester och håller just nu på att utveckla sitt ljudande och tecknande. En viktig del av ditt arbete blir därför att på ett lekfullt och naturligt sätt stötta hennes kommunikation och utveckling.

Hon har vissa motoriska svårigheter och använder ibland rullstol, men tycker mycket om att röra på sig. Du kommer därför också att uppmuntra till fysisk aktivitet, dans, lek och övningar som stärker hennes motorik.

Som personlig assistent blir du en viktig person i hennes vardag. Ditt uppdrag handlar både om att ge henne en rolig och trygg fritid och att skapa många tillfällen för utveckling genom lek och vardagliga aktiviteter.

Arbetet kan till exempel innebära att:

    leka, busa och hitta på roliga aktiviteter
    träna kommunikation genom TAKK, ljud och lek
    uppmuntra fysisk aktivitet och motorisk träning
    gå till lekparker, göra utflykter eller hitta på andra aktiviteter
    hjälpa henne att utvecklas mot ökad självständighet

Vem är du?

Vi tror att du är en person som:

    är varm, trygg och lyhörd
    tycker om att leka och har lätt för att skapa kontakt med barn
    är engagerad, positiv och initiativrik
    är pedagogisk och tycker att det är roligt att hjälpa barn att utvecklas
    har tålamod och ser möjligheter snarare än hinder
    är ansvarstagande och pålitlig

Det är meriterande om du:

    har erfarenhet av arbete med barn
    har erfarenhet av intellektuell funktionsnedsättning eller andra funktionsvariationer
    kan TAKK eller vill lära dig

Erfarenhet är dock inte det viktigaste – vi lägger stor vikt vid personlighet och engagemang.

Det här passar dig som vill ha ett meningsfullt extrajobb där du får bygga en nära relation med ett fantastiskt barn och vara med och bidra till hennes utveckling över tid. Berätta gärna i din ansökan vem du är, varför du tror att du skulle trivas i rollen och vad du tycker är roligast med att arbeta med barn.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Om rekryteringsprocessen: Vi tar löpande kontakt med intressanta kandidater och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen. Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomför vi alltid en bakgrundskontroll via Fortcheck som skickas ut till dig som kandidat via mejl och sms. Bakgrundskontrollen sker helt på dina villkor - du utför själv kontrollen och får ta del av resultatet. Du väljer sedan huruvida du vill skicka vidare informationen till oss eller avbryta.

Om du blir erbjuden den här tjänsten behöver du även visa ett utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister då Uppdragsgivaren är minderårig. Det ansöker du själv om här: Polismyndigheten (polisen.se) Det är viktigt att du väljer belastningsregistret som är för ”Arbete med barn med funktionsnedsättning”.

Om JAG som arbetsgivare: Vi har kollektivavtal med Kommunal och erbjuder alla anställda betald introduktion, fortbildning och friskvårdsbidrag. Här kan du läsa om alla förmåner du erbjuds som personlig assistent hos oss.

Som anställd i JAG gör du skillnad varje dag. Välkommen du också!

Vill du veta mer om yrket personlig assistent?

Läs mer om oss på JAG.SE

Vi är Sveriges största privata assistansanordnare som drivs utan vinstsyfte. Assistansen är särskilt utformad för personer med flera stora funktionsnedsättningar där en är den intellektuella förmågan. Organisationen har en stark ideologisk förankring som bottnar i alla människors lika värde. Namnet JAG valdes för att symbolisera varje assistansanvändares rätt att vara huvudperson i sitt liv, oavsett funktionsnedsättning. Vi finns i hela Sverige och har systerbolag i Norge och Finland.

Välkommen till oss du också!

jobs.title: Product Team Engineer - Mechanical
jobs.description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

We offer a workplace with customers and colleagues from different parts of the world, where cultures and perspectives meet and work together to achieve common goals.



Your mission



Are you interested in and willing to learn and gain a broad technical knowledge about the product family / application and work in an “Product and customer” environment? Where you will interact with - Marketing  - Production, - Aftermarket. Occasionally also with customers/customer centers to gather feedback to gain a better understanding of customer requirements, ensuring these needs are incorporated into future solutions?



Do you see that you would like to grow and, in the future, also take on a new role as product owner in R&D or marketing? Then you might be the one we are looking for!



As “Product Team Engineer” you will collaborate with a cross-functional team, comprised of diverse engineering expertise, and your main tasks will be to lead and implement solutions that will Reduce customers' total cost of ownership (TCO) by solving issues reported by customers and production on existing machine models and implement solutions that improve operator experience and overall machine performance.



Product Team Engineer will also give input regarding product strategy and roadmap and lead troubleshooting investigations in quality and Product Safety cases and continually work to improve product availability and quality through improvement suggestion to the Technical Product Responsible.



Your profile



To be successful in this role you need to have a university degree in Engineering from a relevant area or similar highly qualified documented engineering experience.



As a member of the R&D team, we expect you to be committed to contribute to growing the entire organization towards our vision and strategy, where collaboration, innovation and technology transitions are important examples.



You are customer centric, target focused, and a collaborative team player and we hope that you are curious and dare to think new.



We are searching for several positions with a few years’ experience in Mechanical system design.



You have some knowledge of the products application and are familiar with the tools that you use in your engineering role today, like Teamcenter, 3D cad, AutoCad etc.



You are comfortable in both English and Swedish both speaking and in writing.



Location and travel



This position is located in Örebro, Sweden. Occasional travel is required.

jobs.title: Saxoly Børnehus søger 2 pædagoger 1 til vuggestuen på 34 timer ugentligt og 1 til børnehaven på 35 timer ugentligt.
jobs.description:
Saxoly Børnehus vi er en del af den selvejende klynge Saxoly, en integreret institution beliggende i Saxogade og på Sønderboulevard -centralt på Vesterbro. Vi er 140 børn fordelt på 60 vuggestuebørn, 80 børnehavebørn på 2 matrikler, vi har en hytte i Hareskoven og 35 medarbejdere.

Vi lægger vægt på,
at vi som personale har en høj grad af medbestemmelse, og har indflydelse på de demokratiske værdier og processer, som hverdagslivet i Saxoly er bygget op omkring. Vi vægter at se mulighederne i hverdagen, som hele tiden byder på nye krav og udfordringer. Vi sætter fokus på et anerkendende og rummeligt pædagogisk miljø, hvor børnene mødes af omsorgsfulde og nærværende voksne. Åbenhed, humor og faglighed kendetegner Saxoly.

I vuggestuen
er vi 5 stuer og vi er inddelt i 2 teams. På hver stue er vi 2 pædagoger og 1 medhjælper. Vi har ansat 1 fast eftermiddagsflyver, der understøtter ved ferie og sygdom. Vi samarbejder og har aktiviteter på stuen og på tværs i teamet. Nærvær og omsorg er kerneværdier i Saxoly.

I børnehaven Saxogade 61
er vi 2 grupper med 20 børnehavebørn i hver gruppe.vi er pt. 4 pædagoger og 2 medhjælpere. Vi har ansat 1 fast eftermiddagsflyver, der er hos os hver anden uge, når vores bus kører afsted med 12 børn og 2 medarbejdere til vores naturgrund i Hareskoven. Det vil være en fordel at du har et kørekort til bus eller er motiveret for at tage D1 kørekort. Vi arbejder i pædagogiske læringsmiljøer med strukturereret fagligt indhold, og vi vægter et udviklingsorienteret og positivt arbejdsmiljø for både børn og voksne. Nærvær og omsorg er kerneværdier i Saxoly.

I Saxoly Børnehus arbejder vi med
  • Langsom pædagogik - som et fagligt ståsted
  • Pædagogiske måltider
  • Sproglig udvikling med fokus på dialogisk læsning, ugle og sætte ord på i alle sammenhæng og vi arbejder med sprogtrappen
  • Motorik, krop og bevægelse, sanser og rytmik i mindre grupper
  • Vi inddrager alle vores læringsmiljøer ude og inde som vi har i vores skønne omgivelser.
  • Selvhjulpenhed i hverdagen
  • Konflikt håndtering og relations dannelse.
  • Leg, læring og udvikling i nærmeste udviklings zone.
  • Hjælper børnene til at navigere i store og små børnefællesskaber.
  • Udeliv i Hareskoven

Vi tilbyder
Et dejligt arbejdsmiljø, med faglig nysgerrighed og samarbejde om opgaverne i huset.

Vi søger 2 kollegaer
der er uddannet pædagoger og brænder for det gode børneliv. Om du er erfaren eller nyuddannet er underordnet, bare du er engageret og nærværende i dit pædagogiske arbejde. I skal have overblik, høj faglighed og forståelse for inklusion og kan tage pædagogiske initiativer. Vi er en personalegruppe med mange forskellige kompetencer og måske har du en særlig kompetence, du kan bidrage med.

Faglig og personlig udvikling
vægter vi højt. Vi har en aktiv trio og MED udvalg, afholder ugentlige stuemøder, personalemøder fælles og i afdelingen, pædagogiske dage med fokus på fagligudvikling for hele klyngen og fordybelse i teamet, vi sparre med supportteam om pædagogisk praksis, vi har sundhedsordning gennem Falck Health Care og har egen P kælder.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Kontakt:
Pædagogisk leder Ditte Andersen på 20198981 og aftal gerne et besøg.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst med BUPL. Der indhentes straffeattest og børneattest på den der indstilles til stillingen.

Ansøgningsfrist: 28-09-2026 mærk ansøgning med børnehave eller vuggestue

Ansættelsessamtaler: afholdes løbende.

jobs.description:
Do you want to design the future of sustainable data centres?

Do you have the expertise to lead complex, international engineering projects?

Then you may be the Design Manager we are looking for.

Data centres play a vital role in society, and the decisions made today will shape the digital and sustainable infrastructure of tomorrow. At COWI, we are intensifying our focus on data centres and strengthening our capabilities to support clients in delivering the next generation of digital infrastructure.

We are therefore looking for a Design Manager to join us on this journey, becoming an integral part of our growing organisation and helping evolve our data centre environment through your expertise in complex projects.

As Design Manager – Data Centres, you will bring your expertise in engineering and project delivery into multidisciplinary teams, helping translate customer needs into robust and future-ready solutions.

You will be part of a professional environment experiencing rapid growth and strong strategic focus within COWI, with the opportunity to deepen your technical leadership, work on some of the largest data centre projects in the region, and actively influence how COWI delivers international data centre projects.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

    Lead the technical direction and delivery of complex data centre projects, ensuring high quality and consistency across disciplines.
    Engage strategically with customers to understand business drivers and translate them into scalable, resilient and efficient technical solutions.
    Act as technical lead and trusted advisor on major data centre programmes.
    Drive coordination across multidisciplinary teams, ensuring seamless integration of engineering, architecture and sustainability aspects.
    Support project development from early concept and feasibility through design, tender and construction phases.
    Contribute to business development, including client engagement, proposal development and market positioning.
    

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

You are driven by a fast-paced and high-energy environment and thrive when working on complex, large-scale projects where collaboration, technical excellence and clear communication are key to success.

On top of that, you will have:

    A relevant educational background in engineering (e.g. electrical, mechanical, civil or similar).
    Extensive experience working with engineering consultancy, technical advisory or complex infrastructure projects.
    Proven experience from data centre projects or other large-scale mission critical facilities.
    Demonstrated experience in leading technical teams and delivering complex engineering projects.
    Strong commercial understanding and ability to engage with senior stakeholders.
    Professional proficiency in English.

Work location

The role can be based in any of our offices across Scandinavia.

This includes offices in:

    Norway – Bergen, Trondheim, Stavanger, Oslo, Fredrikstad, Haugesund, Bodø, Tromsø, Hamar, Drammen
    Sweden – Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmö
    Denmark – Copenhagen, Kongens Lyngby, Vejle, Aarhus, Odense and Aalborg

We work in international and multidisciplinary teams, and many of our projects are delivered across offices and borders.

Do you have more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist Mette Gutte at mtgt@cowi.com

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com and www.arkitema.com where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home. With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so the role may close as soon as we find the right match.



Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Architect, France
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes.

This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value.

You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams.

The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption.

 - Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale.

 - Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation.

 - Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value.

 - Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback.

 - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path.

 - Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements.

 - Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role.

 - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria.

 - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions.

 - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows.

 - Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to write production code but you should be able to reason through technical constraints and troubleshoot effectively.

 - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value.

 - Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences.

 - Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward.

 - Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments.

 - Fluency in English and French.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience designing or deploying Agents, automations or AI-powered workflows with Customers.

 - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows.

 - Experience developing discovery methodologies, reusable delivery assets, internal tooling, packaged services or reference architectures from the ground up.

 - Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to turn field learnings into roadmap signal, reusable architecture patterns or scalable product improvements.

 - Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €106,000 - €119,000 per year.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.title: Analytical Technical Specialist
jobs.description:
Analytical Technical Specialist

​Our story goes back more than 150 years, to the chilly southern coast of Scandinavia. From our early success in Sweden and Denmark, we’ve grown into the world’s leading specialist producer of plant-based oils, employing more than 4,000 people across the globe.

We work with our customers to make the products you love even better. The oils we produce go into making your chocolate extra-creamy or putting the crunch into your croissant. And it’s not just food — we work across industries to make products that are higher quality, healthier and better for the planet.

Everything we do is about Making Better Happen™.

AAK LOCATION

This position is based on site in Karlshamn

About the role

​AAK is seeking to appoint an Analytical Technical Specialist to join our Dairy, Plant-Based and Savory Applications team at the Customer Innovation Center in Karlshamn, Sweden. The team forms part of the Applied Innovation function for Europe and plays a key role in supporting AAK’s strategic initiatives through the delivery of customer innovation projects, internal product development, and technical support during training sessions and trade shows.

As an Analytical Technical Specialist, you will serve as the team’s technical expert in analytics, responsible for planning and executing analytical studies that support Scientists, Technologists, and Technical Specialists.

In this role, you will develop analytical methods and protocols focused on the physical analysis of fats, oils, and food solutions, as well as food prototypes across a range of applications.

You will be part of a small, collaborative team driving application development within Savory, Dairy, and Plant-Based food solutions for the European market. As such, you will be expected to contribute flexibly to broader team activities, while also supporting internal training programs and customer-facing initiatives.

​Responsibilities

Take an active role in executing analytical work for food application projects, following established procedures and guidelines to support problem-solving, product improvement, and the development of new solutions in close collaboration with Customer Innovation Managers.

​Perform routine analytical, experimental, and investigative work in line with agreed research plans and project timelines, using key analytical techniques.

​Set up and operate laboratory test equipment, develop and optimize analytical methods, evaluate and interpret test data, and prepare detailed technical reports with clear conclusions and recommendations.

​Carry out routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and calibration of laboratory equipment to ensure the Dairy, Savory, and Analytical laboratories operate efficiently.

​Collaborate closely with Global Innovation teams to implement and harmonize global analytical standards across regional Customer Innovation Centers and networks.

​Support customer and partner visits, as well as the delivery of technical training sessions for customers and colleagues, promoting best practices and consistent execution across teams.

​Maintain and continuously expand technical expertise by staying informed on emerging scientific developments, analytical technologies, and industry innovations relevant to food applications and research.

​About you

​University degree in Analytical Chemistry, Technical Analytical Chemistry, Food Science and Technology, or a related scientific discipline.

​Minimum of 5 years’ experience performing physical and/or chemical analyses within a laboratory or food application environment.

​Minimum of 5 years’ experience managing and maintaining laboratory equipment to ensure reliable performance and compliance with laboratory standards.

​Proven experience in the operation, maintenance, calibration, and troubleshooting of analytical laboratory equipment.

​Professional experience working within B2B and/or B2C environments, ideally within the food, ingredients, or related industries.

​Solid understanding of oils and fats chemistry, including relevant analytical methods and applications.

​Strong analytical thinking, organizational capabilities, and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and scientific accuracy.

​Collaborative team player who is comfortable working in a small team environment and supporting colleagues with both laboratory activities and technical expertise.

​Self-motivated, creative, and solution-oriented, with an innovative mindset and a proactive approach to continuous improvement.

​Demonstrates a sense of urgency and is comfortable managing complexity, uncertainty, and competing priorities in a dynamic environment.

​Driven to challenge existing ways of working and identify opportunities for improvement and innovation.

​Customer-oriented and business-focused, with the ability to balance technical excellence with commercial objectives.

​Experience working within a matrix organization, with the ability to communicate and collaborate effectively.

​Strong written and verbal communication skills, with proficiency in both Swedish and English.

In return AAK offers

​Join a pioneering company in specialty oils and fats, driving innovation and sustainability.

​In AAK you can work across 25+ countries, gaining international exposure and collaborating with a diverse team.

​Join a diverse and inclusive workplace that values every individual's perspective and talents.

​Contact and information

​For further information about the position, please contact Conor Kelly, Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist: conor.kelly@aak.com.

About AAK

Everything AAK does is about Making Better Happen™.

We specialize in plant-based oils that are the value-adding ingredients in many of the products people love to consume. We make these products better tasting, healthier, and more sustainable. At the heart of AAK’s offer is Customer Co-Development, combining our desire to understand what better means for each customer, with the unique flexibility of our production assets, and deep knowledge of many products and industries, including Chocolate and confectionery, Bakery, Dairy, Plant-based Foods, Special Nutrition, Foodservice and Personal Care. Our 4,000 employees support our close collaboration with customers through 25 regional sales offices, 15 dedicated Customer Innovation Centers, and the support of more than 20 production facilities. Listed on Nasdaq Stockholm and with our headquarters in Malmö, Sweden, AAK has been Making Better Happen™ for more than 150 years.

Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes.

This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value.

You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams.

The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption.

 - Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale.

 - Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation.

 - Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value.

 - Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback.

 - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path.

 - Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements.

 - Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role.

 - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria.

 - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions.

 - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows.

 - Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to write production code but you should be able to reason through technical constraints and troubleshoot effectively.

 - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value.

 - Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences.

 - Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward.

 - Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience designing or deploying Agents, automations or AI-powered workflows with Customers.

 - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows.

 - Experience developing discovery methodologies, reusable delivery assets, internal tooling, packaged services or reference architectures from the ground up.

 - Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to turn field learnings into roadmap signal, reusable architecture patterns or scalable product improvements.

 - Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €106,000 - €119,000 per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

Do you want to be part of an ambitious and collaborative team, building world-class simulation technology used in real industrial applications?

Advanced Simulation Software Developer



Digital Products Engineering is responsible for SKF’s portfolio of engineering and simulation software. We work closely with product development, research, application engineering, and customers worldwide to push the boundaries of bearing simulation.

In our Gothenburg-based team, you will contribute to the development of Beast (BEAring Simulation Tool) — SKF’s most advanced simulation platform, used for analysis and prediction of bearing application performance.



Key responsibilities

    Drive the development and verification of new simulation technology

    Engage with product development and application engineering to ensure we deliver measurable impact on product performance, engineering efficiency, and business decisions
    Contribute to the exploration and integration of AI to enhance simulation software capabilities and engineering efficiency
    Contribute to the definition and evolution of simple, efficient, and modern design principles
    Provide advanced technical support in complex customer cases



Requirements

You will enjoy working here if you:

    thrive in a collaborative, engaged, knowledge-sharing environment

jobs.title: Arbetsterapeut till Arbetsmarknads- och vuxenutbildningsförvaltningen
jobs.description:
Vill du ha meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter som gör skillnad i människors liv? Välkommen till kommunen som är långt ifrån lagom!

Arbetsmarknads- och vuxenutbildningsförvaltningen arbetar för att fler Botkyrkabor ska få förutsättningar att nå egen försörjning genom arbete, studier eller andra vägar till ett självständigt liv.Förvaltningen ansvarar för kommunens arbetsmarknadsinsatser, daglig verksamhet, komvux, yrkeshögskola samt studie- och yrkesvägledning.

Vid årsskiftet blir gymnasieskolan en del av förvaltningen, vilket stärker sambandet mellan utbildning, arbetsmarknad och kompetensförsörjning. Förvaltningen har cirka 400 medarbetare och växer till närmare 800 efter årsskiftet. Genom samverkan med näringsliv, utbildningsanordnare och andra aktörer utvecklar vi verksamheter som möter både individens och arbetsmarknadens behov.

Tjänsten och arbetsuppgifterna

Vill du bidra med din professionella kompetens i en verksamhet som skapar reella möjligheter till arbete och studier för Botkyrkabor? Vi söker en arbetsterapeut som vill vara med och bygga upp Arbetsmarknadsenhetens nya arbetssätt inom ramen för ReBootkyrka och det kommande aktivitetskravet.

I rollen som arbetsterapeut arbetar du nära individer som står långt ifrån arbetsmarknaden och bidrar med professionella bedömningar av arbetsförmåga och aktiviteter. Ditt uppdrag är att identifiera individens förutsättningar, hinder och möjligheter i relation till arbete och meningsfull aktivitet. Arbetet innebär både individuella bedömningar och ett konsultativt stöd till kollegor och samarbetspartners, där dina underlag ligger till grund för planering, matchning och beslut om vidare insatser. Du blir en av två arbetsterapeuter på enheten, vilket skapar goda möjligheter till kollegialt lärande, erfarenhetsutbyte och stöd i det dagliga arbetet.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:

    utreda och göra bedömningar av deltagarnas arbetsförmåga och aktiviteter genom strukturerade observationer och evidensbaserade bedömningsinstrument
    identifiera hinder och möjligheter i relation till arbete samt föreslå konkreta anpassningar av arbetsmiljö, arbetsuppgifter eller arbetstid
    arbeta konsultativt gentemot arbetsinstruktörer och gruppaktivitetsledare i de praktiska verksamheterna för att bidra till en hållbar arbetsmiljö samt som stöd till andra funktioner i arbetet med deltagarna
    genomföra aktivitetsanalyser för att matcha individens förutsättningar mot lämpliga arbetsuppgifter internt eller externt
    samverka med olika parter och bidra med bedömningsunderlag för fortsatt planering mot arbete, studier eller annan relevant insats
    dokumentera och skriva professionella utlåtanden som används i samverkan med exempelvis Försäkringskassan, vården och andra myndigheter.

Vi erbjuder dig

Du blir en del av en ny enhet inom arbetsmarknads- och vuxenutbildningsförvaltningen som är under uppbyggnad. Här arbetar arbetsterapeuter, arbetsinstruktör och andra professioner i nära samverkan kring individen. Tillsammans utvecklar ni individanpassade aktiviteter och insatser med fokus på hållbara stegförflyttningar mot arbete eller studier. Enheten befinner sig i en utvecklingsfas där arbetssätt, samverkansformer och strukturer successivt formas, vilket ger utrymme för dialog, samarbete och gemensamt lärande.

Hos oss får du möjlighet att utvecklas i din yrkesroll tillsammans med en kollega där du får vara med och forma en ny verksamhet. Du ges förutsättningar att fördjupa din kompetens inom arbetsförmågebedömning, samverkan och individanpassade insatser, samtidigt som det finns möjlighet att bredda din erfarenhet genom samarbete med andra professioner och aktörer. På sikt kan rollen även öppna upp för fördjupning inom särskilda målgrupper, metodutveckling eller ett utökat ansvar i verksamhetens utvecklingsarbete, beroende på verksamhetens behov och ditt eget intresse.

Du som söker till oss

Du är legitimerad arbetsterapeut med akademisk examen och legitimation utfärdad av Socialstyrelsen. Du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med individer som står långt ifrån arbetsmarknaden och är trygg i att bedöma aktivitets- och arbetsförmåga som underlag för vidare planering mot arbete, studier eller annan relevant insats.

Övriga krav:

    Erfarenhet av arbetsförmågebedömning och vana att använda relevanta bedömningsinstrument, exempelvis AWP, DOA, WRI eller motsvarande.
    Erfarenhet av att arbeta med personer med psykisk ohälsa, fysiska eller intellektuella funktionsnedsättningar samt neuropsykiatriska diagnoser (NPF).
    Erfarenhet av att analysera och dokumentera bedömningar i tydliga, strukturerade och rättssäkra utlåtanden.
    Erfarenhet av att kommunicera tydligt och pedagogiskt samt av att förmedla bedömningar till deltagare, kollegor och samverkande aktörer.
    Erfarenhet av att arbeta konsultativt och i samverkan med andra professioner.

Vi ser det som meriterande om du har:

    Erfarenhet av arbete inom kommunal verksamhet, Arbetsförmedlingen, Försäkringskassan eller företagshälsovård.
    Utbildning eller erfarenhet av motiverande samtal (MI).
    Utbildning i Supported Employment (SE) och/eller Individanpassat stöd till arbete (IPS).

För att lyckas i rollen behöver du vara samarbetsorienterad i nära samarbete med arbetsmarknadscoacher, arbetsinstruktörer och andra professioner kring individen. Du delar bedömningar och iakttagelser på ett tydligt sätt och bidrar aktivt till gemensamma beslut och en sammanhållen planering. Rollen kräver att du är analytisk och kan se samband mellan individens förutsättningar, aktivitetskrav och arbetsmiljö. Du tolkar observationer och bedömningsresultat på ett systematiskt sätt och omsätter dem till välgrundade rekommendationer som ger stöd i individens fortsatta steg.

Du behöver också vara strukturerad i hur du planerar, genomför och följer upp bedömningar. Dokumentationen håller hög kvalitet och dina utlåtanden är tydliga, rättssäkra och lätta att använda i samverkan med andra aktörer.

Eftersom verksamheten är under uppbyggnad är det viktigt att du är lösningsorienterad och kan hitta praktiska, hållbara anpassningar i vardagen. Du bidrar till att utveckla arbetssätt och skapa lösningar som fungerar både för individen och verksamheten på kort och lång sikt.

jobs.title: Community Lead
jobs.description:
Do you have a strong understanding of contemporary fashion and culture and a natural instinct for bringing people together?

ONLY BRAND HOUSE is looking for a Community Lead to shape, grow and strengthen the communities around our brand.

From intimate community gatherings and creative partnerships to larger-scale events and brand activations, this role will create experiences that bring ONLY BRAND HOUSE into the real world and give people meaningful reasons to engage with and participate in the brand.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
As our Community Lead, you will develop meaningful relationships between ONLY BRAND HOUSE and the people, places and cultural communities surrounding our brand.
You will work across multiple European markets, building an international network of creatives, tastemakers, cultural connectors, ambassadors and brand advocates who authentically connect with ONLY BRAND HOUSE. A particular focus will be on developing our community presence within French-speaking markets.

Working closely with Brand, Creative, Social, Communications and our local markets, you will turn cultural insights and relationships into relevant experiences, partnerships and activations. Your key responsibilities include:

  • Develop and execute ONLY's community strategy across key markets

  • Build long-term relationships with creatives, tastemakers, cultural connectors and brand advocates

  • Identify emerging communities, people and cultural movements relevant to ONLY

  • Develop and execute events, gatherings, launches, pop-ups and cultural activations from concept to delivery

  • Build ONLY's community presence within French-speaking markets

  • Develop creative partnerships with relevant talent, venues, organisations and complementary brands

  • Collaborate with Social and Communications on talent, seeding and organic brand relationships

  • Track community growth, engagement and impact while bringing relevant cultural insights back into the wider Brand team

WHY JOIN ONLY BRAND HOUSE?
This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping how ONLY BRAND HOUSE builds communities and shows up in culture across international markets. You will have the opportunity to:

  • Shape and develop ONLY’s international community approach

  • Build long-term relationships with creatives, tastemakers and cultural connectors

  • Turn ideas and cultural opportunities into real-world experiences and activations

  • Work across markets and bring local insights and perspectives into the brand

  • Join a collaborative Brand team where new ideas and perspectives are encouraged

ABOUT YOU
You are a connector by nature. You genuinely enjoy meeting people, building relationships and bringing different communities together. At the same time, you know how to turn an idea into reality and are comfortable owning events and projects from concept through to execution. We imagine that you:

  • Have 3–5 years of experience in community, events, experiential marketing, cultural marketing, PR or a related field

  • Have a strong understanding of contemporary fashion and culture

  • Have experience developing and executing events, activations or community initiatives

  • Understand the difference between building a community and simply building an audience

  • Are proactive, highly organised and comfortable balancing relationship-building with execution

  • Are professionally fluent in both English and French

  • Experience working across European markets and an existing network within fashion, creative or cultural communities are both considered strong advantages.

INTERESTED?
If you have any questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Head Of Creative, Joshua Mark Bredehoeft on +45 71990213. Otherwise, send us your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than September 10th, 2026. We review applications continuously and reserve the right to close the position once we have found the right candidate.

LOCATION: Brande, Denmark

jobs.title: Pædagogisk assistent søges til barselsvikariat i Børnehuset ved Grøften
jobs.description:
Brænder du for at gøre en forskel i små børns liv? Og trives du i et fagligt stærkt og engageret fællesskab?
Så er det måske lige dig, vi leder efter!

Om stillingerne
Vi søger en pædagogisk assistent til et barselsvikariat på 37 timer. 

Du bliver en del af et hus, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og arbejdsglæde går hånd i hånd. 

Vi forventer, at du er fleksibel og kan se dig selv i både vuggestue og børnehave.

Du bliver tilknyttet en vuggestuegruppe. Her vil du arbejde tæt sammen med kollegaer fra både egen og andre stuer. Du vil være den primære kontakt til stuens forældre sammen med dine kollegaer på stuen.

Vi søger en kollega, der:

  • Kan lege og aktivt bruger legen som pædagogisk redskab til at skabe trivsel, udvikling og dannelse og et trygt børnefællesskab
  • Kan stå alene med en mindre børnegruppe
  • Er nærværende og autentisk i relationen med børnene
  • Er stabil, loyal og trives i et arbejdsfællesskab på tværs af stuer og afdelinger
  • Er fleksibel inden for husets åbningstider (kl. 6.30–17.00) og kan deltage i aftenmøder ca. en gang om måneden
  • Bidrager positivt til både forældresamarbejdet, den pædagogiske udvikling i huset og det sociale fællesskab

Vi tilbyder:

  • Et hus med stærke faglige traditioner og stort fokus på udvikling
  • Mulighed for indflydelse og ansvar i det daglige arbejde
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor trivsel og arbejdsmiljø prioriteres højt

Om Børnehuset ved Grøften
Børnehuset ved Grøften er en integreret institution for børn i alderen 0–6 år. Vi har tre vuggestuegrupper og tre børnehavegrupper, og vores fællesskab består af 24 engagerede medarbejdere og én daglig leder.

Vi er en del af Dagtilbudsområde Syd i Næstved Kommune, som omfatter 12 dagtilbud med en fælles områdeleder. I 2026 arbejder vi særligt med at styrke børnefællesskaber og leg som centrale pædagogiske fokusområder. Derudover er vi en del af et stort forskningsprojekt, den styrkede sprogvurdering ”Vi lærer sammen”.

Med Socialstyrelsens normeringsløft har vi fået tilført ekstra ressourcer, som giver os endnu bedre muligheder for at udvikle og kvalificere det pædagogiske arbejde.

Derudover samarbejder vi tæt med tværfaglige eksperter som specialpædagogiske vejledere, psykologer, ergoterapeuter og tale-hørekonsulenter.

Du kan se job- og personprofilen her.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst indgået mellem KL og FOA.

Oplysninger om startløn og forventet løninterval 
Via linket her kan ses oplysninger om relevant løninterval for den konkrete stilling. I oversigten vælges Næstved Kommune, hvilken stillingskategori (overenskomst) du ansøger til og yderligere hvilken stilling du søger. I tabellen derunder kan ses de relevante oplysninger for den konkrete stilling.

Tiltrædelse d. 5. oktober 2026.

Arbejdstid pr. uge: 37 timer.

Vil du vide mere, er du velkommen til at kontakte daglig leder Maiken Mouridsen på telefon 2165 6781.

Ansøgningsfrist mandag d. 31. august 2026. 

Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes: Løbende.

Du søger stillingen ved at sende din ansøgning, CV og anden relevant dokumentation og uddannelsesbevis elektronisk via ansøgerknappen ”Ansøg”.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

jobs.description:
Anzet A/S søger for kunde i Hvidovre en dygtig og ansvarsbevidst Chauffør med CE-kørekort, som har erfaring med maskintransport og lyst til at blive en del af en professionel hverdag, hvor kvalitet og god kundeservice er i fokus.

Virksomheden har mange års erfaring med udlejning af entreprenørmateriel og har afdelinger flere steder i Danmark. Det betyder, at du bliver en del af en organisation med godt styr på tingene – men hvor den enkelte medarbejder samtidig spiller en vigtig rolle i den daglige drift.

Som chauffør får du en vigtig rolle i at få maskiner og materiel sikkert frem til kunderne.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har godt kendskab til entreprenørmaskiner og materiel, men det vigtigste er, at du er en stabil og erfaren chauffør, der tager ansvar for både køretøj, materiel og kunder og kan møde fra kl. 04.00 om morgenen.

Du får en hverdag i en virksomhed, hvor der er brug for dygtige medarbejdere, som kan få tingene til at fungere i praksis.

  • Gode og ordnede arbejdsforhold

Send dit CV hurtigst muligt – vi afholder løbende samtaler og kan besætte stillingen inden ansøgningsfristens udløb.

Personale-match varetager rekrutteringsprocessen.
Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Rekrutteringskonsulenter på tlf. 70 70 18 28.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellowship for the project “Truth, Information, Democracy and Law”
jobs.description:
Job description

A Postdoctoral Research Fellowship (SKO 1352) is available as part of the project Truth, information, democracy and law (TIDAL) - Department of Private Law (TIDAL) funded by the Research Council of Norway (RCN) and Norid AS. 

The fellow will be responsible for their own research and work closely with the TIDAL team at the Norwegian Research Center for Computers and Law - Department of Private Law, UiO (NRCCL).

The project runs from April 2026 until March 2030. In addition to researchers at the NRCCL, the project team includes researchers at Queen Mary University of London, University of Bergen, University of Tromsø, Lund University, Bond University, BI Norwegian Business School, and Boston University. 

At the NRCCL, the core project team comprises four people, including the postdoctoral fellow. The project is led by Professor Lee A. Bygrave.

The appointment period lasts three years without teaching and administrative duties, or four years with teaching and administrative duties making up 25% of the total workload. 

A four-year fellowship requires that the candidate can contribute to the Faculty of Law's current teaching needs. 

If the Postdoctoral Fellow does not already have qualifications that meet the requirements for an associate professor position, UiO shall facilitate the acquisition of such competence during the employment period.


More about the position

The TIDAL project concerns the legal preconditions for a well-functioning democracy in an age marked by increasing generation and dissemination of disinformation, misinformation, and other forms of information disorder (ID). Drawing upon cross-disciplinary insights and approaches, including a policy field study of stakeholder viewpoints in Norway and the United Kingdom, the project tackles the fundamental question of whether the law needs to be reformed in order to tackle ID more effectively and, if yes, what avenue(s) of reform would be most sensible. It does so in light of the vexing problem that measures to combat ID in the name of securing or promoting democracy can end up undermining democracyʼs bedrock by tightening various freedoms and accountability frameworks that help buttress democracy and the rule of law. 

The TIDAL project not only examines how best to overcome the latter problem, but elucidates a range of other related matters. These include: the effects of recent legal initiatives by the European Union (EU) to curb ID; the interaction of hard law and soft law codes in this regulatory domain; and current geopolitical tensions at the global level over appropriate legal-regulatory strategies for tackling ID. 

At a more fundamental jurisprudential level, the project interrogates the relationship between law and the promotion of truth, analysing the borderlines between when law penalizes the dissemination of lies, “untruths” and other false or misleading information and when it abstains from doing so, along with the rationale(s) for either course of action.

As part of elucidating the relationship of ID and the law with a view to identifying optimal regulatory strategies for reducing the deleterious effects of ID, the project pursues five main sub-objectives:

(1) to map the non-legal structural factors causing ID, drawing upon scholarship in the social sciences and information sciences;

(2) to develop an holistic understanding of ID that bridges insights from the social sciences and information sciences with insights from legal-regulatory scholarship;

(3) to assess how the law, in light of these insights, currently facilitates and impedes ID;

(4) to evaluate what role law should play to remedy ID in the future and to develop and assess new norms, legal concepts, and regulatory frameworks, innovating legal treatment of ID;

(5) to assess the legal innovations within the wider geopolitical situation which Norway finds herself in, with a view to minimizing jurisdictional “overreach”.

The postdoctoral fellow is expected to work closely with TIDAL team members in pursuing the above-listed objectives. The postdoctoral fellow is also expected to engage in international dissemination activities and collaborate with key scholars in the field, outside the project group. Part of these activities will involve participation in the collection, coding, and analysis of data from policy field studies, writing research articles and other publications (e.g. book chapters, blogposts), participating in the ongoing reporting from the project, and assisting the project leader in the daily operation of the project.


Qualification requirements
  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree (PhD) in Law or another relevant social science discipline, such as Political Science or Sociology.
  • Applicants must have submitted their doctoral dissertation for evaluation at the time of application and the dissertation must be approved by the time of appointment.
  • Applicants must have an excellent command of English, necessary for publishing in high-level international journals and participating in international conferences, seminars, and similar events; additionally, an excellent command of Norwegian, alternatively Danish or Swedish, necessary for studying Norwegian policy discourse, is an advantage.
  • Applicants must have a demonstrated knowledge of, and experience with, research containing significant cross- and interdisciplinary elements.
  • Experience with carrying out policy field studies is desirable.
  • Experience with legal research containing significant cross-jurisdictional elements, especially in relation to the regulation of information flows, is desirable.

Personal skills
  • Applicants must be able to work independently and in a structured manner.
  • Applicants should possess good collaborative skills and demonstrate the ability, willingness, and commitment to contribute to the development of the research field.
  • Applicants should be able to take initiative and actively participate in an international and multidisciplinary research team.

Assessment of the applicants

In assessing applicants, priority will be given to their academic achievements, previous relevant publications, the project description, and their professional and personal qualifications, especially regarding their ability to complete the proposed project within the specified timeframe.

Applicants who progress through the selection process will be invited to interview for the position, either in person or digitally.

Applicants are assessed by an assessment committee that ranks them according to the above criteria and interviews the most suitable candidates. A separate interview committee may be used. The final decision is made by the faculty’s appointment board.

The applicant must submit a project description but a final plan for the research of the postdoctoral fellow will be developed in consultation with the project leader following the appointment.


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • Committed colleagues and an inspiring, friendly, and inclusive working environment.
  • Pension scheme in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Research Fellow (SKO 1352) in the range NOK 610 000 - 690 000 depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.
     

The application must include
  • A cover letter describing the applicant’s qualifications and motivation for the position.
  • A project description of 4-7 pages (excluding the list of references) outlining how they would approach their research tasks within a 3-year project plan. This should include a description of the theoretical background, objectives, methodologies, and reflections on potential ethical challenges. The proposal must clearly demonstrate how the research will contribute to the aims of the TIDAL project. Further information on the project aims can be received from the project leader upon request.
  • A CV providing a comprehensive overview of education, previous positions, teaching experience, list of publications, and other relevant activities.
  • Copies of diplomas with all grades included in the degree and certificates (if the original language of diplomas/certificates is not English or a Scandinavian language, an English language translation must be provided in addition to a copy of the original). Foreign diplomas must include official documentation about the grading system, together with the official grading scale.
  • Up to three academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered. If a publication has been authored by multiple individuals, the division of work must be documented with a declaration from the co-author(s).
  • Names and contact details for at least two references.
  • A written assessment of the doctoral dissertation may also be submitted. If the assessment is not ready in time for the application deadline, the assessment can be submitted after deadline.

Please note that all documents must be in English or a Scandinavian language. The application with attachments must be submitted through our electronic recruitment system; please follow the link “apply for this job”. The tentative starting date is January 2027.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


General information

Please see the guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at the University of Oslo. 

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Fellowship period at the University of Oslo. 

According to the Norwegian Freedom of Information Act §25 information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. 

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of Private Law (IFP) was established in 1955 and is one of the five departments that together comprise the Faculty of Law. The department is the largest Norwegian academic milieu working directly with private law subjects.

jobs.title: Rengøringsleder til Renseri
jobs.description:
Vi søger en engageret og struktureret Rengøringsleder til vores renseri hos Renserierne.DK ApS, ,Vester Farimagsgade 3 , 1606 København V

Som Rengøringsleder får du en central rolle i den daglige drift, hvor du sikrer, at arbejdsopgaver planlægges, koordineres og udføres effektivt. Du bliver bindeled mellem virksomhedens ejer og medarbejderne og bidrager til en høj kvalitet i både driften og kundeservicen.

Stillingen er en driftskoordinerende funktion uden personale- eller HR-ansvar. Du har ikke ansvar for ansættelser eller afskedigelser, men du har ansvar for at sikre en effektiv daglig drift, høj service og et godt samarbejde mellem medarbejderne.

Ansættelsen forudsætter, at du til enhver tid har gyldig arbejdstilladelse, hvis dette kræves.

Arbejdsopgaver

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Overvåge og koordinere virksomhedens daglige driftsaktiviteter for at sikre en smidig og effektiv arbejdsgang.

  • Koordinere medarbejdernes arbejdsplaner og sikre tilstrækkelig bemanding i forhold til den daglige drift og kundernes behov.

  • Vejlede og støtte medarbejderne i det daglige arbejde for at sikre høj kvalitet og effektiv kundeservice.

  • Modtage og betjene kunder, besvare henvendelser samt modtage servicebestillinger.

  • Håndtere kundefeedback og klager professionelt og sikre hurtig opfølgning.

  • Sikre en effektiv kommunikation mellem medarbejderne og virksomhedens ejer om den daglige drift.

  • Overvåge virksomhedens kundeservice og den samlede driftseffektivitet.

  • Følge kundetilfredsheden og komme med forslag til forbedringer af kundeoplevelsen.

  • Identificere daglige driftsmæssige udfordringer og foreslå praktiske løsninger, der styrker den operationelle effektivitet.

  • Bidrage med idéer til salgsfremmende aktiviteter og forretningsudvikling med henblik på at tiltrække nye kunder og understøtte virksomhedens vækst.

  • Sikre, at de daglige arbejdsopgaver udføres rettidigt og bidrage til et organiseret, sikkert og effektivt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Repræsentere virksomheden professionelt i kontakten med kunder.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har erfaring fra renseri, vaskeri, rengøringsbranchen eller en anden servicevirksomhed.

  • Er struktureret og god til at koordinere den daglige drift.

  • Har stærke samarbejds- og kommunikationsevner.

  • Er serviceminded og sætter en ære i at levere en høj kundeservice.

  • Er løsningsorienteret og arbejder selvstændigt.

  • Kan bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag og sikre, at opgaver bliver løst effektivt.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og alsidig stilling med ansvar for den daglige drift.

  • Mulighed for at bidrage til udviklingen af virksomhedens arbejdsgange og kundeoplevelse.

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med korte beslutningsveje.

  • Et tæt samarbejde med virksomhedens ejer.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til vores kontaktperson, da vi akut har brug for en medarbejder i teamet.

We are looking for a dedicated and well-organised Cleaning Supervisor to join our dry-cleaning business at Renserierne.DK ApS, ,Vester Farimagsgade 3 , 1606 København V.

As a Cleaning Supervisor, you will play a key role in coordinating and overseeing the daily operations of the business. You will ensure that daily activities are carried out efficiently, customer service standards remain high, and communication between employees and the business owner runs smoothly.

This is an operational coordination role and does not include HR or personnel management responsibilities. You will not be responsible for hiring, dismissing or conducting employee performance reviews. Instead, your focus will be on ensuring efficient daily operations, service quality and workflow coordination.

Employment is subject to holding a valid work permit at all times where required.

Key Responsibilities

Your duties will include, but are not limited to:

  • Monitor and coordinate the company's daily operational activities to ensure efficient workflows.

  • Coordinate employee work schedules and ensure adequate staffing levels to meet operational and customer service needs.

  • Provide day-to-day guidance and support to employees to ensure efficient customer service and smooth operations.

  • Welcome and assist customers, respond to enquiries and receive service orders.

  • Handle customer feedback and complaints professionally and ensure timely resolution.

  • Maintain effective communication between employees and the business owner regarding daily operations.

  • Monitor customer service performance and the overall efficiency of daily operations.

  • Monitor customer satisfaction and recommend improvements to enhance the customer experience.

  • Identify operational challenges and recommend practical solutions to improve efficiency.

  • Suggest practical business development ideas and sales initiatives to support business growth and attract new customers.

  • Ensure daily tasks are completed on time while maintaining a well-organised and efficient working environment.

  • Represent the company professionally in all customer interactions.

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has experience in a dry-cleaning, laundry, cleaning or similar service business.

  • Is organised and capable of coordinating daily operations.

  • Has strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Is customer-focused and committed to delivering excellent service.

  • Is proactive, reliable and solution-oriented.

  • Can work independently while maintaining an overview in a busy working environment.

We Offer

  • A varied and responsible position with a key role in daily operations.

  • The opportunity to contribute to improving operational processes and customer satisfaction.

  • A friendly working environment with short decision-making processes.

  • Close collaboration with the business owner.

  • Salary based on qualifications and experience.

How to Apply

Please submit your application and CV as soon as possible to our contact person as we have an immediate need of getting the position filled.

jobs.title: Material Investigation Specialist
jobs.description:
SKF has been around for more than a century, and today we are one of the world’s largest suppliers of solutions for rotating equipment. Our products are found throughout society — wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions may be in use. jobs.description:
Overview

As a member of the military, Infantry Soldiers are the Armyâs primary combat fighters and are responsible for closing with and destroying the enemy. They are the core members of the Combat Arms team, which includes Artillery and Armour Soldiers.

Infantry Soldiers are capable of operating anywhere in the world in any environment â Arctic tundra, mountains, jungle or desert â and in any combination of arms, including airmobile and amphibious operations. The primary duties of Infantry Soldiers are to:

  • Expertly operate and maintain a wide range of weapons, including rifle, hand-grenades, light, medium and heavy machine-guns, and anti-tank weapons
  • Use sophisticated equipment for field communications, navigation and night-vision surveillance
  • Inspect and maintain weapon systems, vehicles, survival gear and personal defensive equipment
  • Participate in airborne operations
  • Operate with support elements such as fighter aircraft, tactical and artillery
  • Engage in unarmed combat
  • Employ camouflage and concealment, patrol, assault, defence, and escape-and-evasion tactics.


Work environment


Infantry Soldiers normally work outdoors. Both in training and on operations they live and work in conditions that would resemble those in the field. Infantry Soldiers will be posted to a battalion in Canada, but there are employment opportunities across Canada and on deployed operations around the world.

If you chose a career in the Regular Force, upon completion of all required training, you will be assigned to your first base. While there is some flexibility with regards to postings (relocations), accommodations canât always be made, and therefore, you can likely expect to move at some point in your career. However, if you decide to join the Primary Reserve Force, you will do so through a specific Reserve unit. Outside of training, your chosen Reserve unit will be your workplace on a part time basis, and you will not be obligated to relocate to a different base. As part of the Primary Reserve Force, you typically work one night per week and some weekends as a minimum with possibilities of full-time employment.

Entry plans

  • Direct Entry Options

No previous work experience or career related skills are required. CAF recruiters can help you decide if your personal interests and attributes match the criteria for this occupation.

The minimum required education to apply for this occupation is the completion of the provincial requirements for Grade 10 or Secondary 4 in Quebec.

Foreign education may be accepted.

Training

The first stage of training is the Basic Military Qualification course, or Basic Training, held at the Canadian Forces Leadership and Recruit School in Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu, Quebec. This training provides the basic core skills and knowledge common to all trades. A goal of this course is to ensure that all recruits maintain the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) physical fitness standard; as a result, the training is physically demanding.

Infantry Soldiers attend one of three Military Training Centres: The Royal Canadian Regiment in Meaford, Ontario; Princess Patriciaâs Canadian Light Infantry in Wainwright, Alberta; and the Royal 22 e RÃ©giment in Valcartier, Quebec. The training takes 17 weeks and includes the following topics:

  • Use and care of personal and section-level weapons, including rifles, machine guns and anti-tank weapons
  • Field-craft, including personal hygiene and meal preparation, camouflage, sentry duties, signalling, selecting firing positions, tactical movements and lines of advance
  • Construction of field defences, such as trenches and roadblocks, and laying and marking of minefields
  • Navigation by day and by night
  • Patrolling operations
  • Infantry section and platoon tactics, including offensive, defensive and transitional operations

Infantry Soldiers may be offered the opportunity to develop specialized skills through formal courses and on-the-job training, including:

  • Basic Parachutist
  • Parachute Jumpmaster
  • Para Instructor
  • Mountain Warfare
  • Instructional Techniques
  • First Aid Instructor
  • Rappelmaster
  • Nuclear, Biological and Chemical Defence Instructor
  • Urban Operations
  • Close Quarter Combat Instructor

As they progress in their career, Infantry Soldiers who demonstrate the required ability and potential will be offered advanced training. Available courses include:

  • Instructional Techniques
  • Primary Army Leadership
  • Infantry Section Commander
  • Infantry Platoon Second in Command
  • Infantry Company Sergeant-Major
  • Communicator
  • Reconnaissance Patrolling
  • Anti-Armour Gunner
  • Sniper
  • Machinegunner (Heavy and General Purpose)
  • Small Arms Coach
  • 25mm Gunner and light armoured vehicle Crew Commander
  • Winter (Arctic) and Jungle Operations
  • Patrol Pathfinder
  • Tactical Intelligence Operator

Part time options

This position is available for part-time employment with the Primary Reserve at certain locations across Canada. Reserve Force members usually serve part time at a Unit in their community, and may serve while going to school or working at a civilian job. They are paid during their training. They are not posted or required to do a military move. However, they can volunteer to move to another base. They may also volunteer for deployment on a military mission within or outside Canada.

Infantry Soldiers serve with the Canadian Army. They are the Armyâs primary combat fighters, are responsible for engaging the enemy and are the core members of the Combat Arms team, which includes Artillery and Armoured Soldiers. When they are employed on a part-time or casual full-time basis they usually serve at a Forces Infantry unit located within Canada.

Find a Recruiting Centre

Reserve Force members are trained to the same level as their Regular Force counterparts. They usually begin training with their home unit to ensure that they meet the required basic professional military standards. Following basic training, Infantry Soldiers attend one of three CAF training centres for 7 weeks of Infantry training.

Reserve Force members usually serve part-time with their home unit for scheduled evenings and weekends, although they may also serve in full-time positions at some units for fixed terms, depending on the type of work that they do. They are paid 92.8% of Regular Force rates of pay, receive a reasonable benefits package and may qualify to contribute to a pension plan.
