jobs.title: HR-suunnittelija
jobs.description:
Etsitkö monipuolista HR-tehtävää, jossa pääset tukemaan esihenkilöitä, ratkomaan henkilöstöhallinnon kysymyksiä ja työskentelemään erilaisten HR-prosessien ja järjestelmien parissa? Tässä tehtävässä saat vastuullesi vaihtelevia kokonaisuuksia ja pääset myös kehittämään yhteisiä toimintatapoja yhdessä muiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa.

Haemme nyt HR-suunnittelijaa Helsingin kaupunginkansliaan vakituiseen tehtävään. Tehtävän aloitus 1.10. tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Mitä pääset tässä roolissa tekemään?

Työpäiväsi HR-suunnittelijana koostuvat henkilöstöhallinnon neuvonnasta, päätösvalmistelusta, koordinoinnista ja kehittämisestä. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä esihenkilöiden, HR-asiantuntijoiden ja kaupungin yhteisten palveluiden kanssa.

Tehtävässäsi:

- neuvot esihenkilöitä henkilöstöhallinnon kysymyksissä ja autat heitä löytämään oikeat toimintatavat ja palvelut

- käsittelet HR:lle tulevia henkilöstöhallinnon kysymyksiä ja ohjaat niitä tarvittaessa oikeille asiantuntijoille

- valmistelet kaupunginkanslian ylimmän johdon henkilöstöhallintoon liittyviä päätöksiä ja huolehdit niiden etenemisestä palkanmaksuun

- tuet esihenkilöitä työaikajärjestelmän ja työaikakäytäntöjen käytössä sekä vastaat työaika- ja ylityöraportoinnista palkanmaksun aikataulujen mukaisesti

- osallistut työaikajärjestelmän kehittämiseen osana kaupunkitasoista yhteistyötä

- hoidat henkilöstöhallinnon prosesseja, jotka liittyvät esimerkiksi A1-todistuksiin, siviilipalvelukseen ja palvelusvuosiin

- toimit tarvittaessa Workday-pääkäyttäjän sijaisena

- osallistut HR-tiimin yhteiseen kehittämiseen sekä kokousten ja tilaisuuksien koordinointiin.

Tehtävässä menestymisen eväät

Tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos innostut käytännönläheisestä HR-työstä ja erilaisten henkilöstöhallinnon kysymysten ratkomisesta. Toivomme, että sinulla on:

- Kokemusta henkilöstöhallinnon tehtävistä tai henkilöstöprosesseista. Työehtosopimusten ja työlainsäädännön tulkitseminen ei aiheuta sinulle harmaita hiuksia - jos KVTES ja kunta-ala ovat sinulle entuudestaan tuttuja, olemme erityisen vaikuttuneita!

- Kykyä selvittää henkilöstöhallinnon kysymyksiä itsenäisesti ja soveltaa osaamistasi erilaisissa tilanteissa. Tartut uusiinkin kysymyksiin rohkeasti ja etsit niihin toimivia ratkaisuja.

- Kykyä hallita useita samanaikaisia tehtäviä ja organisoida omaa työtäsi. Pidät langat käsissäsi ja huolehdit siitä, että sovitut asiat etenevät loppuun asti.

- Selkeä ja sujuva tapa viestiä. Osaat sanoittaa henkilöstöhallinnon asioita ymmärrettävästi eri kohderyhmille ja neuvot esihenkilöitä luontevasti erilaisissa tilanteissa.

- Mutkaton tapa tehdä yhteistyötä. Autat mielelläsi muita, jaat osaamistasi ja arvostat avointa kommunikointia.

- Sujuvaa digiosaamista ja valmiutta ottaa haltuun uusia HR-järjestelmiä. Workday-HR-järjestelmän tuntemus ja kokemus työaikajärjestelmistä ovat tässä tehtävässä plussaa.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehtona on soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto sekä suomen kielen erinomainen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Pääset osaksi osaavaa, palvelualtista ja rempseää HR-tiimiä, jossa yhdeksänhenkinen porukka tukee ja auttaa sinua onnistumaan työtehtävissäsi. Joustoa työn tekemiseen tarjoaa liukuva työaika ja mahdollisuus etätyöskentelyyn - teemme töitä monipaikkaisesti, mutta iloitsemme erityisesti kohdatessamme toimistollamme. Viihtyisät toimitilamme sijaitsevat historiaa havisevassa kaupungintalon korttelissa.

Tehtävän määritelty peruspalkka on 3498,42 e/kk + KVTES:in mukainen työkokemuslisä 3 tai 8 %. Helsingin kaupungin työntekijänä saat myös runsaasti erilaisia henkilöstöetuja. Kaupunki tarjoaa muun muassa laadukkaita työterveyshuollon palveluja, henkilöstökassan jäsenyyden, runsaasti liikkumiseen ja vapaa-aikaan liittyviä etuja sekä kaupunkipyörä- ja työsuhdematkalippuedun. Suurena työnantajana tarjoamme monia mahdollisuuksia ammattitaidon kehittämiseen, kuten kattavan koulutustarjonnan sekä monenlaisia urapolkuja.

Innostuitko?

Tartu rohkeasti tilaisuuteen ja jätä hakemuksesi rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta 31.8.2026 klo 16.00 mennessä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä saat henkilöstöpäällikkö Taru Wickströmiltä (+358504331004) Parhaiten saat Tarun kiinni joko ke 18.8. klo 13.30-15.30 tai pe 21.8. klo 13.30-15.30.

Toivottavasti kuulemme sinusta pian!

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
If you’re looking to make the best co-op games in the world, you’ve come to the right place. We're proud to have some of the best game makers and collaborators in the industry working with us. What's more, we're a fun bunch of game developers, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together. Our games are not for everyone. Are they for you?

We are now looking for a Data Engineer!

As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in the design, optimization, and operation of our data infrastructure and backend systems. You will work closely with a collaborative team of engineers, focusing on technologies such as SQL Server, Azure Data Factory, Azure, C# and ASP.NET Core. If you are passionate about building scalable, efficient, data-driven backend solutions, we want to hear from you.

Who you are:

    

You have experience tuning all aspects of SQL Server, including query and execution-plan analysis and know exactly where to place the right index.

    

Your savvy troubleshooting skills include identifying and mitigating locking and concurrency issues.

    

You know what is important when it comes to observability and monitoring, what needs acting on as well as identifying blind spots.

    

You are comfortable automating and orchestrating repetitive tasks such as reports and data exports.

    

You are experienced with data classification and different retention needs.

    

You have experience in backend development using C# and ASP.NET Core.

    

You are familiar with cloud platform providers such as Azure and their data infrastructure services.

What you'll do:

    

Database management: Design and implement efficient database structures using SQL Server, optimizing data storage, and retrieval for optimal system performance.

    

Database operations: Ensure database operations under sustained production load are healthy and performant, supporting both players, designers and fellow developers in their day-to-day activities.

    

Database observability: Create and maintain alert rules, the SQL metrics exporter, Grafana dashboards, and Extended-Events-based performance diagnostics.

    

Data pipelines: Operate and evolve the Azure Data Factory pipelines, maintenance, and telemetry events.

    

Application development: Design and develop backend solutions using C#, ASP.NET Core, and Microsoft Orleans, ensuring high performance, scalability, and maintainability.

    

Cloud integration: Utilize Azure services to build and optimize cloud-based backend components, ensuring seamless integration with our applications.

    

Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders to understand requirements, provide technical insights, and ensure the successful delivery of projects.

Our tech stack

    

Azure SQL Server, Azure Data Factory, NET/C#, ASPNET Core, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, CosmosDB, Redis, Grafana, MS Orleans, Kafka

How to apply

If you think that this position matches your background and skills, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV in English as soon as possible. We ask that your application always include relevant work samples or a link to your portfolio.

We interview candidates continuously and hire when we find a good fit.  

Practical Information

Scope: Full-time: 40 hours per week with initial 6 month probation period. Location: Office first.

We are a pet friendly office! You can expect to find cute dogs and occasionally some cats around.

What we offer

Arrowhead Game Studios is a growing team of about 140+ people, best known for our co-op titles. Despite our size, we remain a friendly and down to earth bunch, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together.

Located in the heart of Södermalm, in Fatburen in the middle of the Game Dev scene we enjoy everything Stockholm has to offer. The is a a lot of different types of activities immediately available on our doorstep.

Our talented developers are crucial to our success, therefore we put a lot of emphasis in creating and maintaining a prosperous culture. We’re committed to open and transparent communication. Your ideas are welcomed, valued, appreciated - the ceiling for creative discussions is high.

We also have numerous work benefits for all our employees. You can read about them here!

jobs.title: Vice President Compensation & Benefits  Sandvik Group
jobs.description:
People are one of Sandvik’s most important success factors. Competitive, transparent, and business-relevant reward programs are therefore essential to attracting, engaging and retaining the people who drive our continued success.

We’re now looking for an experienced and commercially minded Vice President Compensation & Benefits to lead and further develop our global Compensation & Benefits function. This is a highly influential role at the center of a global, decentralized and continuously evolving organization, with the opportunity to shape how Compensation & Benefits supports business performance, profitable growth and long-term value creation.

Your mission

You set the strategic direction and lead the development of Compensation & Benefits across Sandvik Group. You ensure that our global reward framework supports the Group’s business strategy and balance clear governance with the needs of our decentralized businesses and local markets.

You act as a trusted advisor to the EVP and Chief HR Officer, senior management, and the Remuneration Committee. You lead the Group Compensation & Benefits team at Group level, including Executive compensation, Pensions and benefits, Global mobility and Global Rewards Operations, data and projects. You also chair Sandvik’s global Compensation & Benefits forum and work closely with the Compensation & Benefits leaders across our four Business Areas and the regional organizations. You’re an engaged peer in Sandvik’s Group HR Management team.  

Job responsibilities also include;

    Translating business needs into decentralized Compensation & Benefits practices that enable Business Areas and Divisions to succeed.
    Designing and implementing Compensation & Benefits procedures and policies with primary focus to support a high-performing organization and contribute to a strong performance culture.
    Developing Sandvik’s approach to areas such as pay transparency, equal pay, executive remuneration, pensions and benefits governance, regulatory requirements and data-driven decision-making.
    Strengthening the function’s contribution to Sandvik’s growth agenda, by ensuring that Compensation & Benefits expertise is brought into acquisitions, including due diligence and post-merger integration.

Location  

The position is based in Stockholm, Sweden and requires travel.

Your profile

You have a successful track record from translating business needs into Compensation & Benefits structures, creating growth and value across a variety of organizations. You have extensive experience within global Compensation & Benefits or Total Rewards, gained in international and complex organizations.

You understand how reward structures influence performance, behavior, cost and value creation, and you are genuinely interested in understanding and supporting Sandvik’s businesses and operations. You enjoy speaking business from an HR and reward perspective.

Your background also includes:

    A strong and broad experience in executive compensation, incentive design, remuneration governance and interaction with senior management.
    Experience leading global teams and operating through both direct and indirect reporting lines in a decentralized business model.
    Relevant experience from business growth, transformation and M&A, including reward-related due diligence and integration.
    Strong financial and business acumen, with a genuine interest in investor and shareholder perspectives.

It’s highly meriting with experience from:

    International industrial, engineering and/or technology companies.
    Direct interaction with Remuneration Committees in a listed environment.
    Broader HR Director, financial and/or other leadership positions.

You’re curious, culturally versatile, and comfortable navigating across a truly global footprint. You naturally build trust across cultures and organizational levels, and between the business and your expert function. You naturally and constructively interact with, and challenge, senior stakeholders. Collaborative and low in prestige, you’re successful by being present and close to the business. You combine integrity with a pragmatic approach and know how to navigate between firm governance and business needs.

Application & Contact information

In this recruitment, Sandvik Group is cooperating with Alumni Global. Please use the application link provided to send us your application (CV only required). Apply as soon as possible and no later than September 4, 2026. Please note that we do not accept applications via e-mail.

For questions about this position, please contact Karin Hagelborn, Partner and Consultant at Alumni Global.

Björn Axelsson, EVP and Chief HR Officer, Sandvik Group  

Union contacts – Sweden

We’ve already decided on what advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contacts.

Our recruitment process is open and fair – we welcome all applicants and evaluate every unique application in line with the specified requirements profile, to find the best match for the position. To learn more about our recruitment process, please visit our career site or contact HR Services at hrservices.sweden@sandvik.com.

jobs.title: People Business Partner
jobs.description:
At NORMAL we are looking for an experienced People Business Partner in Finland who will be an important part of our People Business Partner team. You will be based at our head office in Helsinki but will primarily have activities in stores - in your regions in the country.

**Your role**

As a People Business Partner, you will be the link between our People Development initiatives and the everyday life in our Finnish stores. You will be given a wide range of tasks – from recruitment and onboarding to leadership development and business partnering – all with a focus on developing both people and the organization. You will participate in leadership group meetings and contribute actively to the People agenda.

**Your responsibilities**

· Drive and support recruitment processes primarily at management level

· Be a close sparring partner for the leaders in your regions - also in relation to strengthening our leadership pipeline

· Drive and support onboarding of new employees and managers

· Teach at our internal management training courses and run workshops

· Facilitate leadership development initiatives and ensure that concepts become practice

· Contribute to the development and implementation of People Development activities in everyday life

**Who are you?**

You are an empathetic relationship builder who meets people at eye level, and you are able to create trust and support among both managers and employees. You have a high drive, like to take initiative and do not wait for others to get you started. You think business and people together - and can translate strategic initiatives into concrete actions. You are also ambitious as a sparring partner and not afraid to get involved.

You thrive in an informal culture where there is room for the crazy and quirky while at the same time, we chase results and have big ambitions.

**We also imagine that you:**

· have years of experience with recruitment and leadership development – preferably from a larger retail organization

· have worked in a leadership role yourself

· can teach and facilitate with impact and energy

· thrive in an environment with pace, growth and many stakeholders

**Who are we?**

The culture at NORMAL is unpretentious, and we meet each other at eye level with the common goal of achieving success and results – while having a lot of fun and running fast. We believe in US more than ME, so we also help each other when things are busy. The employees have a high degree of influence, as we want to create a workplace based on trust and responsibility for the individual.

**Normal offers you:**

An exciting and challenging responsibility in a rapidly growing company. With us, you will become part of a big family, where we are motivated by self-development and our common goal to make Normal the best place possible for both our customers and employees.

Our working environment at NORMAL's Finnish headquarters and stores is youthful, international and fun, and we have a good can-do attitude. The company's values are an important part of our daily lives and thus we offer the opportunity to develop in a supportive work environment.

**Do you want to be part of the team?**

If you are interested in the position, please send us a motivated CV and an application with a few words about yourself and why you would be a good fit for this position. You are also welcome to reach out for questions to our Head of People Development, Morten Max on +4530248611.

We will be conducting interviews as we go, and we will hire the right candidate as soon as we have found that individual.

We look forward to receiving your application

jobs.title: Tuotantotyöntekijöitä Pirkkalaan
jobs.description:
FY-Composites on sotilas- ja viranomaiskäyttöön tarkoitettujen vaativien komposiittirakenteiden ja ballististen suojien valmistaja. Tuotteet ja palvelut kattavat taistelijan henkilökohtaiset suojatuotteet ja räätälöidyt komposiittiratkaisut. Suunnittelemme ja valmistamme tuotteet yli 30 vuoden kokemuksella.

Olemme luotettava kumppani. Valmistamme komponentteja ja henkeä pelastavia suojaimia, joiden suorituskykyyn voi luottaa, myös kaikkein vaativimmissa olosuhteissa. Tuotteemme on kehitetty ja testattu yhteistyössä sotilaiden ja viranomaisten kanssa pohjoisen olosuhteissa.


Nyt meillä on haussa FY-Composites Oy:lle Pirkkalaan reippaita TUOTANTOTYÖNTEKIJÖITÄ määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen!

Työnkuva pitää sisällään puolustus- ja turvallisuussektorin komposiittivalmistukseen liittyviä eri työvaiheita mm. koneiden käyttöä, liimauksia, mittauksia, asennuksia ja yleisiä tuotannon työtehtäviä.

Työtä tehdään tällä hetkellä päivävuorossa, mutta lähitulevaisuudessa työ siirtyy kaksivuorotyöhön. Tehtävässä edellytetään valmiutta myös 3-vuorotyöhön tarvittaessa.

Töiden suunniteltu alkamisajankohta olisi heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Työt alkavat 6-12kk mittaisella määräaikaisella työsuhteella Wirestaffin kautta, jonka jälkeen hyvät mahdollisuudet vakinaistumiselle

Rekrytointiprosessiin kuuluu työympäristön ja luonteen vuoksi valitulle henkilölle terveystarkastus (työ sisältää kemikaalien käsittelyä), turvallisuusselvitys sekä huumausainetesti.

Mitä FY-Compositesin homma tarjoaa?

- Vaihtelevan työnkuvan, jossa mahdollisuus päästä tekemään monipuolisia ja mielenkiintoisia suojaustuotteita viranomaiskäyttöön

- Kattavan perehdytyksen työhön ja todella mukavan ja innostavan työporukan

- Hyvän sopimuspalkkauksen ja omalla tekemisellä pääsee vaikuttamaan palkkakehitykseen

Mitä toivomme hakijalta?

- Tekemisen meininkiä, laadukasta, vastuullista ja tarkkaa työotetta

- Kädentaitoja ja ymmärrystä työkalujen käytöstä

- Kokemusta teollisuustöistä ja valmiutta käytännön tuotantotyöhön

Kiinnostuitko hommasta?

Pääset hakemaan paikkaa suoraan osoitteesta www.wirestaff.fi.

Lisätietoja antaa: Ma-pe klo 13-15 välillä Ville Kangasmäki, puh 044 901 6930 tai sähköpostilla ville.kangasmaki@wirestaff.fi

Hyvässä Wireessä!

Wire on tuore, mutta kokenut henkilöstöalan toimija.

Osaamisemme pohjautuu yhteensä yli 40 vuoden kokemukseen henkilöstövuokrauksesta ja rekrytoinneista useilta eri toimialoilta. Meille on tärkeää, että tunnemme asiakkaamme ja työntekijämme henkilökohtaisesti. Ymmärrämme myös erilaisten työympäristöjen haasteet ja vaatimukset. Wire on meidän näköisemme - ei turhaa kiertelyä tai jauhantaa.

jobs.title: Scrum Master OneService
jobs.description:
About the job

We are now looking for a structured and people-focused Scrum Master to support our teams in growing, maintaining alignment, and successfully delivering value.



You'll join a global team of approximately 20 people working across two Agile teams. One team focuses on Field Service, supporting technicians who work directly with customers, while the other supports Service Centres, where equipment is serviced and repaired. The two teams share the same Product Owner, Scrum Master, QA Lead, and Solution Architect. As the Scrum Master, you will support both teams in their ways of working, delivery, collaboration, and continuous improvement.



The Product Owner defines business priorities, while you help the teams translate these priorities into actionable plans and sustainable ways of working. You will guide the teams through planning, follow-up, and continuous improvement, while helping people stay focused on shared goals and agreed ways of working.



Your responsibilities will include:

    

Facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, and follow-up activities

    

Support trust, commitment, and collaboration within and between the two teams and with other teams we collaborate with

    

Establish clear structures for planning, prioritization, follow-up, and continuous improvement

    

Keep the teams focused on shared goals, timelines, and agreed ways of working

    

Identify risks, dependencies, and blockers early and support the teams in resolving them proactively

    

Collaborate closely with the Product Owner to align priorities and proactively communicate risks to delivery

    

Coach the teams in Agile principles, Scrum, and self-organization

    

Foster open communication and an inclusive team culture

    

Encourage experimentation, innovation, and continuous learning

    

Drive long-term improvements in ways of working and team effectiveness



The role requires 2-3 days onsite per week in Lund.



Who are you

Proven ability to collaborate and communicate effectively across functions and stakeholders in a complex, global organization

    

Strong communication and facilitation skills in English

    

Experience supporting multiple Agile teams is an advantage



What's in It for You?

Join a people-focused organization built on collaboration, trust, and open communication, and become part of a large and complex IT landscape. As Scrum Master for a key solution supporting Alfa Laval's global service execution, you'll have the opportunity to work across teams and make a tangible impact on how we deliver service worldwide.

You will be part of a cross-functional scrum team working with one of Verisure’s most critical domains: alarm handling. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a position as Senior Software Engineer - Data Science, Climate and Health, available at the HISP Centre.

The position is permanent subject to availability of external funding. Starting date no later than October 1st, 2026.

Place of work is the HISP Centre at Department of Informatics, Oslo.


Job description

The HISP Centre is looking for a senior software engineer to strengthen the data science side of its climate and health project. The project develops Chap, an open-source platform that connects climate data to disease forecasting inside DHIS2, enabling countries to run, evaluate, and own their own predictive models for climate-sensitive diseases such as malaria, dengue and cholera. Chap is developed in close collaboration with ministries of health and national HISP partners across 17 countries in sub-Saharan Africa and Southeast Asia, together with the global HISP network. The project is funded by Wellcome Trust.

The position sits at the intersection of software engineering and applied data science. You will work on the modelling and evaluation side of the platform - the components that let external forecasting models be plugged in, run inside a country’s own infrastructure, and be compared under identical, platform-governed evaluation criteria. This includes contributing to the model template architecture, the evaluation and back testing framework, and the pipelines that turn climate, environmental and health surveillance data into forecasts delivered back into DHIS2 dashboards. There are also ambitions to move the analytical methodology towards causal decision support questions, like estimating effects of disease interventions or early warning systems as such.

Because Chap is built as much through participatory action research as through software engineering, the role also has a project-facing dimension: translating feedback from country teams and domain experts into concrete technical requirements and helping shape how the platform evolves as it scales to more countries and use cases.


What skills are important in this role?

Qualification requirements:

In this role you must have:

  • Master’s degree in computer science, data science, or a closely related field. Extensive practical competence may replace the educational requirement
  • Strong programming skills, with demonstrated experience building and maintaining production-quality software (Python preferred, given the platform’s stack)
  • Solid grounding in data science methodology - comfortable working with statistical or machine learning models, evaluation methodology, and messy real-world data, preferably within the biomedical medical domain
  • A combination of academic and industry experience: experience from academia alongside several years of experience working as a software engineer or applied data scientist outside academia
  • Leadership experience - planning, prioritising, and coordinating project development and software engineering and data science work
  • Fluent written and spoken English

Desired qualifications:

  • PhD in computer science, data science, or a closely related field
  • Experience with applied data science in the medical domain
  • Experience with climate and health analysis
  • Some familiarity with DHIS2 and Chap, or corresponding software platforms built for deployment in low-resource settings
  • Interest in global health, digital sovereignty, or the operational challenges of taking research models into real-world use
  • Experience with reproducible computational research
  • Understanding of a Scandinavian language at a very basic level - at least corresponding to A2 level of Norwegian

All candidates and projects will have to undergo a check versus national export, sanctions and security regulations. Candidates may be excluded based on these checks. Primary checkpoints are the Export Control regulation, the Sanctions regulation, and the national security regulation.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Comfortable moving between hands-on development work and higher-level project/technical leadership
  • Ability to work independently as well as closely with an interdisciplinary team spanning software engineers, statisticians, epidemiologists, and country-based implementation partners
  • Pragmatic about real-world constraints - interested in what it takes to make a model actually run reliably in the field, not only in a paper
  • Good communication skills, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders
  • Structured, and able to adapt swiftly as project priorities shift

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • A central technical role in a platform already deployed with health ministries across 17 countries, with real operational stakes
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as Senior Engineer, position code 1181 in salary range NOK 810 000 – 875 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2% is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund

Inclusive work life and diversity at UiO

Inclusion and diversity are a strength. The University of Oslo has a personnel policy objective of achieving a balanced gender composition. Furthermore, we want employees with diverse professional expertise, life experience and perspectives.

If there are qualified applicants with disabilities, employment gaps or immigrant background, we will invite at least one applicant from each of these categories to an interview.

We hope that you will apply for the position.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.  


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Brief cover letter with a statement of motivation, relevant to the announced position
  • CV summarising education, positions, technical projects, and relevant academic or industry work
  • Contact details of 2–3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)
  • Any other documentation the applicant wishes the evaluation committee to consider (portfolio, code samples, publications)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

Applicants may be called in for an interview.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The HISP Centre is a global action research project that is considered one of the University of Oslo's greatest international successes. Since 1994, researchers at the HISP Centre have developed the "open source" health information platform DHIS2, which has revolutionized the health sector in the global south. The platform is used to collect, validate, analyze and present aggregated health data. 70 countries use the platform as their national health solution. The system is used by 2.4 billion people. The HISP network further develops the platform thanks to grants from national and international partners. UiO conducts extensive training to enable users in the respective countries to configure and use the software in the best possible way. The HISP Centre based at UiO consists of a global team with 45 employees at UiO and 55 external consultants. In addition, 90 man-years are financed via almost 20 regional HISP groups in Asia, Africa and Latin. Associated with HISP are also 27 recruitment positions and 45 master's students. The HISP Centre has a clear and realistic ambition that DHIS2 will also be used in new areas in addition to health, to continue growth in education, logistics and agriculture, as well as investing in the environment and climate.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager Thailand
jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future

Â 

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology â setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality â when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Â 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: CNC-koneistaja / CNC-machinist
jobs.description:
CNC-koneistaja – Pohjois-Savo / CNC-Machinist, North-Savo, Finland

Etsimme asiakkaallemme CNC-koneistajaa Pohjois-Savoon Kaaville vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

Asiakkaamme valmistaa koneistettuja komponentteja mm metsä- ja kaivosteollisuuden koneisiin, kuten polttoaine- ja hydrauliikkasäiliöihin. Tuotanto on monipuolista ja valmistettavien kappaleiden koko vaihtelee – tuotannossa on sekä pieniä sarjoja että yksittäisiä kappaleita.


Työtehtävät

Työskentelet monipuolisesti CNC-koneistuksen parissa. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

* CNC-koneiden käyttö ja asetukset
* kappaleiden koneistus teknisten piirustusten ja mitoitusvaatimusten mukaisesti
* työkalujen ja työstöarvojen määrittäminen
* kappaleiden mittaus ja laadun varmistaminen
* koneiden asetusten ja työkalujen vaihtaminen
* tarvittaessa useamman koneen samanaikainen käyttö

Kaikissa koneissa ohjelmointi ja koneistus perustuvat ISO-/G-koodiin.


Työstökoneet ovat vaaka- ja pystykaraisia. Ohjaimina Haas, Fanuc ja Mazatrol. Työstökoneiden lisäksi osaaminen sorvilla eduksi (Y-akselillisista CNC-sorveista, vastakarasta, tankolaitteista).


Odotamme sinulta

* vähintään 2 vuoden työkokemusta CNC-koneistuksesta
* kokemusta CNC-työstökeskuksista (osaaminen sorveista eduksi)
* ISO-/G-koodin hallintaa
* kykyä lukea teknisiä piirustuksia
* mittavälineiden sujuvaa käyttöä
* huolellista ja itsenäistä työskentelyotetta
* valmiutta työskennellä 2-vuorossa
* hyvää työmotivaatiota ja halua kehittyä koneistajana
* Fanuc-, Haas- ja/tai Mazatrol-ohjausten tuntemus


Tarjoamme

* vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työsuhteen
* työajan 40 h/vko, 2-vuorotyössä
* palkkauksen teknologiateollisuuden työehtosopimuksen mukaan, alkaen 14,87 €/h brutto + vuorolisät
* mahdollisuuden työaikapankin hyödyntämiseen
* edullisen työasunnon mahdollisuuden
* monipuolisen ja nykyaikaisen konekannan
* mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamista ja työskennellä erilaisten CNC-koneiden parissa

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.

Jos olet kokenut CNC-koneistaja ja haluat työskennellä monipuolisessa tuotantoympäristössä, lähetä meille hakemuksesi!
**



CNC Machinist – North Savo

We are looking for an experienced CNC Machinist for our client in Kaavi,North Savo, Finland.

Our client manufactures machined components for the forestry and mining industries, including fuel and hydraulic tanks. Production is varied, with different component sizes and both small batches and individual pieces.

The workplace is located approximately 60 km from Kuopio.


Your responsibilities

Your work will include a wide range of CNC machining tasks, such as:

* operating and setting CNC machines
* machining components according to technical drawings and specified dimensions
* setting tools and machining parameters
* measuring components and ensuring quality
* changing tools and making machine adjustments
* operating several machines simultaneously when required

All machines are operated using ISO/G-code.


Horizontal and vertical Machining centres, with Haas, Fanuc- and Mazatrol controllers. Experience with CNC Lathes is advantage (Y-axis CNC lathes, sub-spindles, bar feeders)


What we expect from you

* at least 2 years of experience in CNC machining
* experience with machining centres (experience with CNC lathes is advantage)
* good knowledge of ISO/G-code
* ability to read and understand technical drawings
* ability to use measuring tools
* accurate and independent working style
* willingness to work in a 2-shift system
* good motivation and willingness to develop your machining skills
* Knowledge of Fanuc, Haas and/or Mazatrol controls


We offer

* a permanent, full-time employment contract
* working hours of 40 hours/week in a 2-shift system
* salary according to the Technology Industry Collective Agreement, starting from €14.87/hour gross + shift allowances
* possibility to use a working time bank
* affordable work-related accommodation
* a modern and versatile machine park
* an opportunity to develop your skills and work with a wide range of CNC machines

The work can start as soon as possible, according to agreement.

If you are an experienced CNC Machinist looking for a versatile position with modern CNC equipment, send us your application!

jobs.title: Unit Manager - Distribution Centre Lund | Parts, Distribution & Logistics
jobs.description:
About the job

As Unit Manager, you will play a key leadership role within Parts, Distribution & Logistics (PDL), shaping the future of the office organization at Distribution Centre Lund. As a member of the DC Lund Management Team, you will lead the function from a strategic, business, and organizational perspective, ensuring the organization has the structure, leadership, and capabilities needed to support long-term growth and operational excellence.



Stakeholder management is a key part of this role. You will collaborate closely with senior leaders, global functions, and customers while contributing to the strategic direction of the Distribution Centre. By building strong relationships and creating alignment across a complex international organization, you will help drive business performance, organizational development, and future growth.



This is a fully on-site position based in Lund.



Key Responsibilities

    

Lead and develop the organization through direct-report managers, driving business performance, leadership excellence, and organizational development.

    

Develop and execute the long-term strategy for the office organization in alignment with the overall strategy for Distribution Centre Lund.

    

Build and strengthen a high-performing management team by coaching managers, clarifying accountability, and driving performance.

    

Drive organizational development by strengthening leadership capabilities, succession planning, and a culture of continuous improvement.

    

Own the function's governance model, KPIs, budget, and executive-level performance reporting to ensure business objectives are achieved.

    

Identify and implement opportunities to improve efficiency, strengthen customer value, and support operational excellence.

    

Represent the function within the DC Lund Management Team and collaborate closely with global functions, customers, and senior stakeholders.

    

Ensure effective risk management, compliance, and internal controls within the area of responsibility.



Who are you

You are a strategic leader who builds organizations through people. You create direction, empower managers, and foster a culture where accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement drive both individual and business performance. Developing leaders, building trust, and enabling others to succeed are at the core of your leadership style.



You thrive in complex, international environments where balancing competing priorities is part of everyday business. Combining strategic thinking with operational understanding, you confidently engage senior stakeholders, influence decisions, and lead change while keeping both customer value and long-term business success in focus.



What you know

To succeed in this role, you bring extensive leadership experience together with a strong understanding of business, organizational development, and strategic execution. We believe our ideal candidate has:

    

Relevant university degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Procurement, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

    

Several years of documented experience leading managers and developing high-performing leadership teams.

    

Experience as a member of a management team, influencing business strategy and collaborating with senior stakeholders in complex organizations.

    

Proven experience leading organizational transformation, change management, and digitalization initiatives.

    

Proven track record of business accountability, including responsibility for financial performance, quality, safety, and business objectives.

    

Experience working within an international matrix organization is considered a strong advantage.

    

Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.



What's in it for you?

This is an opportunity to take on a highly influential leadership role where you will shape the future of the organization while contributing to the overall direction of Distribution Centre Lund.



At Alfa Laval, you will have the opportunity to:

    

Build and shape your own leadership organization during an exciting phase of development.

    

Influence strategic decisions as a member of the DC Lund Management Team.

    

Work closely with senior stakeholders across Alfa Laval's global organization.

    

Make a lasting impact on both business performance and organizational culture.

    

Grow into a trusted leadership role with the opportunity to represent the Factory Manager in selected forums.





We are conducting a continuous review of received applications.

We do not accept applications via email, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).



Please send your application no later than August 30th, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long!



At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in Lund or have an established presence in the area.



Our commitment to integrity
We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioral traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.



As part of Alfa Laval's commitment to a safe and healthy workplace, we conduct background checks on final candidates for this role, and alcohol and drug testing is applied during the pre‑employment process.

jobs.title: Liikunnanohjaaja / Uinninvalvoja
jobs.description:
Raahen kaupungin liikuntapalvelut vastaa kaupungin liikuntapaikoista, -alueista ja -rakennuksista sekä tuottaa näihin liittyviä liikuntapalveluita. Luomme päivittäisellä työllämme liikkumiselle ja harrastamiselle hyvät ja turvalliset puitteet.

Haemme moniammatilliseen joukkoomme LIIKUNNANOHJAAJAA/UINNINVALVOJAA määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen 1.9.2026 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Liikunnanohjaaja/uinninvalvoja työskentelee Kuntokeidas Vesipekan liikunnanohjaus- ja uinninvalvojatiimissä. Pääasialliset työtehtävät ovat koululaisten uimaopetus, uinninvalvonta ja vesiliikunnanohjaus. Työhön liittyy myös uusien kurssien ja tapahtumien suunnittelua ja järjestämistä.

Odotamme liikunnanohjaaja/uinninvalvojalta vähintään Suomen uimaopetus- ja hengenpelastusliiton uimaopetuskurssia ja/tai uinninvalvojan kurssia. Tehtävässä eduksi katostaan aiempi työkokemus vastaavista tehtävistä. Sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja viestintätaidot, sekä osaat hyödyntää niitä työssäsi. Toimintatavoiltasi olet suunnitelmallinen, itseohjautuva ja yhteistyökykyinen.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on SUH:n uimaopetuskurssi ja/tai uinninvalvojakurssi.

Työ on kaksivuorotyötä, joka sisältää viikonlopputyötä, työaika 30h/vko. Valitulla on kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaika. Ennen työtehtävän vastaanottamista valitun on esitettävä lääkärintodistus terveydentilastaan sekä rikosrekisteriote lasten kanssa työskentelyyn.

Tehtävä on määräaikainen 31.5.2027 asti, mahdollisuus työn jatkumiseen tulevaisuudessa. Palkkaus ja muut työsuhteen ehdot määräytyvät kunta-alan yleisen virka- ja työehtosopimuksen mukaan (KVTES tasopalkka 2VAP60A1 kokoaikaisessa tehtävässä 2 504,97 € / kk),

Hakemukset ansioluetteloineen tulee jättää 27.8.2026 klo 23.59 mennessä sähköisesti osoitteessa www.kuntarekry.fi

Lisätiedot: Liikuntapalvelukoordinaattori Janne Mykkänen p. 044 028 9200 arkisin klo 8.00-16.00 välisenä aikana.

Rekrytointiprosessin aikataulu:
Hakuaika: 14. - 27.8.2026.
Haastattelut: 28. ja 31.8.2026
Valintapäätökset: Haastatteluiden jälkeen


Raahen kaupungilla on kattavat työsuhde-edut:

-Viikkoliikunta (1h viikossa mahdollista liikkua työajalla)
-Edenred - liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hierontaedut
-Lomaosakkeita
-Laaja työterveyshuolto

jobs.title: Køkkenassistent søges til børneinstitution på Østerbro
jobs.description:
På vegne af vores kunde, en børneinstitution på Østerbro, søger FIRMAVIKAR en erfaren og selvstændig køkkenassistent til et længerevarende vikariat.

Stillingen ønskes besat fra mandag den 17/8 og løber som udgangspunkt frem til jul. For den rette person vil der være mulighed for både forlængelse og fastansættelse.

Du får ansvaret for den daglige drift af køkkenet og kommer til at arbejde selvstændigt. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du er tryg ved at stå alene i køkkenet, kan strukturere din arbejdsdag og har et godt overblik.

Du får udleveret en fast menu/madplan, som du skal følge i forbindelse med den daglige madlavning til institutionens børn.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Tilberedning af mad til børn ud fra den fastlagte menu/madplan

  • Klargøring og øvrige almindelige køkkenopgaver

  • Daglig rengøring og oprydning i køkkenet

  • Sikre god køkkenhygiejne og orden

  • Selvstændigt ansvar for den daglige drift af køkkenet

Arbejdstid

Mandag til fredag kl. 07.30–14.00.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har erfaring fra køkken, kantine, institutionskøkken eller lignende

  • Er vant til at arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar

  • Arbejder struktureret og har et godt overblik

  • Er stabil og møder til tiden

  • Har gode danskkundskaber

  • Har fokus på kvalitet, hygiejne og orden

Vi tilbyder

  • Et længerevarende vikariat frem til jul

  • Opstart hurtigst muligt

  • Fast arbejdstid mandag til fredag

  • Et selvstændigt job med ansvar for eget køkken

  • Mulighed for forlængelse eller fastansættelse for den rette kandidat

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Send os din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt.

jobs.title: Night receptionist, Star Arctic Hotel, Saariselkä, Lapland
jobs.description:
Are you the night receptionist we are looking for?

The Star Arctic Hotel is uniquely situated on the top of Kaunispää fell, surrounded by the pristine Arctic wilderness and the breathtaking landscapes of a national park. It offers premium accommodation in spectacular suites, where you can stay above the clouds and experience the peace and beauty of Finnish Lapland at its finest. Carefully curated full-service holiday packages make your stay effortless, while a wide range of activities ensures unforgettable experiences for every guest. The panoramic Restaurant Kaunis serves culinary delights inspired by the pure nature of Lapland, both in the dining room and at the bar. End your evening in the cozy lounge bar, relaxing by the warmth of the fireplace. The hotel's motto, Passion for Lapland, is reflected in every aspect of the guest experience.

We are looking for professional night receptionist for the winter season 2026–2027!

As a night receptionist, you will work while others are sleeping. Your diverse responsibilities include guest check-ins and check-outs for high-quality accommodation, processing reports, providing customer service, and preparing for the following day. During your shift, you will work independently and be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of the hotel throughout the night. We are looking for candidates with previous front desk experience, an independent approach to work, and fluent English language skills. You will work as part of international team - Finnish language skills are not required.

Full-time employment, 90h/3 weeks, starts with orientation in Mid-November 2026 and lasts til March-April 2027. Terms of employment are following the Finnish Collective agreement for hotel- and restaurant industry. Salary according to the agreement. Employment contract will be between Bondata and employee. Shared accommodation in Saariselkä will be organized by the company for a reasonable rent.

What we offer:

- Unique work place on top of Kaunispää fell

- Good orientation for the work tasks and support from your team

- Possibility to develop your professional skills

- Bondata support during your employment

- Shared accommodation with your own bedroom for a reasonable rent

We hope from you:

- Suitable education / good previous work experience of night receptionist tasks

- Excellent team working skills

- Ability to work independently and under pressure

- Familiarity with the Mews and FareHarbor systems is considered an advantage.

- Fluent english language, other languages are an advantage

- B-driving lisence and own car are an advantage in this area

Salary:

Salary according to the collective agreement for the hotel- and restaurant industry, taking into account relevant experience in the field.

Recruitment process:

Please send your application with your resume in English as soon as possible. We will start video interviews instantly, so remember check your emails during recruitment process!

More info:
Bondata Lapland
Lappi@bondata.fi


Star Arctic Hotel

Established in early 2016, this privately owned Star Arctic hotel offers high-quality accommodation and exceptional service in the heart of Lapland's breathtaking fell landscape. Stunning views of the surrounding fells can be enjoyed from the hotel's main building as well as from every guest room. During the winter season, guests have the opportunity to admire the magical Northern Lights directly from the hotel, creating an unforgettable Arctic experience.

The hotel's philosophy is built on providing comfortable accommodation, outstanding customer service, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Its peaceful location and close proximity to nature make it an ideal destination for both relaxation and unforgettable adventures in Finnish Lapland.

Phone: +358406816797 Email: lappi@bondata.fi Location: Ylämajantie 1, 99830, Saariselkä

jobs.description:

Full time 39 hours per week Monday - Friday €16.00 per hour Opportunities for career development Plus our Sodexo employee benefits package Dublin Airport - Full time A role that keeps everyone smiling. At Sodexo, we are passionate about our people. We know that our teams are the key to delivering exceptional service and creating meaningful experiences for our clients, customers, and employees. So, whilst you enhance comfort and convenience, we will enhance your career! As an Airport Lounge Administrator with Sodexo, you'll be the welcoming face of our vibrant corporate site, offering a helping hand to ensure flawless workplace operations and shape that all-important guest experience. Enjoy a role where you’ll love what you do. What you will do Operations & Administration Provide day-to-day administrative support across our Dublin Airport Lounges. Maintain accurate food allergen records and customer-facing menu information. Log and track catering, facilities, equipment and maintenance issues. Prepare and distribute daily, weekly and monthly operational reports. Support meetings, action trackers and document control. Manage customer enquiries, complaints and refund administration. Support events, promotions and seasonal campaigns. Reporting & Commercial Administration Produce regular sales, trading, revenue and operational reports. Compile and distribute SLA and KPI performance reports. Process purchase orders, supplier invoices and weekly invoice trading. Support financial administration through EprophIT and other approved systems. Assist with revenue analysis, budgeting information and cost-control reporting. Support the preparation of Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs). Compliance & Quality Support airport compliance activities and maintain accurate records. Manage trackers for airport passes, vetting, training, certifications and permits. Monitor expiry dates and ensure documentation remains up to date. Assist with audit preparation and maintain audit-ready records. Maintain quality assurance documentation and corrective action logs. Track customer feedback, improvement actions and Quality Improvement Plans. Work with operational teams to ensure airport, contractual and regulatory standards are maintained. Stakeholder & Systems Coordination Act as a key administrative contact for internal teams, suppliers and airport stakeholders. Gather accurate information from multiple lounges to support performance reporting. Help identify trends, improvements and opportunities to enhance operational efficiency. What you will bring Previous experience in administration, aviation, facilities management or a similar operational environment. Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook and PowerPoint. Experience producing financial, operational or management reports. Experience with invoices, purchase orders and financial administration.

jobs.title: Data Architect
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Data Architect to join Etteplan!

This position includes versatile tasks in creating data solutions mainly for our industrial customers. The role will be customized based on your unique preferences, interests, and skillset.

As a Data Architect at Etteplan your work would include e.g.:
- hands-on work with data architecture, modeling and pipelines - design and specification work in collaboration with the clients - presales work with internal stakeholders - technical guidance of project teams - technology selection for customer projects
One of our strengths in career development is our diverse range of clients and various projects in different fields. That enables us to offer versatile opportunities for our employees. We are concentrating on helping our customers in industrial system digitalization. At Etteplan, every phase of a customer project is handled with pride, from requirements and UX design to the final maintenance phase.

The position is based in Finland, the location preferably being Espoo or Tampere.

Who are we looking for?
- You have good interpersonal skills and can lead a technical team - You have plenty of experience within modern data architectures, data modeling, cloud solutions, data lakes (Snowflake, Databricks or Fabric), ETL, SQL and other data related tasks - Adapting new technologies easily is part of your nature and you are always interested of learning new skills - You are familiar with environment and processes of industrial customers - You have an applicable educational background - Good written and spoken Finnish and English skills are required
What do we offer you at Etteplan?

Etteplan is a Technology Service company that specializes in software and embedded solutions, engineering solutions, and technical documentation solutions. We help our customers to create a better world through engineering, innovation, and digitalization. Our customers represent a wide range of industries which enables unlimited access to variety in your work tasks.

jobs.title: Senior Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

Do You Want to Help Shape the Future of Construction Equipment?

We are looking for an experienced and technically driven Senior Test Engineer to play a key role in the development and verification of next-generation powertrains and electrified systems for construction equipment.

With us, you will work with cutting-edge technology, ranging from conventional diesel powertrains to hybrid and fully electric solutions. This role offers significant technical challenges, a high degree of responsibility, and the opportunity to influence both product development and testing methodologies in a global engineering environment.

About the Role

As a Senior Test Engineer, you will be responsible for planning, leading, and executing testing activities related to powertrain and electrification systems. You will work throughout the entire product development cycle, from defining verification strategies and test plans to analyzing results, troubleshooting issues, and recommending design improvements.

You will serve as a key technical contributor, providing both specialist expertise and a systems-level perspective in cross-functional development projects.

You will work in a team with test technicians and workshop mechanics.

Key Responsibilities

    Plan, coordinate, and execute verification and validation activities
    Test and evaluate diesel, hybrid, and electric powertrain systems
    Perform functional testing of transmissions, axles, electric motors, and battery systems
    Analyze test data and create technical reports and recommendations
    Lead troubleshooting activities and root cause investigations
    Develop and improve test methods, processes, and test equipment
    Ensure systems and components meet performance, durability, and functional requirements
    Collaborate closely with design engineers, system engineers, software developers, and suppliers
    Participate in global development projects and provide technical leadership within testing and verification
    Lead and drive risk analysis to ensure safe and healthy test environment

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who has:

    A B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
    Several years of experience in testing, verification, validation, or product development within the automotive, construction equipment, or industrial sectors
    Strong technical understanding of powertrains, transmissions, and vehicle systems
    Experience with measurement systems, instrumentation, and data analysis tools
    The ability to independently plan and drive complex testing activities
    Experience documenting, analyzing, and presenting technical results
    Excellent communication skills in both English and Swedish

Meritorious Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly valued:

    Electrified powertrains and high-voltage systems
    Battery technology and energy storage systems
    CAN communication, CANalyzer, or similar tools
    Functional safety and verification according to industry standards
    Working in international product development organizations

Personal Attributes

To succeed in this role, you are:

    Analytical and solution-oriented
    Passionate about technology and understanding complex systems
    Comfortable taking ownership and driving activities to completion
    A strong communicator who enjoys collaborating across disciplines
    Structured, organized, and quality-focused
    Motivated by continuous improvement and technical innovation

What We Offer

    A key role in developing the next generation of sustainable construction equipment
    The opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies in electrification and powertrain development
    The ability to influence products, testing methods, and technical decisions
    Highly skilled colleagues and a strong technical network
    An international project environment with broad collaboration opportunities

Ready for the next move?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career and contribute to the development of tomorrow's construction equipment?

Submit your application today, but latest day to apply is the 6th of September. If you have questions contact Hiring Manager Stefan Semmelhack at stefan.semmelhack@volvo.com.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing from you.

As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable.

Join us and help drive the future of powertrain and electrification technology.

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

Who we are and what we believe in

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

Part of Volvo Group, Volvo Construction Equipment is a global company driven by our purpose to build the world we want to live in. Together we develop and deliver solutions for a cleaner, smarter, and more connected world. By unleashing everyone’s full potential, we build a more sustainable future for all our stakeholders. Come join our team and help us build a better tomorrow.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Fire & Security
jobs.description:
Are you our next Project Manager?

Are you an experienced Project Manager or product development professional looking to take the next step in driving complex engineering programs? We’re seeking a proactive leader with strong execution skills and a passion for accelerating sustainable innovation.

What drives us at Schneider Electric?

For us, impact isn’t just a term paraded across posters or social media; it’s encoded into our culture. After all, Schneider makes companies, infrastructure, buildings, homes, data centers, and entire industries more efficient and sustainable. There’s a reason why we’re consistently ranked among the most sustainable companies in the world. Here, you can pursue your dream career while actively making a long-term, positive impact on the planet.

With us, you’ll contribute to tackling the climate crisis head-on, and accelerating the energy transition the planet urgently needs. What’s more, we help tens of millions of people in underserved communities gain access to energy and education — so you’re making the world a fairer place, too. You’ll sit among colleagues with vastly different personal and professional backgrounds, all united by a vision of a better world.

Welcome to your workplace

You’ll be based at Schneider Electric’s R&D Innovation Site in Lund — a dynamic hub for cutting-edge development in energy management and automation. The site brings together cross-functional teams in a collaborative, high-tech environment designed to foster innovation, creativity, and continuous learning. With modern labs, agile workspaces, and a strong focus on sustainability, it’s the perfect place to grow your career.

What you’ll do

    Collaborate Globally: Work across functions in a large, global matrix organization, adapting to time zones as needed. Foster a positive collaborative working environment.
    Being the driving force, highlight problems with the right nuance and simultaneously be mindful of our culture to put people first.
    Having full execution responsibility to meet budget, time plan and quality objectives and communicate efficiently to stakeholders
    Engage with state‑of‑the‑art Fire detection and Access control technologies—including Fire Detection & Access Control softwares and integrations with 3rd party systems —while providing project leadership in a rapidly evolving market that delivers significant positive environmental impact.

Essential for the role

    Minimum of 5 years’ experience in project/ program management
    Preference for Advanced Degree and/or Project Management certificate
    Experience leading the end-to-end delivery of new software platforms, from requirements definition and architecture alignment through development, deployment, and commercial release.
    Demonstrated experience managing the continuous development and enhancement of existing software platforms, including regular release cycles, feature expansions, performance improvements, and technology upgrades.
    Experience coordinating cross-functional teams including Software Engineering, Product Management, QA, UX, DevOps, Cybersecurity, and System Integration teams.
    (Preferred) Demonstrated experience working with Fire Detection & Fire Alarm systems, Access Control, Video Management Systems (VMS), integrations with Building Management System (BMS), third-party APIs and SDKs, related security technologies and applicable standards.
    (Preferred) Experience working within Fire & Life Safety, Access Control, Physical Security, Smart Buildings, Building Automation, or related regulated industries is highly preferred.
    xperience working with cross functional globally distributed teams, including R&D, QA, supply chain, and manufacturing partners across multiple time zones. Demonstrated ability to drive alignment, facilitate technical decision-making, and manage cross-cultural communication.
    You demonstrate excellent people skills with high level of self-awareness
    Structure as a personal strength to build plans, takes decisions based on time aspects, create clarity and provide right amount of structure to make the team successful.

Location and Language requirements

    Based in or willing to relocating to Lund, Sweden.
    Language skills: Fluent advanced English (Swedish is a plus)

Why Schneider Electric?

    Hybrid work model and flexible hours
    Inclusive, supportive and diverse work culture with people-first culture
    Global career development opportunities
    Competitive compensation and benefits tailored to the region

jobs.title: Rzeźnik - Rozbiór Łopatki Wieprzowej / Experienced Butchers – Shoulder Deboning
jobs.description:
Pracuj w Danii jako rzeźnik – atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie, elastyczność i stabilne warunki pracy. Danish Crown to jedna z największych firm spożywczych w Europie. Oferujemy stabilne warunki zatrudnienia i pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku.

Opis stanowiska


  • Wykonywanie rozbioru łopatki wieprzowej zgodnie z obowiązującymi standardami jakości i wydajności.




  • Precyzyjna praca nożem na linii produkcyjnej, z dbałością o detale.




  • Monitorowanie i utrzymywanie wysokiej jakości cięcia oraz efektywności pracy.




  • Ścisłe przestrzeganie zasad higieny i bezpieczeństwa pracy na każdym etapie produkcji



Wymagania


  • Ugruntowane doświadczenie w rozbiorze mięsa, najlepiej w pracy z łopatką wieprzową lub przodami.




  • Doskonała umiejętność sprawnego i precyzyjnego posługiwania się nożem.




  • Udokumentowane doświadczenie w pracy na ubojni lub w zakładzie mięsnym.




  • Zdolność do efektywnej i samodzielnej pracy w tempie produkcyjnym od pierwszego dnia.




  • Sprawność fizyczna oraz odpowiedzialność w wykonywaniu powierzonych zadań.



Oferujemy


  • Atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie godzinowe z dodatkami, 176 dkk + 12,20% czyli 197,58 dkk z możliwością wzrostu po przejściu na system akordowy.




  • Stabilne zatrudnienie bezpośrednio u duńskiego pracodawcy Danish Crown, z pełnym pakietem socjalnym (urlop, emerytura).




  • Wsparcie w procesie relokacji i adaptacji w Danii (CPR, podatki, ubezpieczenie, zakwaterowanie).




  • Pomoc w języku polskim oraz innych językach, a także wprowadzenie w życie i pracę w Danii.



English version:

Experienced Butchers – Shoulder Deboning

Work in Denmark as a butcher– attractive salary, flexibility and stable working conditions

For our customer, Danish Crown - one of Europe’s largest food companies - we are looking for experienced pork butchers for shoulder deboning (pork front ends) at abattoirs in Blans, Denmark.

Working in Denmark means clear employment conditions under collective agreements, pension schemes, paid holidays and stable working conditions. At Danish Crown you will join an international workplace with colleagues from many different countries.

The work is guided by clear values. Safety first is the most important principle – employees must always be able to work safely and return home safely every day.

Danish Crown is also focusing strongly on employee well-being and development. Employees should feel comfortable in their work, understand their role in the production and see how their contribution creates value for the company.
The company culture is based on teamwork, responsibility and mutual respect, where colleagues support each other and everyone is treated fairly.

Please note: You will be employed directly by Danish Crown from your first day of work

Job tasks

• Deboning of pork shoulders (front ends)
• Knife work in high-volume pork production
• Ensuring correct cutting and optimal meat yield
• Following hygiene and safety procedures
• Supporting other tasks in the cutting room when required

Candidate requirements

• Experience with deboning
• Preferably experience with pork shoulders / front ends
• Good knife skills
• Experience from a abattoirs or meat processing plant
• Ability to work in a fast-paced production environment
• Physically fit and reliable

Candidates must be able to work independently with deboning from the first working days.

Salary and working conditions

• Hourly wage according to the collective agreement: DKK 176.10 plus a flexible benefits allowance of 12.20% = DKK 197.58 per hour.

• After a short accomodation period, the salary will switch to piecework (akkord), where the hourly rate will increase significantly.

• Possibility of higher earnings depending on function and performance

• Flexible benefit scheme (extra pay or extra time off)

• Canteen facilities

• Opportunities for training and development

We also offer:

• Admininstrative assistance with CPR number, tax card, healt insurance, and more.

• Help with accomodation near the working place.

• Support in multiple languages ( English, Danish, Romanian, Polish, more)

• Guidance regarding Danish work and living culture.

Working hours

Day shift
Monday – Friday

40 hours per week

Employees accumulate additional hours that can be used for time off.
If flexible benefits and accumulated hours are used for time off, employees can potentially have up to around 10 weeks of time off per year.

Evening shift
32-hour work week distributed across 4 working days.

Employees on the evening shift do not accumulate extra hours, but instead have a weekly rotating day off, which means that approximately every fifth weekend they can have both Friday and Monday off.

Evening shift employees also receive additional evening pay for many of their working hours.

Application
If you are interested in the job, please complete the application form and attach your CV as soon as possible.

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Ewa Pedersen email ewape@jks.dk telefon: +45.61204070.

We look forward to hearing from you!
