jobs.title: [Contract] Language Training Specialist - Japanese
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an experienced Localization Project Manager — Japan Training Quality to support localization for Customer Education, helping ensure Notion training content feels accurate, clear, culturally relevant, and ready to use for learners across the globe.



You’ll work at the intersection of localization quality, training implementation, and program management, collaborating with Localization, Partner Enablement, Customer Education, vendors, and language specialists. You’ll help turn translation feedback, learner experience issues, and regional quality needs into practical improvements across training content, quizzes, LMS setup, and repeatable localization workflows.



The ideal candidate combines native-level Japanese language expertise with a deep understanding of what effective education looks like in the Japanese market.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Own and apply Japanese localization QA standards across training content, including checking for accuracy, clarity, tone, terminology, and cultural nuance

 - Support development of glossaries, style guides, QA checklists, review processes, and localization assets

 - Become a go-to partner for translation questions related to Notion-specific concepts, product terminology, and training context

 - Support QA of technical implementation in eLearning authoring tools and LMS environments (course files, quizzes, answer selections)

 - Coordinate across Customer Education, Partner Enablement, Localization, and vendors to align on priorities, timelines, translation progress, and quality expectations

 - Identify workflow risks and recommend improvements that improve translation quality and reduce time-to-launch

 - Document repeatable processes that make training and help center localization easier to manage over time




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - Strong understanding of localization workflows, including vendor collaboration, review cycles, glossaries, style guides, QA rubrics, and linguistic QA

 - Experience with Japanese localization QA, ideally for SaaS, technical training, customer education, or partner enablement content

 - Ability to review translated content for quality, clarity, terminology accuracy, cultural nuance, and learner comprehension

 - Familiarity with eLearning or LMS tools; experience with platforms like Skilljar or Parta authoring tools is a plus

 - Comfort working with technical or product-specific terminology that may not translate directly

 - Strong attention to detail, especially in learner-facing content, quizzes, course setup, formatting, and implementation QA

 - Strong project management skills and ability to bring structure into ambiguous areas




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

We want all of our learners should feel like Notion training content was made for them — not simply translated for them. High-quality localization has a direct impact on learner trust, comprehension, launch readiness, and regional enablement outcomes.



This role will help Customer Education and Partner Enablement move faster while raising the quality bar: reducing rework, catching issues before launch, improving vendor feedback loops, and creating a clearer, more repeatable operating model for training localization



This is a 6-month, part-time role with option to extend. Preferred location is Tokyo, but we're open to remote applicants with strong Japanese market expertise and timezone overlap with Japan and Notion's International Experience team.



Availability: 20 hours/week



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: MONTER/KA III (821306) U ODJELU ELEKTRO ODRŽAVANJA
jobs.description:
Uvjeti (potrebna znanja i kvalifikacije) koje kandidati moraju zadovoljiti za navedeno radno mjesto su:

• SSS/KV – elektro smjera • poznavanje čitanja električnih shema • vozačka dozvola B kategorije

Opis poslova radnog mjesta:

• obavlja složene poslove na održavanju elektro opreme i uređaja energetike na crpnim, precrpnim stanicama i vodospremama • obavlja popravak elemenata električnih instalacija niskog napona, sklopne tehnike, rasvjete, grijanja i snage • sudjeluje pri remontu agregata, demontaže i montaže elektro motora, mekih upuštača, frekventnih pretvarača i ispravljača • obavlja izradu električnih instalacija jake i slabe struje • izrađuje i montira sustave za kompenzaciju jalove energije na svim pogonima vodoopskrbe • održava elektroinstalacije u poslovnim prostorima • popravlja i održava vanjsku i unutarnju rasvjetu, gromobransku instalaciju, uzemljenja, izjednačavanje potencijala i kabelskog razvoda • rad u smjenama

Izabrani kandidati obavljat će poslove radnog mjesta MONTER III (821306) u Odjelu elektro održavanja, temeljem ugovora o radu na neodređeno vrijeme s probnim radom u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci. Mjesto rada je u Zagrebu.

Uz predaju ponude koja sadrži kontakt podatke (broj telefona ili mobitela, e-mail adresa) kandidati trebaju obvezno priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta, kako slijedi:

• životopis s opisom dosadašnjeg rada • dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja u skladu s uvjetima iz javnog natječaja (presliku svjedodžbe, odnosno rješenje o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije koju je izdalo nadležno tijelo) • uvjerenje da se ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od 3 mjeseca od dana objave natječaja) • presliku važeće vozačke dozvole

Ponude na javni natječaj podnose se elektroničkim putem. Rok za dostavu tražene dokumentacije je 14 dana od dana objave, na adresu elektroničke pošte:

vio.karijera@zgh.hr

S naznakom „Za javni natječaj za radno mjesto MONTER III (821306) u Odjelu elektro održavanja“.

Urednom ponudom smatra se ponuda koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravodobno pristigle ponude neće se razmatrati. Kandidati koji zadovoljavaju tražene uvjete iz natječaja, bit će upućeni na daljnji selekcijski postupak koji uključuje, prema potrebi, pisano testiranje (testovi općeg znanja, stručnih znanja, opće pismenosti, informatičke pismenosti i sl., psihologijsko testiranje i dr.) i/ili intervju.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskoga rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, br. 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), a u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjavaju uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja i dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju.

Popis dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalazi se na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21 i 13/26) a u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjavaju uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti i sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja i dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju. Popis dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalazi se na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, br. 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19), uz prijavu na javni natječaj dužni su, uz dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja, priložiti rješenje ili potvrdu o priznatom statusu, izjavu da do sada nisu koristili pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju po toj osnovi te dokaz iz kojeg se vidi na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.).

Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, br. 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20), uz prijavu na javni natječaj dužni su, uz dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja, priložiti i rješenje o utvrđenom invaliditetu, odnosno drugu javnu ispravu o invaliditetu na temelju koje se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom te dokaz iz kojeg se vidi na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.).

https://mrosp.gov.hr/pristup-informacijama-16/najcesca-pitanja-i-odgovori/najcesca-pitanja-i-odgovori-12153/rad-i-zaposljavanje/zakon-o-profesionalnoj-rehabilitaciji-i-zaposljavanju-osoba-s-invaliditetom/5946 Vodoopskrba i odvodnja d.o.o. zadržava pravo poništenja natječaja, u cijelosti i/ili u dijelu te ne prihvatiti ni jednu dostavljenu ponudu.

jobs.title: ISPITIVAČ/ISPITIVAČICA ZA POSLOVE ISPITIVANJA BEZ RAZARANJA (NDT)
jobs.description:
Inženjer strojarstva za rad na poslovima ispitivanja bez razaranja. Posao uključuje provedbu ispitivanja bez razaranja, te pisanje izvještaja provedenim ispitivanjima na Hrvatskom i / ili Engleskom jeziku s odgovarajućim zaključcima. Ispitivanja se vrše na različitim strojarskim elementima i dijelovima parnih turbina i pumpe te slične energetske opreme u pogonima TTK u Karlovcu i na terenu (razna postrojenja). Ispitivanja koja se provode su: - VT – vizualni pregled (povremeno videoskopija i dimenzionalna kontrola)* - UT – ispitivanja ultrazvukom* - PT – ispitivanja penetrantima* - MT – ispitivanja magnetnim česticama* - HT – mjerenja tvrdoće - PMI – analiza sastava materijala *potrebna formalna certifikacije prema HRN EN ISO 9712:2022, minimalno level 2 Rad je samostalan ili u timu, uz podršku inženjeringa TTK. Poželjno je prethodno radno iskustvo na sličnim poslovima, te formalna certifikacija. Ukoliko postoji interes a nemate formalnu certifikaciju ista će se provesti od strane TTK uz interno i vanjsko školovanje. Od kandidata se očekuju tehnička stručnost, analitičnost, ozbiljnost u izvršavanju posla te završnim izvještajima te spremnost na terenski rad koji može uključivati i rad vikendom. Uvjeti:
  • VŠS / VSS (strojarstvo)
  • Poželjno prethodno radno iskustvo na sličnim poslovima
  • Vozačka dozvola B kategorije
  • Spremnost na terenski rad
  • Analitičnost i tehnička stručnost
  • Znanje engleskog jezika
Nudimo:
  • Mogućnost stručnog usavršavanja i dodatnih edukacija (rad sa specijaliziranom opremom)
  • Rad na zanimljivim i tehnički zahtjevnim projektima u strojarstvu i energetici
  • Profesionalni razvoj i stjecanje specijalističkih znanja

jobs.title: U141  Boltvezető-helyettes HUMANIC - Duna Plaza üzletbe (Verkaufsfahrer/in)
jobs.description:
RÓLUNK

A LEDER & SCHUH AG két értékesítési márkájával, a HUMANIC-kal és a SHOE4YOU-val Európa egyik legnagyobb cipőkereskedője. A vállalat kilenc országban (AT, DE, CZ, SK, HU, HU, SI, HR, RO, BG) mintegy 200 telephelyen mintegy 2000 embert foglalkoztat. A vállalat központja a stájer fővárosban, Grazban található. Nagy hangsúlyt fektetünk a hosszú távú munkakapcsolatok kiépítésére és a vállalaton belüli karrierépítésre.

A HUMANIC kilenc országban mintegy 140 üzletből álló hálózattal rendelkezik, amelyek közül tizennyolc üzlet Magyarországon található, az európai cipőipar úttörőjeként. Folyamatosan változó kollekcióinkkal a divat fővárosainak nemzetközi trendjeit azonnal elhozzuk üzleteinkbe és online boltunkba. Akár az elegáns és vonzó üzletek egyikében, akár az online shopban - a HUMANIC-nál a cipők iránti szenvedélyt megéljük. És ez már 1872 óta így van.

A SHOE4YOU a jó minőséget és a kedvező árat képviseli. A SHOE4YOU divatos női-, férfi- és gyermekcipő kínálatával a cipőpiac megkerülhetetlen szereplőjévé vált Ausztria-szerte, mintegy 60 üzletével és saját online áruházával.

AZ ÖN FELADATAI

- Boltvezető helyettesítése
- Ügyfélkiszolgálás és értékesítés.

This is how you'll win us over

- Experience & Skills- Several years of post-consulting experience in cybersecurity strategy, risk management, or related advisory roles- Proven ability to develop strategic recommendations and influence senior decision-makers technical audiences- Experience in digital transformation or enterprise-wide (security) initiatives- Familiarity with specific frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, or similar)- Knowledge of cloud security, OT/IT convergence, or industry-specific security requirements- Experience working in regulated industries or large, complex organizations
- Ways of working: Collaborative, adaptable, and committed to continuous learning, working effectively across diverse teams and staying current with evolving security trends- Languages: business proficiency in English and German

jobs.description:
**Etsimme Voikkaan kuntosalille vastuullista asiakaspalvelijaa**

Voikkaan kuntosali aukeaa kaikelle yleisölle 21.1.2025. Rekrytointi pyritään pitämään nopeana. Rekrytointi on jatkumoa keväällä olleelle työpaikkahaulle joka jäi kesken paikan avaamisen aikataulujen vuoksi.

Voikkaan Kuntosali hakee motivoitunutta ja oma-aloitteista työntekijää monipuoliseen rooliin, jossa yhdistyvät asiakaspalvelu, myynti, sopimushallinta sekä kuntosalin yleisestä siisteydestä ja toimivuudesta huolehtiminen.

Työssäsi olet tärkeä osa kuntosalin arkea ja asiakaskokemusta. Huolehdit siitä, että sali on viihtyisä, siisti ja houkutteleva niin nykyisille kuin uusillekin asiakkaille. Lisäksi osallistut aktiivisesti uusasiakashankintaan sekä yritysasiakkuuksien rakentamiseen alueella.

**Työtehtäviin kuuluvat**

- kuntosalin yleinen ylläpito ja puhtaanapito

- asiakaspalvelu ja uusien asiakkaiden vastaanottaminen

- asiakassopimusten laatiminen ja hallinta

- jäsenmyynti ja asiakkuuksien kehittäminen

- yritysmyynti sekä yhteistyösopimusten tekeminen alueen yritysten kanssa

- kuntosalin palveluiden ja jäsenyyksien aktiivinen markkinointi


**Odotamme sinulta**

- reipasta ja oma-aloitteista työotetta

- hyviä asiakaspalvelu- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

- myynnillistä asennetta ja kykyä tehdä sopimuksia

- järjestelmällisyyttä ja vastuullisuutta

- kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti

- kiinnostusta liikunta- ja hyvinvointialaan


**Eduksi katsotaan**

- Personal trainer kokemus

- aiempi kokemus myyntityöstä

- kokemus asiakaspalvelusta

- kokemus sopimusten tekemisestä tai yritysmyynnistä

- kiinnostus kuntosali- tai hyvinvointialaan


**Tarjoamme**

- monipuolisen ja vastuullisen työn kasvavassa kuntosalissa

- mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa asiakaskokemukseen ja toiminnan kehittämiseen

- vaihtelevan työnkuvan, jossa yhdistyvät käytännön tekeminen ja myyntityö

- mahdollisuuden rakentaa pitkäaikaisia yritysasiakkuuksia paikallisesti


**Työpaikan sijainti** Voikkaa

**Hakeminen** Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si otsikolla **Hakemus / Voikkaan Kuntosali**. osoitteeseen info@voikkaagym.fi

jobs.title: LOĢISTIKAS SPECIĀLISTS
jobs.description:
Tevi interesē transporta un loģistikas nozare un vēlies ar savu darbu veicināt videi drošu un efektīvi organizētu atkritumu apsaimniekošanas pakalpojumu nodrošināšanu? Aicinām pievienoties mūsu komandai LOĢISTIKAS SPECIĀLISTA amatā!

Darba pienākumi

  • Organizēt, plānot un koordinēt atkritumu apsaimniekošanas daļas transporta un loģistikas procesus.
  • Uzturēt un regulāri aktualizēt maršrutu datubāzi, veicot izmaiņas esošajos maršrutos atbilstoši pakalpojuma sniegšanas nosacījumiem.
  • Izstrādāt un plānot jaunus maršrutus, ņemot vērā pakalpojuma apjoma izmaiņas, jaunas pakalpojuma sniegšanas adreses un teritoriālo pārklājumu.
  • Nodrošināt atkritumu konteineru loģistikas plānošanu, uzstādīšanu un apstrādāt ar konteineru skaita, tilpuma vai izvietojuma izmaiņām saistīto informāciju datubāzē.
  • Veikt maršrutu un transporta darbības datu analīzi (nobraukums, laika patēriņš, degvielas patēriņš), sagatavojot priekšlikumus pakalpojuma efektivitātes uzlabošanai.
  • Sadarboties ar citām struktūrvienībām jautājumos, kas skar maršrutu un pakalpojuma sniegšanas plānošanu.
  • Veikt citus ar loģistikas procesu nodrošināšanu saistītus darba uzdevumus.

Piedāvājam

  • Iespēju pilnveidot savas zināšanas un iegūt praktisku pieredzi.
  • Nepilnu darba laiku – 20/h nedēļā.
  • Stabilu atalgojumu  1050,00 EUR (bruto) mēnesī un sociālās garantijas.
  • Stabilu darbu sociāli atbildīgā uzņēmumā, nozīmīgā un sabiedrībai svarīgā nozarē.
  • Veselības apdrošināšanu pēc pārbaudes laika.

namu pārzini

Administratīvā departamenta Tehniskā nodrošinājuma nodaļā

      Latvijas Nacionālā arhīva (turpmāk – LNA) Administratīvā departamenta Tehniskā nodrošinājuma nodaļa (turpmāk – TNN) atbild par visu LNA apsaimniekošanā un lietošanā, kā arī nomā esošo LNA īpašumu pārvaldību un apsaimniekošanu, uzturēšanu Rīgā, kā arī visos zonālajos valsts arhīvos un reģionālā valsts arhīvā, kopā 26 īpašumos visā Latvijā. TNN sadarbojos ar VAS “Valsts nekustamie īpašumi” un citiem pakalpojumu sniedzējiem, kas nodrošina saimnieciska rakstura pakalpojumus, kā arī paši veic saimnieciski tehniskos darbus.


Aicinām mūsu komandai pievienoties apzinīgu, rūpīgu un atbildīgu kolēģi namu pārziņa amatā vienā no mūsu ēkām Bezdelīgu ielā 1A, Rīgā.

Mēs Tev uzticēsim:

  • nodrošināt arhīva ēkas un tās ārējās teritorijas apsaimniekošanu un labiekārtošanu
  • organizēt vai veikt ēkas tehniskā stāvokļa, inženiertehnisko sistēmu, iekārtu uzraudzību, apkopi, remonta darbus
  • būt atbildīgajam par ugunsdrošību un nodrošināt ugunsdrošības prasību izpildi
  • organizēt saimnieciskos un tehniskos procesus un remontdarbus
  • koordinēt sadarbību ar pakalpojumu sniedzējiem, uzraudzīt veikto darbu kvalitāti
  • nodrošināt ēkā esošās LNA struktūrvienības ar precēm un pakalpojumiem, veikt materiālo resursu uzskaiti.

Mums ir svarīgi, lai Tev ir:

  • vismaz vidējā vai vidējā profesionālā izglītība
  • profesionālā darba pieredze saimnieciski tehnisku darbu veikšanā, vēlams namu apsaimniekošanā
  • vēlamas prasmes būvniecībā un inženierkomunikāciju ekspluatācijā
  • apmācības ugunsdrošībā vismaz 20 stundu apjomā un attiecīga apliecība tiks uzskatītas par priekšrocību
  • prasme organizēt, plānot savu darbu, patstāvīgi risināt darb

jobs.title: Toolmaker / Mold Maintenance Technician (Injection Molding)
jobs.description:
Aquaphor International OÜ is looking for an experienced Toolmaker / Mold Maintenance Technician (Injection Molding) to join our team.

Work tasks: Job description
Repair, service, and maintain injection molds. Perform preventive maintenance and keep molds production-ready. Diagnose mold and tooling issues and carry out necessary repairs. Disassemble, inspect, repair, and assemble molds and their components. Repair and manufacture tooling, mold components, and production fixtures. Support mold trials and troubleshoot mold-related issues in production. Preferred candidate profile Technical or vocational education in toolmaking, machining, mechanical engineering, industrial maintenance, or a related field. At least 3 years of hands-on experience in toolmaking, mold assembly, maintenance, or repair of injection molds. Good understanding of injection mold construction, components, mechanisms, and operating principles. Ability to repair and maintain injection molds of varying complexity, including cold runner and hot runner systems. Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings for molds and tooling. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Responsible, precise, and quality-focused approach to work. Good working knowledge of technical English.

We offer: Fixed-term contract for 12 months, with the possibility of extension
4-month probation period. Full-time position, 40 hours per week. Work location: Tallinn, Estonia. Employer-provided health insurance. 28 calendar days of annual leave. Company-provided workwear and personal protective equipment. A performance-based bonus system.

Option to work from home: No

jobs.title: Danish-speaking Assistance Coordinator in Spain
jobs.description:
Viking Travel Care is looking for Danish-speaking Assistance Coordinators to join our travel insurance assistance centre in Spain.

At Viking Travel Care, you will assist Nordic travellers around the world when they experience illness, accidents or other unexpected situations while travelling. You will provide important support to customers who need reassurance, information and practical assistance.

This could be an exciting opportunity for you if you already live in Spain or are considering moving here.

What does the role involve?

As an Assistance Coordinator, you will often be the first person a customer speaks to when something has happened.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Answering telephone calls and emails
    Listening to customers and understanding their situation
    Opening and following up on cases
    Providing information about insurance coverage
    Assisting with arrangements involving doctors, clinics, transport, hotels or repatriation when required
    Working with insurance companies, doctors, clinics and other partners

Our assistance centre operates 24/7, and working hours are organised across daytime, evening, night and weekend shifts.

Who are we looking for?

You do not need a particular educational background to apply. What matters most is that you enjoy helping people, communicate well and are comfortable working in a busy environment.

Experience in customer service, travel, healthcare, insurance, hospitality or other people-focused roles may be relevant, but it is not a requirement.

A background in areas such as languages, travel and tourism, healthcare, law, insurance or international studies may also be relevant, but is not required.

We are looking for someone who:

    Speaks and writes Danish fluently
    Speaks and writes English confidently
    Is comfortable communicating by telephone and in writing
    Is organised and accurate
    Enjoys finding solutions
    Works well both as part of a team and independently
    Learns new systems quickly
    Is flexible and positive

Additional languages are an advantage.

To proceed in the recruitment process, you must be able to provide a clean criminal record certificate.

What we offer

    A full-time position in accordance with Spanish employment law
    Thorough and structured training
    A competitive salary and good employment conditions
    A social and inclusive working environment
    Varied working days where you can make a genuine difference
    Opportunities for personal and professional development
    Attractive offices in Torrevieja or Fuengirola

How to apply

Please submit your application and CV. Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis.

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Viking Travel Care assists travelers and expatriate employees around the world on behalf of travel insurance companies. jobs.title: Kok til The Food Company - fri hver aften og weekender
jobs.description:
Forestil dig et kokkejob, hvor du har fri hver aften og alle weekender

Faste dagsvagter • Fri hver aften • Fri alle weekender • 37 timer

Du elsker at lave god mad.

Men måske er du blevet træt af sene aftener, weekendarbejde og at skulle vælge mellem dit arbejde og dit privatliv.

Hos The Food Company behøver du ikke vælge. Vi søger en fagligt dygtig kok, der stadig brænder for håndværket – men som også sætter pris på at kunne spise aftensmad med familien, have fri i weekenderne og vide, hvornår arbejdsdagen slutter.

Her får du et køkken med høj faglighed, gode kolleger og ordnede forhold - uden de klassiske arbejdstider, som mange kokke gerne vil væk fra.

Det får du hos os

✔ Fast arbejde på daghold

✔ Fri hver aften

✔ Fri alle weekender

✔ 37 timers fuldtidsstilling

✔ Eget parti med ansvar og indflydelse

✔ Et stærkt køkkenteam, der hjælper hinanden

✔ Mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt

Kort sagt: Du får mulighed for at arbejde med det, du elsker, samtidig med at du får mere tid til livet uden for køkkenet.

 

Et køkken, hvor kvalitet og fællesskab går hånd i hånd

Hos The Food Company laver vi mad med stolthed.

Vi tror på godt håndværk, gode råvarer og kolleger, der spiller hinanden gode.

Du får ansvar for dit eget parti og følger produktionen hele vejen fra planlægning til den færdige ret. Vi giver dig frihed til at tage ansvar, fordi vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes af dygtige mennesker, der får lov til at bruge deres faglighed.

Samtidig står du aldrig alene. Vi arbejder som ét hold og hjælper hinanden, når der er travlt. Det skaber både høj kvalitet og en arbejdsplads, hvor man har lyst til at møde ind.

 

Vi tror på, at de bedste kokke...

...har faglig stolthed.

...kan lide at tage ansvar.

...nyder at samarbejde.

...har øje for kvalitet.

...og altid ønsker at levere et godt resultat.

Hvis du kan genkende dig selv i det, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

 

Hvem er du?

Du er uddannet kok, eller har solid erfaring fra et professionelt køkken.

Du arbejder struktureret, bevarer overblikket og sætter en ære i, at det, der forlader dit parti, altid lever op til en høj standard.

Du kommer med en positiv indstilling og bidrager til et godt samarbejde, fordi du ved, at den bedste mad bliver skabt af et godt team.

 

Vi hjælper hinanden

Hos os er ingen opgaver vigtigere end fællesskabet.

Når der er travlt, giver vi en hånd med, hvor der er brug for det. Vi tror ikke på "det er ikke mit bord" – vi tror på holdånd.

Det er en vigtig del af vores kultur, og det er også derfor, vi kalder vores måde at arbejde på Service by Feeling.

 

Praktisk

Arbejdstid

37 timer om ugen, mandag til fredag i dagtimerne.

Mødetid typisk omkring kl. 06.00

Arbejdssted

Ny Banegårdsgade 48

8000 Aarhus C

Tiltrædelse

Hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

 

Kunne det være dig?

Så send din ansøgning og dit CV via vores rekrutteringssystem.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette kollega.

Måske er du allerede godt tilfreds med dit nuværende job.

Men hvis du savner mere balance i hverdagen, uden at gå på kompromis med dit fag – så synes vi, du skal tage en snak med os.

jobs.title: Autonasentaja / Ajoneuvoasentaja monipuolisiin huolto- ja korjaustehtäviin, Kuopion Yritysautohuolto, Kuopio
jobs.description:
Autonasentaja – Kuopion Yritysautohuolto

Työn kuvaus

Haemme **kokenutta autonasentajaa Kuopion Yritysautohuoltoon** vahvistamaan ja kehittämään yritysautojen huolto- ja korjauspalveluamme.

Kuopion Yritysautohuolto keskittyy yritysten **henkilö- ja pakettiautojen huoltoon, korjaukseen ja vianetsintään**. Asiakkaidemme ajoneuvot ovat pääasiassa päivittäisessä ammattikäytössä, joten meille on tärkeää saada autot huollettua ja korjattua laadukkaasti ja sujuvasti takaisin liikenteeseen.

Etsimme asentajaa, jolla on **3–5 vuoden tai pidempi käytännön kokemus autonasentajan työstä** ja joka pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti erilaisten huolto-, korjaus- ja vianetsintätehtävien parissa.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa

- henkilö- ja pakettiautojen määräaikaishuollot

- jarru- ja alustakorjaukset

- moottori- ja voimansiirtoon liittyvät korjaukset

- vianetsintä ja diagnostiikka

- ajoneuvojen sähkövikojen selvittäminen

- lisälaitteiden ja varusteiden asennukset

- muut monipuoliset autokorjaamon huolto- ja korjaustyöt


Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Toivomme sinulta:

- **3–5 vuoden tai pidempää kokemusta autonasentajan työstä**

- monipuolista käytännön osaamista henkilö- ja pakettiautojen huolto- ja korjaustöistä

- kokemusta vianetsinnästä ja diagnostiikasta

- kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn

- huolellista ja vastuullista työotetta

- B-ajokorttia


Kokemus pakettiautoista, hyötyajoneuvoista ja ajoneuvosähköstä katsotaan eduksi.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme **monipuolisen työn ja mahdollisuuden tulla mukaan kehittämään Kuopion Yritysautohuollon toimintaa**.

Taustalla on toimiva korjaamo, valmis yritysasiakaskunta ja pitkä kokemus yritysten kaluston huolto- ja korjaustöistä. Yritysautohuoltoa kehitämme omana palvelukokonaisuutenaan, ja haemme siihen nyt osaavaa autonasentajaa.

Työssä pääset tekemään monipuolisesti huolto-, korjaus-, diagnostiikka- ja vianetsintätöitä eri automerkkien parissa.

Korjaamossamme huolletaan ja korjataan myös muuta yritysasiakkaiden kalustoa, joten toimintaympäristö on tavallista autokorjaamoa monipuolisempi.

Työtä on mahdollista tehdä **kokoaikaisessa tai osa-aikaisessa palkkatyösuhteessa**. Myös työskentelystä kevyt- tai sopimusyrittäjänä voidaan sopia erikseen.

**Palkkaus sovitaan kokemuksen ja osaamisen perusteella.**

Hakeminen

Lähetä hakemus ja kerro lyhyesti aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi, osaamisestasi sekä siitä, millaisten autojen ja korjaustöiden parissa olet työskennellyt.

Voit myös soittaa ja kysyä tehtävästä lisää.

**Jos olet kokenut autonasentaja ja etsit monipuolista työtä yritysasiakkaiden kaluston parissa, ota yhteyttä.**

jobs.title: Consultant DevOps et Cloud (H/F)
jobs.description:
A propos du poste

Dans le cadre de la modernisation globale de ses infrastructures, notre client migre ses workloads actuellement hébergés sur des serveurs physiques RKE en fin de vie en Chine vers des services managés d'un cloud provider chinois. Ce projet stratégique d'une durée estimée à 12 mois vise à concevoir une architecture cible moderne, automatisée et hautement disponible.

Contrat : CDI de projet ou contrat Freelance, projet d'une durée initiale d'une année (atterrissage prévu été 2027).

Localisation : Secteur de Montbéliard, une présence sur site à minima de 2 jours / semaine sera nécessaire les 3 premières semaines pour la phase de cadrage.







Vos missions :

Rattaché(e) à l'équipe technique de la DSI, vos responsabilités seront les suivantes :

- Cadrage et Chiffrage : Réaliser l'étude technique de faisabilité, définir l'architecture cible et présenter le chiffrage détaillé au DSI courant septembre.

- Build de l'Architecture : Concevoir et construire l'infrastructure sur un cloud provider chinois (type Alibaba Cloud) en privilégiant les services managés.

- Automatisation & Déploiement : Reproduire les mécanismes d'automatisation existants sur GCP à l'aide de Terraform et déployer les nouveaux clusters via Helm.

- Résolution des points de friction : Concevoir les architectures réseau (SD-WAN, cross-border line) pour maintenir la connectivité API avec Google, gérer l'interopérabilité de l'authentification (Google Identity) et définir les politiques de sécurité équivalentes à Cloud Armor.








Talent recherché

Expérience : Track record avéré et obligatoire sur un cloud provider chinois (idéalement Alibaba Cloud).
Nous recherchons un profil ayant à minima 5 années d'expérience en tant que Consultant DevOps et Cloud ou Architect Cloud et ayant déjà participé à des phases de cadrage et de chiffrage.

Compétences techniques :
- Compétences Cloud Chinois (Alibaba Cloud ou autre)

- Maîtrise de l'écosystème Kubernetes managé, des bases de données managées et du stockage objet.

- Expertise sur Terraform et Helm.

- Solides compétences en architecture réseau internationale et connectivité cross-border.

- Compétences GCP

- Connaissance des solutions de sécurité (WAF/Cloud Armor) et de gestion des identités (SSO/Google Cloud Identity).

- Utilisation de l'IA au quotidien

Soft Skills :

- Esprit de synthèse et pragmatisme pour concevoir des solutions simples à exploiter au quotidien.

- Autonomie et force de proposition pour guider le client sur ses choix stratégiques (ex. alternatives à PubSub).

- Capacité à communiquer facilement avec des équipes transverses

Langues : Anglais fluent (contexte international), Français, Mandarin serait un très gros plus








Processus de recrutement :

- Entretien initial avec notre recruteur et le responsable de la structure qui est ingénieur en informatique.
- Présentation de votre candidature à notre client (suite à un accord commun).
- Rencontre avec le client et ses équipes pour échanger sur le poste et les attentes.

Vous souhaitez en savoir plus ? Nous vous invitons à candidater et/ou à nous contacter !

jobs.description:
Jobbeskrivelse

Vil du være med til at sikre at vores kunder altid får den bedste service, når de henvender sig på lageret? Vil du være en del af et stærkt fællesskab med gode muligheder for udvikling og ansvar? Hos STARK Svendborg søger vi en engageret Lagermedarbejder, der vil være med til at forme både sin egen og STARKs fremtid som Danmarks førende distributør af byggematerialer.


Din rolle som Lagermedarbejder i STARK
Du bliver en del af lageret i STARK Svendborg, hvor vi målrettet arbejder med lagerstyring og for at give vores kunder den bedste service. Som STARKs nye Lagermedarbejder vil du få en vigtig rolle i at servicere kunderne og håndtere både ind- og udgående varer i samarbejde med resten af teamet. Det betyder at du:

  • Er ansvarlig for varemodtagelse og -registrering.

  • Sikrer et altid salgsklart lager, hvilket inkluderer vareopfyldning, trimning, prisskiltning på hyldeforkanter samt oprydning og orden.  

  • Arbejder med ordrehåndtering, herunder pluk og pak, emballering og læsning på lastvogn.

  • Tager del i at sikre at lageret altid er et sikkert sted at færdes – både for medarbejdere og kunder.

  • Indgår i et tæt samarbejde med kollegaer på lageret, for at sikre optimal koordinering og effektiv planlægning af varehåndtering og ordrebehandling.  

  • Med fordel har truckcertifikat og kørekort B.


Vores nye Lagermedarbejder
Du vil blive en del af at sikre, at vi efterlever vores værdier. Det betyder, at vi udviser ordentlighed, passion og stolthed overfor vores kunder, samarbejdspartnere, leverandører og kollegaer i det daglige arbejde. For at trives i rollen som lagermedarbejder er det vigtigt, at du:

  • Er effektiv i planlægning og evner at navigere efter fakta og se de små detaljer.

  • Er stabil og tager ejerskab over dine opgaver og lægger vægt på det gode samarbejde.

Den rette kandidat, for os, kan både være faglært og ufaglært inden for lagerlogistik eller med anden relevant uddannelse. Selvom produktkendskab og brancheerfaring kan være nyttigt, er det ikke en forudsætning. Det vigtigste for os er din interesse og motivation for at arbejde med lagerhåndtering, kundeservice og at blive en del af STARK holdet.
 


Yderligere jobbeskrivelse

Bliv en del af STARK holdet

Hos STARK ser vi mangfoldighed som en værdifuld egenskab, og vores medarbejderes bidrag er nøglen til vores fremgang. Vi opfordrer derfor alle, som kan se sig selv i stillingen til at søge. Udover gode arbejdsforhold og ansættelse på overenskomst har vi personalepolitikker, der tilgodeser medarbejderen i tråd med STARKs værdi om ordentlighed.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer og vi håber, at du kan starte senest d. 1. september 2026

Send os dit CV med en kort beskrivelse af din motivation for at søge stillingen hos STARK Svendborg via linket. Vi inviterer til samtaler løbende og afslutter, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål jobbet, eller er du nysgerrig på at vide mere om STARK Svendborg som din kommende arbejdsplads, er du velkommen til at kontakte Driftschef Erik Johansen på telefon +45 41915420

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

___________________________________________________

Om STARK

STARK er Danmarks største forhandler og distributør af byggematerialer med flere end 80 forretninger i Danmark og Grønland. STARK tilbyder også faglig rådgivning og en lang række services til både entreprenører og professionelle håndværkere. Virksomheden beskæftiger over 2.400 medarbejdere og er en del af STARK Group, der med flere end 18.500 medarbejdere og 1.050 forretninger og distributionscentre i Norden, Storbritannien, Tyskland og Østrig, er en førende leverandør af byggematerialer i Europa.

STARK Group har SBTi-godkendte net zero klimamål for 2050. Koncernen har underskrevet FN’s Global Compact principper og er anerkendt af EcoVadis med en Platinum-rating for sin bæredygtighedsindsats. 

Vi bygger fremtiden ved at hjælpe andre med at bygge deres.

jobs.title: Harness Manufacturing Technician - ICEYE, Espoo
jobs.description:
Want to build the hardware that goes to space - with your own hands?

We are looking for Harness Manufacturing Technician to join our client, ICEYE, in Otaniemi, Espoo. The position is for a full-time role. The employment contract will be signed with Barona Production Oy, and the work will begin as agreed.

As a Harness Manufacturing Technician, you'll be working hands-on with real satellite hardware in ICEYE's Satellite Integration team in Espoo. You'll assemble and verify the wiring harnesses that go inside the satellites themselves - precise, high-stakes work that directly contributes to missions in orbit.

What we are looking for

We are seeking candidates with 1 to 3 years of hands-on experience in cable or wiring harness assembly, preferably from aerospace, electronics, or other high-reliability industries. A vocational or technical qualification in electronics, electrical engineering, mechanical assembly, or equivalent practical training is considered beneficial.

The ideal candidate has strong manual dexterity and enjoys precise work with small wires, connectors and cable assemblies. You are able to read and interpret assembly drawings, wiring tables and work instructions accurately and consistently. Experience in crimping, soldering, wire stripping, lacing and connector assembly is expected. Familiarity with harness testing, coaxial or shielded cable assemblies, or work in aerospace, space or defense environments is considered an advantage. Good written and spoken English is required.

What you bring

- Experience in cable or harness assembly or similar technical production work
- Practical skills in crimping, soldering, wire stripping, lacing and connector assembly
- Ability to read and interpret assembly drawings, wiring tables and work instructions
- Strong manual dexterity and attention to detail
- Understanding of quality standards and testing methods is considered an advantage

Success in this role requires a careful and systematic way of working, a strong focus on quality standards, and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment. You take responsibility for the quality of your work, communicate clearly and contribute to shared production goal.

What we offer

We offer the opportunity to work with advanced satellite hardware as part of ICEYEs Satellite Integration, Harness & MLI Manufacturing Team in Espoo. The role provides meaningful hands-on work supporting the production of SAR satellites while offering excellent opportunities for professional development and certification training. The working environment is international and inclusive, with colleagues representing approximately 60 nationalities. The work is carried out on-site in Espoo, Otaniemi. Please note that the role requires a clean background, and selected candidates will undergo a security clearance.

The contract is for a full-time role (37,5h/week) and the working hours are from 9 to 17. At first we will offer a fixed-term contract for six months.

Interested?

Submit your application as soon as possible via the provided link, as interviews may be conducted during the application period.

For more information, please contact Baronas Service Manager Pirkka Lind pirkka.lind@barona.fi

Please note that we do not process applications sent by email.

jobs.title: Revontuliretkille moottorikelkkaopas
jobs.description:
REVONTULIRETKILLE MOOTTORIKELKKAOPAS SAARISELÄLLE – TALVIKAUSI 2026–2027

**18€/h + Tes-lisät | osa-aikainen 19.11.2026 – 31.3.2027**

Haluaisitko tehdä lisätienestiä revontuliretkien moottorikelkkaoppaana?

Reindeer's Travel Oy etsii osa-aikaisia**moottorikelkkaoppaita** tulevalle talvisesongille SAARISELÄLLE.

Olemme voimakkaasti kasvava saamelaisomisteinen perheyritys, joka järjestää poro-, mönkijä- ja moottorikelkkaretkiä Saariselän upeissa maisemissa.

Meille tärkeintä **hyvä asiakaspalvelu, aidot elämykset ja turvallisuus**. Haluamme, että asiakkaamme lähtevät retkeltä hymyillen ja muistavat kokemuksensa vielä pitkään kotiin palattuaan.

MITÄ PÄIVÄSI OPPAANA SISÄLTÄÄ?

Moottorikelkkaoppaana työpäiväsi on vaihteleva ja käytännönläheinen.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

- asiakkaiden vastaanottaminen ja opastaminen

- moottorikelkkojen ja varusteiden valmistelu safareille

- turvallisuus- ja ajo-ohjeiden antaminen asiakkaille

- moottorikelkkasafareiden vetäminen

- asiakkaiden turvallisuudesta huolehtiminen retkien aikana

- kalustosta ja varusteista huolehtiminen

- safariympäristön ylläpitoon osallistuminen

- yhteistyö muiden oppaiden ja muun tiimin kanssa.


Työ tapahtuu pääasiassa ulkona Lapin talviolosuhteissa. Pakkaset, lumi ja vaihtelevat sääolosuhteet kuuluvat työhön – samoin kuin upeat talvimaisemat ja asiakkaiden ilo onnistuneen safari jälkeen.

**MILLAISTA OPPASTA ETSIMME?**

Etsimme ennen kaikkea **luotettavaa, reipasta ja hyvän asenteen omaavaa ihmistä**.

Aikaisempi opaskokemus on ehdottomasti plussaa, mutta sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis ammattilainen. **Perehdytämme sinut tehtävään ja tuemme sinua työssä onnistumisessa.**

**Sinulla on:**

- kokemusta moottorikelkalla ajamisesta

- turvallinen ja vastuullinen ajotapa

- sujuva englannin kielen taito

- hyvät asiakaspalvelu- ja vuorovaikutustaidot

- hyvä fyysinen kunto

- valmius työskennellä ulkona talviolosuhteissa

- B-ajokortti.


**Katsomme eduksi:**

- aikaisemman opas- tai ohjelmapalvelualan kokemuksen

- muun kielitaidon

- ensiaputaidot

- kokemuksen kansainvälisten asiakkaiden kanssa työskentelystä.

- Muut ajokorttiluokat ehdoton plussa


Jos ensiapukoulutus ei vielä löydy taskustasi, ei hätää – järjestämme tarvittaessa koulutuksen ennen kauden alkua.

**MITÄ ME TARJOAMME?**

Me haluamme, että työntekijöillämme on hyvät edellytykset onnistua työssään.

Saat meiltä:

- **18€/h + ohjelmapalvelualan TES:n mukaiset lisät**

- **Laadukkaat työvaatteet ja tarvittavat työvälineet**

- **Kattavan perehdytyksen ja tuen työhön**

- **Työn upeissa Lapin talvimaisemissa**

- **Ammattitaitoisen ja tiiviin työyhteisön**

- **Mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa opasosaamistasi kasvavassa yrityksessä**


**TYÖSUHDE**

Työsuhde on määräaikainen talvisesongin ajalle marraskuusta 2026 maaliskuun 2027 loppuun.

Mahdollisuus työllistyä jo syys-lokakuuksi revontuliretkille mönkijöillä.

Työ on osa-aikainen ja työvuoroja on sesongin ilta-aikaan sekä viikonloppuisin. Mahdollisuus tehdä halutessaan myös päiväsafareita tarvittaessa. sekä pidempiä muutaman viikon pätkiä täysillä viikko tunneilla. Työmäärä vaihtelee varaustilanteen mukaan.

**MIKSI REINDEER'S TRAVEL?**

Me emme halua olla vain paikka, jossa käyt tekemässä työvuorosi.

Olemme kasvava, saamelaisomisteinen perheyritys, jossa arvostetaan **hyvää tekemisen meininkiä, vastuullisuutta, luontoa ja sitä, että pidetään toisistamme huolta.**

Jos nautit ulkoilmasta, moottorikelkkailusta, ihmisistä ja vaihtelevista työpäivistä, saatat olla juuri etsimämme henkilö.

**KIINNOSTUITKO?**

**Jos ajatus talvesta Saariselällä kuulostaa hyvältä, lähetä meille hakemuksesi!**

Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.

Hakemukset ja CV sähköpostitsekatja.heikkinen@reindeerstravels.fi

Annan mielelläni lisätietoja työstä ja meistä

**Katja Heikkinen** 040 166 1000

jobs.title: Postdoc in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows
jobs.description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows

We seek a bioinformatician to develop computational workflows to analyze large-scale microbiome multi-omics data in multiple projects studying human and animal health, including the consortium project PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net) and EU Horizon 2020 project MICROB-PREDICT (https://microb-predict.eu/). We strive to implement efficient and scalable workflows to analyze and integrate these data derived from metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, and metaproteomics in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. We have developed the MIntO package (https://github.com/arumugamlab/MIntO) that integrates microbiome metagenomic and metatranscriptomic data. Our ambition is to develop new workflows that expand MIntO’s features (e.g., novel analysis types) as well as datatypes (e.g., metabolomic data).

In this position, you will be:

  • Responsible for improving and expanding workflows in our current MIntO pipeline, while also having a chance to create your own novel workflows.

  • Expected to participate in and lead existing projects within these consortia and other projects in the Arumugam group; and are highly encouraged to initiate new cutting-edge research projects.

  • Expected to interact and collaborate with other clinical researchers, veterinarians, biologists, and bioinformaticians in these consortia, to enhance and ensure proper interpretation of experimental results.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree and documented research experience in one or more of the areas/fields mentioned below:

  • Bioinformatics

  • Biology

The Postdoc fellowship is aimed at early-career researchers with a background in basic science. We are particularly interested in candidates with solid experience in analyzing large volumes of next-generation sequencing data, who are aware of challenges in scalability and efficiency

Required qualifications:

  • PhD in bioinformatics or biology with strong experience in software development.

  • Academic preparation as well as experience in biological statistics.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or R.

  • Experience with bioinformatics workflow environments such as snakemake, NextFlow or CWL.

  • Experience in analyzing next-generation sequencing datasets.

  • Experience in a high-performance computing environment using any flavor of UNIX.

  • Demonstrated capacity for effective teamwork.

  • Proven track record showing scientific productivity in peer-reviewed journals.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.

The following qualifications are highly preferred, but not required. Candidates who possess any of these qualifications are encouraged to highlight them in the application:

  • Basic understanding of disease biology and/or microbiology.

  • Experience in analyzing metagenomic datasets from host-associated microbiota.

  • Experience in handling multi-omics data, including metabolomics and proteomics.

  • Experience in distributed and cloud computing technologies.

  • Experience in supervising other researchers at different levels.

  • International mobility

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision – We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information, please contact Group Leader Mani Arumugam, Department of Clinical Research, e-mail: arumugam@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 23649552 or Head of Department at the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477 

Application deadline

September 09, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a detailed description of research experience

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

We seek a data scientist to derive insights from host-microbiome multi-omics data in multiple consortium projects studying human and animal health, including GALAXY/MicrobLiver studying liver fibrosis (https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/galaxy), MICROB-PREDICT studying late-stage liver cirrhosis (https://microb-predict.eu/), and PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net). jobs.title: Postdoctoral Fellow in Steam Turbines for Ships
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You can find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

     

Video: https://youtu.be/Xt-yHCN5QS0About the position

We invite applications for a postdoctoral fellow research position in steam turbines for ships. The work will be embedded in the SFI - SAINT project Sustainable, Applied and Industrialized Nuclear Technology, which supports the launch of 2-3 nuclear powered demonstration ships in the early 2030s. Within the SAINT project, you will work in Work Package 3 – From heat to propulsion.

The shipping industry accounts for roughly 3% of global CO₂ emissions, and with international pressure to decarbonize hard-to-abate sectors, nuclear propulsion is emerging as a serious candidate for deep-sea and high-utilization vessels where battery or hydrogen solutions face fundamental range and energy density constraints.

Steam turbines are already in use in commercial ships today, based on fossil fuels. This research project will investigate how to integrate steam turbines, thermal and electrical energy storages, and a nuclear reactor in an energy efficient and operational reliable energy system for various ship types. As a Post Doc (PD), you will work closely with other members of the project, both industry partners, PhD candidates and other researchers in the project on a daily basis. You will also be a part of the PD/PhD community at our institute, counting around 40 candidates at present, who work on other projects but on topics related to yours.

Your work will be to investigate the present applications of steam turbines in shipping, identify critical criteria for integration and operation, and develop a model for simulation of the energy system. This includes normal operations, ramping, transit vs. port stay, and maintenance requirements. The aim of the work is to use this tool to size the reactor (output heat), steam turbine, energy storages, and other components of the propulsion system for three specified use cases: a tanker, an offshore vessel, and a floating nuclear power plant.

Are you ready to take your research career to the next level? We offer an exciting 3-year postdoctoral position that gives you the opportunity to develop a strong profile as researcher. You will also gain valuable experience that might be relevant for your further career.

The purpose of a postdoctoral position is to build up a researcher profile that qualifies for a position as associate professor. The position may also offer additional skills that are relevant to the postdoctoral fellow's future career.

Apply for this position to become part of our research environment and take the next step in your career with us.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department. 


About the project 

Naval vessels and polar icebreakers have operated on nuclear power for decades. Nuclear propulsion is emerging as a serious candidate for decarbonization of deep-sea and high-utilization vessels in Norway and internationally, offering greater energy independence, higher sustained speeds, and extended range compared to conventional fuel-based propulsion. International bodies are actively establishing the frameworks that will govern the civil use of nuclear propulsion and the foundational engineering knowledge is being established right now.

SAINT - Sustainable, Applied and Industrialized Nuclear Technology - is a research project investigating the use of nuclear propulsion for commercial and specialist maritime vessels and aims at launching 2-3 demonstration ships in the early 2030s. SAINT addresses the technical, safety, and operational challenges that must be resolved before such systems can be responsibly deployed. PhD and Post Doc candidates will be among the people shaping this emergent field. In the intersection of nuclear and maritime engineering qualified engineers and researchers are scarce globally. Candidates who complete a PhD within the SAINT project will be well positioned for careers in nuclear safety, maritime regulation, advanced vessel design, and the emerging commercial nuclear sector.

The project is hosted at the Department of Ocean Operations and Civil Engineering (IHB) at NTNU in Ålesund, a campus with deep roots in maritime engineering and ship design. Around 70 PhD students are at NTNU in Ålesund, roughly 40 of which are in IHB working on ship design, naval control systems and in shipping management. Within the project we are aiming to recruit up to ten PhD students and one or two Post Docs to work in parallel across the core engineering challenges of maritime nuclear propulsion, creating an unusually dense and collaborative internal research environment in which you will collaborate with researchers working across nuclear engineering, naval architecture, electrical power systems, and maritime operations.

The project is carried out in close collaboration with thirty industry partners spanning shipbuilders, reactor vendors, turbine manufacturers, control system developers, classification societies, and maritime operators. A dedicated test center for non-nuclear testing of reactor and turbine systems is under construction, giving SAINT researchers hands-on access to hardware validation at a scale rarely available in academic maritime research.


Duties of the position
  • Carry out research of outstanding quality
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in the research group of SFI SAINT 
  • Apply for research funding and write applications and report on progress to funding sources 
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions 
  • Teaching 
  • Mentoring students, helping them with their research projects, and advising on methodology and academic writing 

Required selection criteria
  • You must have completed a doctoral degree in engineering or other relevant areas
  • If you are in the final phase of your doctorate and can document that the thesis has been submitted or that the defense date has been confirmed, your application can be considered even if you have not defended. NOTE: Documentation of the obtained doctorate must be presented before you can take up the position.
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English equivalent level B2/C1

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

If you do not already have educational competence that meets the requirements for a position as associate professor in Norway, NTNU will arrange for you to acquire such competence during the employment period. In such cases, you will also be assigned relevant teaching as part of the career-promoting work.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions and for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Background in physics, control engineering, electrical engineering, nuclear engineering, mechanical engineering or a closely related field
  • Project management experience
  • Publishing experience
  • Teaching experience
  • Good written and oral Norwegian or Scandinavian language skills

Personal characteristics

Working as a Postdoctoral fellow requires that you:

  • Work independently 
  • Work structured, set goals and make plans to achieve them 
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals 
  • Engage and contribute constructively with feedback 
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity  
  • Show curiosity and a strong motivation for the subject 
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions  
  • Are flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • Have good collaboration skills

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer 
  • An exciting job with an important social mission
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment 
  • Career guidance throughout the postdoctoral program and together with you we will prepare a career plan, which contains the skills and knowledge you will acquire
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues 
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a Postdoctoral Fellow at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals.

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education.

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.


Salary and conditions

As a Postdoctoral Fellow (code 1352) you are normally paid from gross NOK 633 400,- per annum before tax, depending on qualifications and seniority. From the salary, 2% is deducted as a contribution to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.


The period of employment is 3 years

As an employee at NTNU, it is important to keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and to adapt to them. 

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed


About the application 

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English.

The application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above.

The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request. 

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's-,Master's- and PhD degrees. If you have not yet completed your PhD, you must provide confirmation on your estimated date for the doctoral dissertation, or confirmation that your PhD thesis has been submitted. Documentation of a completed doctoral degree must be presented before taking up the position.

Reindeer's Travel Oy etsii **moottorikelkkaoppaita** tulevalle talvisesongille Saariselälle.

Olemme voimakkaasti kasvava saamelaisomisteinen perheyritys, joka järjestää poro-, mönkijä- ja moottorikelkkaretkiä Saariselän upeissa maisemissa.

Meille tärkeintä **hyvä asiakaspalvelu, aidot elämyksetja turvallisuus**. Haluamme, että asiakkaamme lähtevät retkeltä hymyillen ja muistavat kokemuksensa vielä pitkään kotiin palattuaan.

Moottorikelkkaoppaana työpäiväsi on vaihteleva ja käytännönläheinen.

Aikaisempi opas- tai matkailualan kokemus on ehdottomasti plussaa, mutta sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis ammattilainen. **Perehdytämme sinut tehtävään ja tuemme sinua työssä onnistumisessa.**

Jos ensiapukoulutus ei vielä löydy taskustasi, ei hätää – järjestämme tarvittaessa koulutuksen ennen kauden alkua.

Drømmer at være en del af et dynamisk, fagligt stærkt og velfungerende dagkirurgisk afsnit? med fri i weekender og på helligdage?

Så er her en mulighed for at: 

få en hverdag med mening, udvikling og fantastiske kollega fællesskab.

Vi øger vores aktivitet og opnormerer. Vi søger derfor en frisk og dedikeret sygeplejerske, som har lyst at være med til at udvikle fremtidens dagkirurgi. Hvor vi sammen skal sikre den sygeplejefaglige kvalitet i et sundhedsvæsen i forandring, i en tid hvor flere og flere patientforløb overgår til dag- og sammedagskirurgi. 

Hos os får du en unik mulighed for at arbejde med hele patientforløbet i et speciale i udvikling. Du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt afsnit, hvor kvalitet, udvikling og arbejdsglæde går hånd i hånd, og hvor vi prioriterer både patientoplevelsen og medarbejdertrivslen højt.

Vi har et stærkt læringsmiljø med undervisning, simulation og faglig sparring som en naturlig del af hverdagen.

 

En hverdag med helhedssygepleje

I Dagkirurgi 4 arbejder vi med korttidssygepleje og følger patienten gennem hele forløbet:

Modtagelse → Operation → Opvågning → Udskrivelse

Den helhedsorienterede tilgang giver et varieret arbejde med stor selvstændighed og tæt patientkontakt. Samtidig bidrager den til høj sygeplejefaglig kvalitet og sammenhængende patientforløb.

Vi har fokus på at skabe trygge, individuelle og sammenhængende patientforløb Og arbejder med Fundamentals of Care (FoC)

 

Spændende specialer og nye muligheder

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med patienter inden for:

  • Kvindesygdomme
  • Nedre mave- og tarmsygdomme
  • Urinvejskirurgi
  • Plastik og brystkirurgi 

 

Vi tilbyder
  • et spændende og varieret arbejde i et dagkirurgisk afsnit i udvikling
  • et struktureret introduktionsforløb tilpasset dine kompetencer og erfaringer
  • en engageret personalegruppe med humor, hjælpsomhed og stærkt kollegialt sammenhold
  • et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde med fokus på kvalitet og patientoplevelser
  • ønskeplan med indflydelse på egen arbejdstilrettelæggelse - fri i weekender og på helligdage
  • fast undervisning hver onsdag morgen (mono- og tværfaglig undervisning)

- Månedlig simulationstræning med fokus på kliniske færdigheder, akutte situationer,

   kommunikation og tværfagligt samarbejde

  • Sociale aktiviteter og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, fx i biografklub, efter arbejde 
  • Mulighed for ansættelse på 32-37 timer ugentligt.

 

Vi søger en sygeplejerske, der
  • har teknisk flair og interesse for instrumentel sygepleje og digitale løsninger
  • har lyst til at påvirke sygeplejens udvikling i et dagkirurgisk afsnit
  • trives med højt patientflow og kan bevare overblikket
  • har stærke kompetencer i planlægning, prioritering og koordinering
  • er positiv, refleksiv og løsningsorienteret
  • rr omstillingsparat og trives i en hverdag i bevægelse og konstant forandring
  • har interesse for at planlægge og implementere IT-løsninger, der styrker kvalitet og patientforløb
  • har gode kommunikations- og samarbejdsevner
  • vil bidrage aktivt til et stærkt og udviklende tværfagligt arbejdsmiljø.

Erfaring fra operation, opvågning eller dagkirurgi er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

 

Hvem er vi?

Vi er et afsnit med høje faglige ambitioner og et stærkt fokus på kvalitet, læring og sammenhængende patientforløb.

Vi prioriterer kompetenceudvikling højt og arbejder systematisk med læring i praksis. Undervisning, faglig sparring og simulation er en integreret del af vores hverdag.

En gang om måneden gennemfører vi simulationstræning, hvor vi træner kliniske scenarier og styrker samarbejdet på tværs af faggrupper. Det bidrager til høj patientsikkerhed, faglig udvikling og tryghed i mødet med både kendte og uforudsete situationer.

Afsnittet er uddannelsessted for medicinstuderende, sygeplejestuderende, paramedicinere og anæstesikursister, og vi ser uddannelse og videndeling som en vigtig del af vores kultur.

Hos os møder du engagerede kolleger med forskellige erfaringer og kompetencer, som alle bidrager til et stærkt fællesskab og en arbejdsplads, hvor vi hjælper hinanden.
